reviews.comment: She is an absolutely outstanding teacher! Her courses are always meticulously prepared and the content is very comprehensive. She explained each problem very clearly and she give us quizzes which cover fundamental and important concepts and theorems. Each quiz and homework is graded with great care, and she provides very detailed feedback.
Awesome TA! Her recitations were super helpful in preparing me for the PhD preliminary exam.
The motivation behind examples and in-class problems is clear, and they relate well to materials learned in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I had Professor Dalal as a TA for my business calculus class this semester. Whenever we go over examples during class, she always asks if we have doubts and is willing to help when we do. She is also always available after class for extra help, even though those are not her assigned office hours. I would recommend having her as a TA.

Aashi was a great TA for my recitation for Business Calculus. She provided review sessions before the final and major exams and provided practice tests for all of our exams. She was always willing to explain something again in the recitation as well as providing office hour help every week for anyone to drop in. Helped me a lot, highly recommend!

I took Business Calc with Professor Dalal, and she was very helpful in helping me understand the material. She had several office hour opportunities throughout the week, she even offered to help me outside of office hours once. She is accommodating and very kind and she understands the stress of being a student.

Aashi did a great job of both going over all of the material while also having an extra day before exams to review all of the topics covered so we would be prepared for it. In the future, I am fairly confident that I will be prepared to answer questions with differential equations in future physics or electrical engineering classes.
Awesome Professor

This professor cares about her students and the material. Each lecture captures the chapters material without being bogged down by textbook lingo and theorems. She managed to keep the material light and easily digestible, while also providing a deep understanding of the topics.

Professor Dalal was a great professor! She took the time to explain any questions that were asked and was able to respond quickly to any questions that were asked outside of class. I recommend taking a class with professor Dalal!
great professor, very accommodating to drs services, show up to class and you will get a good grade. would HIGHLY recommend
Professor Dalal was an awesome professor! Her lectures and the assigned homework went really well together. She had fair exams and was genuinely concerned about everyone's understanding.

Professor Dalal is a very fair and caring professor. Her exams are very similar to the homeworks, she is always very helpful in office hours and will likely allow you to do exam corrections by demonstrating to her that you understand your errors. Be sure to show up to class, there are not usually recorded lectures and attendance is mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The recitations weren't mandatory, but they were very helpful for the quizzes and tests. Although she teaches at a very fast pace, she'll go back and explains things if you ask. During lon capa review sessions, she is very helpful with explaining how to do problems.

She is a pretty good TA. She will go over anything that you ask her, and she helps you out on HW a lot. If you need help with anything, just go to recitation or her office hours. She also hosted a review session for the final on a Saturday, which is pretty considerate of her.
Very helpful and good professor

I had her as a TA for calculus 3 and she was probably the only reason why I was able to pass the class. She is super helpful and always to the point which is something I really appreciate. She keeps things honest and definitely puts in the work to help her students. Not only this, she's easy to talk to and a great person all around.
Aashi Dalal was a great TA for my class. She explained concepts very well and made sure everyone understood before continuing forward. I would definitely take her again.

She has a fast pace as a TA when doing problems on the board, however, if you ask her what you're confused about she will go back and explain it well. Just have to try and keep it when doing problems on the board. Overall she is very helpful in actually learning how to apply the concepts learned in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had her as a TA for Calc 3. She went over plenty of example problems during recitation that were a really helpful study tool for exams. She was very available outside of class for help with homework or any conceptual issues. Overall, I would definitely take her again!

She's caring and patient. I feel delighted and fortunate to take her rec class! Math is hard for me but she helps me a lot. She's willing to go through each question in details and all her classes are well-prepared and organized which is helpful for all the students and I get a deeper understanding of math. APPRECIATE!

She is awesome! I had her as a TA for calc 2, and her recitations were extremely helpful. She would walk us through many example problems on the board, and she would give helpful hints and great explanations for each problem. She also would help out a lot with Lon Cappa problems- she did not just give vague hints and throw us to the wolves.

Professor Dalal is a great choice for any mathematics course because she genuinely cares and puts in a lot of effort to help students out. If you show up, listen attentively, and ask questions you won't find it hard to do well. If you find yourself struggling, reach out! She is always willing to help in any way she can.
I swear this guy is a zionist and says many questionable things but his class is easy and so long as u do the responses every week its an easy 90
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Adam Dodek is one of the most respected, kind, and inspirational professors at uOttawa Law. If you are lucky enough to get into this class (it is in high demand) it will be the best experience. He is so accessible outside of class too. He is hands down the best Con Law II Prof at uOttawa.

Dodek is a great guy and he's an expert on the constitution. 

He teaches this course entirely by Socratic Method. He won't tell you the ratio or test that comes from a case and his slides are just lists of his questions.

If you like Socratic, by all means Dodek is probably your guy. If you want to be told what you should know, avoid him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This course was one of my worst. I had to reach out to students in other sections with other profs to understand theThis course was one of my worst. I had to reach out to students in other sections wi material. Certainly, his lecturing style was confusing and no office hours were made available. I left the class more confused than I did entering.

By far the best law professor I've had. Makes public law fun. Interacts with students during lecture, provides witty comments, throws jokes into lectures and slides. Incorporates current events, making the material relatable. Exam questions are fairly open-ended, allowing students to showcase their knowledge. I would take any class Dodek teaches!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Dodek is by far one of the best profs that I've had in law school.  I had him in 1L for Public Law and also for Professional Responsibility.  He is engaging, clear and truly cares about student success.  He is also great at connecting current events and even pop culture with course material.  Be sure to follow instructions for assignments.

amazing prof. If you can land one of his courses, go for it. Very transparent in expectations and genuinely wants the students to succeed. Provides above and beyond level resources and help. Very enthusiastic and funny. Do all his readings though as he is fair and expects you to put in work.

By far the best professor for first year Public Law. He's incredibly intelligent and has an awesome sense of humour. The class content is dry and undoubtedly, you will feel lost, but do his old exams (he posts those) and you should be golden. Highly recommend.

From what I've been told, Dodek is the best Public Law prof of the bunch although the course will still be pretty dry. His enthusiasm and his ability to give a good lecture definitely made class bearable. He also posts his marking keys along with his old exams. Do those and you should be fine.

Dodek is highly respected in the school for good reason. His achievements are only outshined by his personal character and integrity. Great person, and his enthusiasm is contagious. I would definitely recommend choosing him for Public Law.

Mixed feelings. He is clearly passionate about public law but the course was not always well laid out. The textbook was bone-dry, and too much class time was spent discussing Rob Ford. Sure, that's tangentially public law-related, but those hours might have been better spent elsewhere.
Loved Professor Dodek. Very intelligent but very down to earth and actually takes his students seriously. Hilarious with a touch of nerdiness and made public law very enjoyable!

This guy really cares about his students. You can talk to him about anything, even an at-home crisis as he'll help or give you guidance. You will also learn, and I mean learn - as you move through your upper years you'll think back to his lectures both in public law and legal ethics. Picking courses - if you see his name pick the course!
Excellent & Fair professor.  Gives very helpful feedback prior to exams and posts marking keys to prior exams.
Dodek canvasses a wide range of material for legal ethics and responsibility. He engages the class in discussion and knows his stuff.

Tough but very fair prof who knows public law extremely well. His enthusiasm for the subject matter can make it come alive. Quite nerdy, which I appreciate. Very good lecturer, but be prepared for class.
Great prof has a passion for public law..
Great prof but very hard.
Excellent. Made torts interesting by focusing on modern cases and the news. Even prepared a mock exam for us to practice. Best small group imo

Nice man but I think he is cunning deep down. Gave great marks on memos and then messed ppl on the exam (maybe to get good course evaluations?) VERY technical. Pleasant to hear if you have an interest in the material. Super great at accomodating extra help to students and giving extra preparation. Cares for students to do well. Awkward in person.
Super!
An excellent and inspiring professor. His course is genuinely worth attending.

Excellent professor overall. Being a new Prof there are some minor bugs to work out but the class was excellent. He has a very innovative approach to teaching, and really tries to make the class interesting. Good articles and selects very interesting guest speakers. If you're preparing to be a french teacher, he's a great person to learn from!

Adam is a kind and caring prof. He is currently doing his PHD. He does assign a LOT of readings so be ready to read at least one article per week. There is a ton of group work. He is open to hearing feedback so let him know if something is outrageous that he asks of you. 7 small group projects, midterm, final portfolio.

She is a good professor and easy to understand. She is very passionate about what she teaches. There are many students who skip or don't read the text book so they complain but I did all the readings and went to 95% of the classes and got an A+. She is not for people who expect good grades but don't do the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is the worst prof I have ever had. Obviously, she lacks communication skills, does a very poor job in teaching the material, and is not polite talking to the students at all. I will never recommend her to any of my classmates.

Used useless youtube videos that were made by highschool students to highlight unrelated and unimportant points about teh topic for the day. Digresses to unrelated topics and rants and yells about pointless information. Tries to tie concepts to canada, where the information does not tie (african hunter gatherer tribes). overall, classes are boring.
Very knowledgeable and makes herself available to students. Also very tactful.

HORRIBLE CLINICAL PROFESSOR I'VE EVER TAKEN! she favors students (mostly men) and will put you on edge every time you stepped into clinical. Does NOT care about the students or her patients. demonstrated unprofessionalism to students, other staff members and patients. Oh she makes you do flash cards for the meds you receive, meanwhile we paid 300 f
WHAT A HORROR!!! ENOUGH SAID.

I personally think that she likes the guys more. I also think that she can be a little condescending but i think it's coz she forgets that we are not comfortable with our skills yet. Overall she is a GREAT instructor. I've learned a lot and would recommend her.
Had this professor for Med-Surg 1 clinical, did not learn a lot. Experience was not tied into the lecture. If you want an easy ride, and don't care to learn a lot, this is the class for you.
Very easy grader. He does take attendence but overall experience was very good. He took BDM class for our semester. Very easy exams and very easy A grade.
If you show up and put in some effort, you will get an A. The lectures are OK. Lot of work for a 2 credit class.

This class is not easy nor is Professor Gomaa going to give you a high letter grade if you don't deserve it. You have to earn your letter grade like you have to earn other things in the real world.  Having said that, Professor Gomaa is an excellent teacher. He is able to bring real-world experience into classroom discussions and convey ideas well.
I loved this professor, always listened to the students and was very easy on the grades in such a time consuming class.

Greatest professor at RBS. 3-4 multiple choice exams extremely easy!! Assigns homework but who knows if he actually checks it. Always late so be patient but such an easy A that it is worth waiting 15 minutes for him. EASY A!!! Does not want you to fail so will find a way to pass you. TAKE HIM!
Great Professor. Easy grader and fun.
awesome teacher, takes attendance and gives you lots of opportunities to get a good grade!!! Such a pleasure to have!!!
An excellent professor. Engaging, really wants you to learn. I enjoyed his class a lot. Will give extra credit if you need to. Highly recommended.
The best!
AWESOME TEACHER!!!!

Basak is the kindest professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his student's success. His exams are entirely based on the lecture slides, which is incredibly helpful for a content-heavy course. He does a great job explaining complex topics and responds to emails very quickly. Amazing prof

Mr. Basak is a gem of a human being and the best professors I have ever met in my entire school career not only does he explain complex concepts with the flow and grace of a swan but every action he makes he is always thinking of the students If I could take his class again I would overall Mr. Basak is at the pinacle of his craft

Prof. Basak is a king. His course is super content-heavy, however his exam questions are based directly on the slides with no surprises. Does a pretty good job at explaining complicated material. He's also super nice if you have any questions and responds to emails quickly.

Prof. Basak is amazing, the content for HSS 2305 is very heavy but he breaks it down and makes it easy to understand. His exams are very fair and based on his slides. Would definitely recommend taking him again.
THE GOAT, TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN
Great prof
u don't have to go to class to get an a+. just memorize the slides. good guy. he has the best interest of his student's at heart.

He's probably the best choice out of the profs that teach this course. His lectures can be pretty dull (esp. at 8:30am), but other than that he means what he says and the evaluations are very straight forward and simple despite being VERY content heavy. Don't take his word when he says when he'll give back evaluations though LOL add on a week more.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very clear in his expectations and though pathophysiology is a very heavy course he explains it all very well. He is also accessible outside of class if you ever need clarification!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor was nice and cared, but the amount of stuff you are expected to know is impossibly much, while what he asks in exams and midterms is much less than what is emphasized and highlighted in his slides.

Overall, I had a great experience with this professor. The class was very content heavy, but he didn't make anyone use the textbook and based all questions off his slides which helped immensely! His classes are an easy recipe for success: go to class, read the slides, and the A+ is yours. Would definitely take again
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Basak has been one of the best profs I've had this semester. His course is very content heavy and can be difficult, but if you go to class and keep up with everything - it will be a breeze. His lectures can be a little slow but he gives you everything you need to be successful. Although I wish gave out more grading opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Finally, a caring prof and evaluations that reflect the content. I highly recommend this course with Dr. Basak.
I love this professor. So kind and thoughtful and his class was a breeze despite having monitored exams. Would take anything with him again.

Super nice prof. His lectures can be a little boring because he has a bit of a monotoned voice. His exams are very fair. Lectures are very clear and easy to follow. Just listen in class and study and you'll have everything you need to succeed.

Basak isn't the best lecturer, but he really cares about you as a student. Automatic bump into the next grade category if you're sitting a few percent away, as long as you attended class.  Slides are super clear, he colour codes the important info! No need to buy the textbook as all the info is on the slides, however that makes for long lectures.

He's really smart so he goes through course material very fast, but tries to go back and help everyone. There's a lot to know, but he tries to make it as easy as possible by colour-coding the slides. He also takes attendance so if you ask for extra credit and you attend classes, he'll give it to you. His accent can be rough, but you get used to it.

Ajoy Basak is a really nice guy. His lectures are very lengthy and detailed so it will be difficult to focus the whole time but try... His tests are fair but he does expect you to know a lot. He knows what he is talking about and will answer all your questions. Overall a joy as a prof!

Answers emails very quickly, quizzes are a lot easier compared to midterms, thick accent but you get use to it after awhile, tends to skip the last few slides if there isn't enough time, sometimes goes back to them the next class, takes attendance, course material is heavy

All test questions are taken straight from lecture slides, which are pretty clear. There is no need to buy the textbook. He has an accent, but he is very helpful and approachable, responds to emails quickly. He's ajoy to be around :^)

You can tell that he is an expert in the field and tries to make the information interesting. I wrote my notes in a question and answer format in 2-3 pages/lecture and did well. Don't be afraid to ask him questions or email because he is super helpful! Only use the text to brush up on basic concepts because exams are straight from the slides.
Good class, just know the slides. Professor is very nice and kind.

I  must say he may not be the best at teaching, he is such a brilliant man that his brain is thinking 3 times the speed that his mouth can go. But you can tell he has nothing but good intentions. He is always ready to answer questions, and he will take all the time in the world to see you succeed. He bell curves and his quizes are easy! Great proff

This man is fantastic! Yes, he does have an accent which may be hard for some but I fully understand him. He is hilarious and truly cares about the success of his students. He explains 1 topic in numerous ways and it really helps it to get in your head and stay there! Brilliant man and I will definitely be taking another class with him!

His lectures are boring but what he lacks in public speaking he makes up by having easy midterms and final exams. As long as there is no short answer in your exam, you should easily get an A. The book is also useless for his class but it does clarify things he is not able toQ

1)Accent is thick but it makes you pay attention more so I liked it                              2)He colour codes the slides so you know exactly what will be on the examinations.                3)The material gets very difficult at around lecture 7-11                           4)Problem? Examination questions are so CONFUSING, so good luck.

Very nice teacher, but can be sometimes confusing. He skips a lot when he can't finish the material, but comes back to it the next class. His tests are easy, and you don't need the textbook at all to pass this class. Overall, he's a good professor. Recommended.

Prof has really good intentions and loves what he teaches. The midterm is very difficult and is worth 40% so if you do bad it's hard to recover. The quizzes are very easy but the exam is hard too. His slides have everything labeled in colour so it's easy to know what to learn, just a dense course. Overall professor is good, he just has an accent.

Exams are insanely confusing and you will always do worse than you expect. The course material is already so heavy and complicated, that it doesn't help that his exams are so difficult. Overall, he's not a bad professor, just a very very tough one.

He's an intelligent, kind, and very helpful person. If you go to his office hours, or talk to him after class, you'll see how genuinely helpful he is. However, this course IS SO HARD. It's not simply memorization, but integration of many difficult concepts. On top of that, his exams are extremely confusing. Just pass this class.

Bull. I feel like these other reviews were written by ajoy himself because not one of my friends (all of whom have above 3.9/4 GPAs) liked him. Not too bad in the classroom but his tests are absolutely horrific. Every MCQ has a)... b)... c)... d) A and B e) all the above --- absolutely brutal. Everyone flopped and he didn't bell curve at all.
Very nice prof. Tests and midterms were fair. Answers emails and questions really quickly. He tries to help his students as much as he can:)

This prof is awesome. He is clear in his explanations and listens to students. A lot of the people taking this course didn't have a chem background, so he took out any chem things that we were supposed to know for the tests. Only issue with him is that his quizzes are very fair and easy vs midterm which was difficult/not as fair. Good prof though!

Really great professor !  I think one of the best I've had so far. He takes the time to explain everything throughly and you can tell that he wants everyone to do well. Such a kind person too ! Definitely recommend.

Excellent professor, very responsive to student feedback and is approachable. HSS 2305 had extremely difficult material and we didn't have the biochemical background. He took that into account and changed the course to dumb it down a few notches. Very patient and will repeat things until you understand.

Excellent teacher, mentor and communicator, Prepared slides in an easy to understand manner, Very helpful and understandable, Willing to go extra mile to make student understand, Highly knowledgable and caring Professor
Very nice and very smart. But he really didn't seem to have gotten a briefing on what is to be taught prior to instructing the class. The course was not well structured and very unclear!

The course itself is quite content heavy, but he does a good job at conveying the material. Study his slides well, and you're sure to do well. He goes into depth with pathways, but if you can follow along, it's actually more understanding than memorization.

I was struggling and after meeting with him several times, he told me "go to CAPS."  I studied for 6 days for his  test and got a 74 (I've had A+ in every french class till then). When we were speaking in class, he made fun of me. Only W I've ever taken.  My experience was bad, but maybe he's helpful to others. Dropped French as my minor.
Super awesome! He's been around, he's lived allover the world! He is an excellent french teacher and a very old school grammar stickler. Go in as mediocre come out a French Speaking Super-Star!

J'adore Monsieur Antoine! He is not an easy teacher, but he is so willing to help you and his personality is just amazing. He's a real sweetheart and we call him the French Einstein because he looks like a mad professor. His French is perfect and he will explain things in English if you can't understand him. Overall; j'adore beaucoup.

Had classe with him during Covid. He always made sure that everyones mental health was good. I also had issues with an other professor and he help me figure out how to "report" and do something with that other prof. Very nice and interesting classes. I didn't like the class to much but he was one of the reason why I didn't change it.

Loved Alain! He's awesome and very understanding. He will accommodate students based on their comfortability and skill level. He only pushes you only to help increase confidence! 10/10 would recommend this wonderful prof.
Pretty good, don't be shy give it what you got

Excellent professor. It is obvious that he is extremely passionate about his subject matter. He is genuinely such a kind and caring man. His course is interesting, and he adds additional anecdotes and concepts from his own life and research. Hands down, his lectures are some of the most inspirational, engaging, and entertaining at my time at UofO

Alain is an incredibly caring professor who wishes only the best for his students. He recognises genuine effort and creativity in problem solving, and will offer his time to support you if you need. His lectures could go further to illustrate the problem solving capacities he looks for from his students, but other than that is an awesome prof :)

Dr. Musende was one of my favorite profs this semester. He really cares about his students and works hard to make his class engaging with funny anecdotes. The class isn't too difficult, if you study you should do well and he curves if needed which is a plus.

Is a very nice prof, he cares a lot about his students. Lectures can be a bit boring, but the exams were quite straightforward if you put in effort to study. If you participate in class (questions, discussions) he gives candy and also bonus marks on your final grade if you participate a lot. Very inspirational and passionate about what he does

Alain is a sweet guy who genuinely cares about his students. He makes sure to have a good class average where everyone understands. The class however is very unorganized and test questions can sometimes be a surprise. They require critical thinking and application. ALOT easier than BPS2110 with Ogilvy. You do have to memorize as well as understand.

Dr. Musende is without a doubt among the best professors I've had during university. He is kind, knowledgeable, and his lectures are very interesting. He is an exceptional human being and mentor who allows you to reap what you sow. Personally, one of the most exciting classes to attend as he is actively involved at high levels in industry.

He is very caring but is not a good lecturer. Came late to class, went off topic every lecture, barley covered 10 slides in the 1.5 hours. Midterm/Final were not a good representation of the class, told us there would be calculations but never gave us any examples. Overall, material is interesting but the course is not structured at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He gets off topic a lot. Often we would only cover 10 slides each class. He starts class with an inspirational quote. The material is easy. You don't need to go to class to learn. there's a millionaire game that counts as participation 10%. I would go for participation and study the material at home, got an A- on the midterm. 40% midterm 50% exam.

Pretty sure the good review are written by him Do NOT take this class if you want a good grade. Cancels class, talks about himself majority of the time, went through only 3 lectures up until the midterm. The midterm was barley based on the lecture notes, majority were calculation type questions which no examples were given in class or in notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Go to class - not because you absolutely have to in order to pass this course, but because he's the best lecturer I've had in my entire undergrad. Very reasonable amount of material taught per class. His focus is on understanding, not memorization - so ask questions, participate, and you'll crush this class and love it.

Awesome Professor and an amazing human being. I loved his class, his teaching method and his enthusiasm about the topics. A little tip is to show up to class and to participate. He honestly wants all students to do well and he tries his best to make you understand the material while relating it to real life examples related to the pharma industry.

This man is so sweet. He really cares about his students. I was in a bad place when I took his class but he inspired me to keep going and be passionate about what I learn. His class is a little tricky, his notes won't make too much sense unless you go to class, but the material is easy to learn. This is my 2nd class with him. Great man!!

Dr. Musende is an inspiration. I cannot stress how much participation is important in his class. He keeps track of your participation, and will give you the academic benefit-of-the-doubt if you do so!
Dr. Musende is very knowledgeable on the topic, and conveys the material well. Participation is a huge part of class, and his exams are very fair. Would take again!
An amazing prof. Very engaging and although the matter is pretty advanced, he's always available to help. Participate!

Amazing professor! Very knowledgeable and passionate about the course material. His questions really make you think critically about the course material as opposed to pure memorization. Gives excellent feedback. Would definitely recommend him!
the best

Hahaha, this guyyyyyy. Found it really impossible to follow him in class. Would start a thought... trail off... and never come back. So don't sweat the awful notes you'll come out with. The slides, though confusing, should be sufficient - memorize the heck out of them and you'll get an A. Very fair testing.
He kept saying don't learn that by heart but exams are nothing but learning by heart. hated him.

Very kind human being. You won't find many people better than him. Although I didn't learn much in his class, and his notes are a little bit hard to decipher he tries to make you a critical thinker by asking out of the box questions during the lectures and is very entertaining. Highly recommended.

Very good prof. He clearly cares about what he is teaching and is passionate in his lectures, easy to listen to and asks you good question worth easy bonus points. Also free candy if you answer questions!
Easy exams
Very enthusiast professor. Passionate about what he does and cares about his students. No textbook, just slides, and gives out a ton of candy during lectures.

This prof was good, but barely taught anything all semester. Instead, we had 30 minute long group presentations (you do not get to pick your teammates) where we would teach the class a chapter from the textbook. Exams are basically impossible to study for, and questions often were on very very specific topics that were not covered in class.

Genuinely the laziest prof I've ever had. This woman does not want to teach and she makes clear of that. I've never had a prof openly complain about how much work her job is, yet she barely even teaches (even when she does, she doesn't do it well). The course is taught by the textbook and group presentations. 3 surprise quizzes. Easy midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Incredibly easy A. Easy marker, but she didn't really teach ANYTHING the entire term. Students taught eachother through group projects every class. We had guest lecturers too. Anyone but the prof teaching. Would pick at people's projects in front of everyone in class and want to have "constructive conversations" which should've been done privately
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Dubois is not a bad prof, she just doesn't teach much for this class. We went through the textbook with group presentations, which was the material for the exams. Instruction for the exam were unclear, but prof Dubois was very generous when grading group projects.

Professor Dubois is very caring. However, in this class, she doesn't teach at all. All the subjects are covered by group presentations, speakers and by the book. Also, she says not to learn anything by heart, but don't listen to her. Personally, I would not take this prof again. Beside that, the exams are fair and the project is fun to do.

I took prof Dubois' HSS3101 last year and found her teaching style a bit disorganized, but still ended the class with an A. Her exams are straight forward. This course, we're tested on the textbook material (which is a good read btw). Pretty much 80% of lecture time is group presentations.

This professor did not do a good job of teaching. Her lectures were very disorganized, she would start them but get sidetracked and never finish the PowerPoint. I had to teach myself everything and when you would ask questions she would say to google it. It is unfortunate that we pay so much money for tuition just to be told to "google it"

Prof Dubois is really nice and caring. The class material is really easy, but you have to read the textbook and know were to find the information to get a good grade on the test (which were open book except for the final). Make sure to consult the websites she provides since some material was on the tests sometimes. The final is super easy.

Professor Dubois is very passionate about the material she teaches. She can be a little disorganized and change her instructions a few times, but if you attend the class, you will easily be able to understand what needs to be done. Make sure to do the readings that she assigns since the exams are mostly based on their content.
Honestly loved her! She's passionate and so caring. She'll do anything that she can to help you. I had her in HSS 1501

I understand why people are saying it can be stressful(Prof Dubois can be disorganised sometimes) but she does repeat instructions and you will understand them eventually. Prof Dubois's class is so light and fun to be in. We did presentations the whole semester(and actually learned). And the exams were open book! I recommend this class.

I understand some of the slander on here, but I absolutely loved prof Dubois! The only reason her class is stressful is because she can sometimes be disorganized and not give clear instructions. Other than that, her class was probably the most fun 3hr lecture I've ever been to. She gives you everything you need to succeed and really cares about you

Je comprend pas pourqoi proffesseure Dubois a tellement de mauvais commentaires associés à son nom. J,ai personellement ADORE son cours, sa facon d'apprendre. Elle est TRÈS flexible et comprehensive. La moyenne du premeir session était vraiment haut (dans les 90%). Je RECOMMMANDE À 100%
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Does not actually teach anything in her 3-hour zoom lectures. I absolutely did not learn anything from her. She can be quite rude and she decided she would proctor the exam because fewer and fewer people would attend her lecture as a form of punishment. I think learning should be about encouraging and motivating students and she did the opposite.

This prof uses the whole 2h 50m lecture and goes very slowly with a poor mic. Went into the exam blindly and guessing. Told the class that only x amount of groups went for help OUTSIDE of class time and that was the reason for low averages. Only uploaded paper help afterwards that could have easily been uploaded to brightspace. Do not take.

Her slides were unclear and its hard to understand her lectures because she has a thick accent. Don't buy the textbook, pay attention to what she says in class. She is very nice and approachable. Her criteria was fair for the Qualitative paper and my group did very good on it but her midterm wasn't too fair.

Alejandra is a nice person. However, her lectures are so long; she makes you read a lot, although her readings and her slides do not correlate sometimes. Most people did not do well on her assignments in my class. Make sure to speak to her a lot about your paper. It helps!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Went on first few lectures then stopped because she took too long and I found it better to study on my own. Qualitative paper was awful as many people were unhappy with their grades. My group followed what she taught on lectures but ended up with a very low mark. She didn't give us an appointment to review our paper too. Avoid.

The lecturers were fine and what she did actually cover, she covered well. BUT, we most often only finished half the slides even though she always took the full 2 hours & 50 minutes. Worse than that was the exam was unfair. I got an 86 but most of the Qs were poorly written &unclear, and didnt reflect what she covered in class/ the readings

Worst prof I've had so far. She's very nice as a person but a horrible teacher. Extremely unclear with her instructions and bad at explaining. She doesn't even seem to know what she's saying. Don't read the book, just go to her classes and TRY to understand what she's saying.  Her notes are really bad and incomplete. AVOID HER!

Basically overall horrible teacher. She tells us to do the readings but doesn't even teach what we have read. Test aren't even related to what we have learned. We learn it a certain way in class and it is the opposite on the test. She has no idea what she is talking about.. Worst teacher i've had yet.

The group project is not based off the rubric! If you skip class and just follow the rubric, the professor is not afraid to fail you. She is very nice if you are happy with your mark. If you would like to review something or have her explain it, she is very dismissive, rude, and unreasonable.

Amazing human being ; One of the nicest prof I've came through in my 4 years of university. Really there for student, caring and understanding. You really know what to expect on the exam. It was her first time teaching the class so she was sometimes confusing but still great. Would recommend her.
L'examen final n'avait aucun rapport avec le cours... Elle n'est pas precise avec ses objectifs. Mais toujours là pour aider!
Professor Fiorello was great. He inspired me to major in Philosophy at UOttawa and I really enjoyed his lectures. He is very kind and understanding. He has a strong passion for the subject.

This professor is kind, but he does not know what he is talking about. Super unconfident, and kept repeating his sentences during lectures, which made his words super hard to track and understand. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!

This class was based only on the midterm 20%, essay 30% and final 50%. His lectures are ok, he gets off topic and can be hard to understand but overall he knows his content. He provides good reviews for the exams. If you study you'll do well, they were never too challenging. So many readings, be prepared to read a LOT.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He knows his content very well and always leaves room for open discussion during class. Great way to engage students and hear different perspectives. There is a lot of reading, which I have personally skimmed through most since it's way too much to read (for someone who has 5 classes). He's open to feedback and is very sympathetic! :)

Prof. Simari was a great professor for essay writing! The class consisted of a couple of quizzes, one midterm, and assignments that helped build toward the final research essay. His feedback was always very clear and helpful!

The professor is a kind person. Sometimes the class takes a slow turn during teaching but I feel like he is a fair grader, and he knows what he is talking about. Seeing a theatre is the best part of this course so that we can discuss it with the class. Liked this course.

He gave good, clear assignments and equally good feedback - they weren't too difficult. Also appreciate that for the plays we had to attend, he chose quite cheap options almost all under $15 for students. Lectures were quite monotone - some interesting content but often not related to/helpful towards the course material and assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof was kind but monotone and dull. His work assigned was easy, and I enjoyed watching the plays assigned. However, being in the lectures was hard. He talked fast and lacked emotion. Everything he said was easy to understand, but it was just communicated dryly. Overall, the class wasn't difficult and he was a pretty fair grader
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor seems nice, but lectures feel long and tend to use jargon where it isn't needed. Grading criteria could have been clearer, but feedback is provided. Beware that this course requires seeing a lot of theatre outside of class.

I learned a lot from her class. Usually the people that do bad are the ones that don't show up. You may get by with just the power points, but every now and then she'll throw in stuff specifically discussed in class.  I found most of her to lectures to be pretty interesting, and she can be pretty chill as well.

Prof A is always willing to help.  She provides very helpful study guides, and as long as you take the time to thoroughly answer the study guide questions, you will be all set for her exams. Answers come from her lectures. Easy points can be earned through attendance and online HW. She gives 3 exams, 2 mini research papers, and tons of extra credit

I hated American Government until I took Prof Wishart's class. She is enthusiastic about what she teaches and that translates well into understanding the information. She gives tons of extra credit opportunities and every test has a thorough review that if you pay any attention to you can't make below a B on. There is some group work but it's okay.

She was lots of energy, very opinionated, lots of reading, very hard  "C" with being at every lecture and completing all task on time... She is slightly liberal on make up work with excuses. Very Firm --- not recommendable- lectures are not by textbook
She was high energy! But not easy........ She was very knowledgeable about the course, I was a hard "b ".. that's being in class every lecture... yes to reading.....
This course is not very organized. Professor not very good at interpreting lessons for students to undtetand. She can come off as rude.

Don't even! i  made a mistake taking this class with her. It's too complex for an intro class. Especially if you aren't familiar with US politics. This is an easy A class. Unless this is your major and wanna learn it the hard way don't take her.

This is a really good professor. Wow. Too be so young she is extremely diversed, great listener, very thorough and clear.. This professor provides easy to understand lectures and makes sure you get it before moving on. I highly recommend her.

Lets get this straight, she is a great professor and this is an interesting class. ALOT of note taking is necessary bc test questions are from lecture instead of ppt slides that dont give enough info. BUT HER TESTS ARE HARD even after I studied extremely hard! Plus she words her tests hard as well to where my brain wants to explode on question one.

I have to agree with several others about her teaching style.  She has difficulty transferring her knowledge in a teachable manner.  Tests were NOT commensurate with her notes or the book. Bring a recorder,  since she goes off topic ad nauseam. Take someone else if you can.

Honestly, She is the VERY BEST professor I have ever had. Always trying to help but you have to ask for help if you need it. She is very passionate about american history and she's not even from here so that should mean more. I recommend doing the reading b/c it makes understanding the lectures easier, which are actually well put together.

Shes a great professor!! She cares about her students and she is very clear. If you attend class every day you have it, it will be very easy. She says everything that will be on her tests! She wants her students to exceed!!

Teach is passionate about American History more than about students desire to learn. Tends to be unorganized, jumps around a lot in her notes. Does not like to repeat herself or go over test.  Will answer some questions asked from study guide. Proceed with caution.

She was unnecessarily hard .She turned what I thought was going to be a good experience into a bad one.  She doesn't know how to transfer her knowledge into a way students are able to follow.  I thought the class would be very interesting and fun...NOT.  She was so all over the place, it was hard to take notes. Bring your recorder, you'll need it!

Prof. Wishart is full of knowledge about global issues and could answer all the questions I had.  Not being from America I had alot to catch up on for American Foreign Policy but she really made it clear

Prf. Wishart LOVES talking about global issues! She is very open and willing to help, however my problem in class was that there were no PowerPoints or anything to take notes from; no direction. So it is a must you bring something to record with. Also she was very (purposely)vague when it came to the study guide. Study hard, tests are challenging.
she is very passionate and knowledgeable. Her tests arent easy but u attend class, pay attention, and read you should do fine. She is also willing to help or clarify anything you dont understand

You can tell about Wishart was that she was compassionate about global issues. The only problem is that the class has no real structure. No power points,just straight out lecture. For a introductory level class, this was by far the hardest I ever had to take. Making a good grade is possible, just very difficult. Her tests are pretty difficult.
She was super helpful when I started writing a paper for her class and she was always around to talk.
Extremely hard.No notes posted whatsoever. Must attend class to take notes from lecture. She talks extremely fast and when asked to repeat still speaks fast. Worst class I've taken so far (jr. yr.)
Teacher is hard but very knowledgeable.  She puts a lot of material into the lectures but is always available to explain anything you missed or go back over something in class.  Very nice.
This is class is hard. Teacher knows what she is talking about. Even though attendance isn't necessary there is no way you can do well in the class without showing up.

She is highly knowledgeable on the subject, though she does not have the ability to properly teach. Somewhat insensitive to student's taking notes, be it by hand or note-taking device. Though, she is very nice, just difficult to be instructed by.

This professor is hard to work with. She is not very open to question. She talks very fast and does not give you any outline or power point. Tests are complicated all though she has a hard time seeing this it is obvious when half the students dropped out. If you want to make one of your freshman classes a challenge you should take this professor.

Very hard. Seems unprepared for class, post readings on ulearn at last minute. Must take notes, however, she's hard to follow, very confusing. Give quizzes in place of taking attendance, only three exams that's worth 60% of grade. Knows her stuff but cant transfer it to others.

Very nice and friendly,just not a good teacher. Taking notes is a must, however, its hard to understand what she's talking about, she's very confusing. She's very passionate about the subject  and knows her stuff, but does not know how to transfer the knowledge to others. She appears unprepared and post readings on ulearn at the last minute. Hard.

Good teacher, but a tough grader. You have to pay attention and do the readings to do well in the class, but that shouldn't be hard if you're a good student. Attendance isn't entirely mandatory, but she does give reading quizzes from time to time as a way of checking attendance.

Prof Rodrigue is amazing, she manages to make complex material easy to understand and to remember. Exam and homework criteria are clear. All lectures are recorded and she takes the time to answer any questions after each class. Take her if you can!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: such an amazing prof oh my god. criteria for exams are super clear no surprises. a university students dream prof!

Great prof overall. Hilarious, actually enjoyed going to his lectures. Group projects are 20% of the grade and heavily depend on your group mates pulling their weight, but he does make an effort to weed out freeloaders. Exams were much tougher than expected, but the final did get an adjustment.
Arguably one of the best Professors at Ottawa U. This was the second course i had with him. First was with ADM1370, and now ADM2372. His TAs are the worst though, avoid the guy with glasses.
Classes are very interesting and not boring. If you show up to class, you will pass. I will definitely take him in other classes in the future.

Nice and helps during class & exams but NOT out of class His practice exams r dumb and no cheat sheets. There are 5 quizzes and some are attendance based so make sure to show up to every class. For excel and database assignments go to office hours bc instructions arent enough & he'll help MAKE FRIENDS FOR CLASS also dont buy textbook its useless

Overall very disorganized, shown by in-class presentations, slow email replies, and poorly prepared PowerPoints. However, he answered questions well during class. Attending lectures and listening is crucial because he discreetly mentions exam content. Its important to study thoroughly for the exams because questions were from almost every chapter.
Super chill. But lectures feel super useless because he does not teach and only talks about other things. Midterm was mid.

Extremely unprepared professor, I took this course with high expectations given his high ratings, however he does NOT post slides on time, ignores emails, and does not say as he does. I would not recommend unfortunately.

Only prof to genuinely make me laugh in a lecture. Also a really easy person to talk to outside of lectures. He'll wave and smile, and take your questions about assignments even if you run into him randomly on campus. 

Shoutout to this guy for real

Much of the content in the assignments, such as Excel's Solver and Access's Database Advancement, is not covered in class, and you must spend extra time in office hour to complete the assignments, and many of the multiple choice questions on the final exam are never covered in class.

Make sure to attend office hours to help you with the excel and database assignment or else you wont know how to do them as the instruction sheet is vague. Exams are open book and in person.

Attend each lecture as he has random quizzes which he always changes the date even if the original date was  on the syllabus.

He is a nice guy but lazy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very great personality and quite accommodating however he will make things sound easier than what they actually are.

Very engaging with the students and his lectures are enjoyable. Assignments have detailed instructions. However, he doesn't really answer emails, will occasionally pause to write future exam questions in the middle of a lecture, and the final was a DISASTER. He made it open book but very difficult, I believe the final grades got curved up a lot.

He's really nice but very unorganized, made classes very engaging and entertaining but also exams were harder than they are supposed to be. He does not respond to some emails even tho he will tell us to email him.
Such a fun and understanding professor. Would definitely take him again!
All exams are open book and assignments are provided with tutorials on how to do them. Easy to reach and will help with your assignments and is a very easy grader.
Easy going but is unorganized. Arrived to lectures late and unprepared on multiple occasions. Lectures are pointless and course material can be learned yourself.
Really great prof ! If you have the chance to take just do it ! He's so supportive with his students and does everything to help them

An Amazing professor! He wants his students to exceed. His assignments were very well explained in class and the midterm was quite easy if you pay attention to his lectures. Overall, a great professor! Would take his class again.

He's super nice but unprofessional. Will not respond to emails and you must message him through MS teams to maybe get a reply. Says he'll release grades, but then doesn't until very late. Says the quizzes are tested only from his slides, but to do well you MUST read the textbook. Overall nice guy, just frustrating when you can't take his word.
One of my favorite professors. You can tell that he wants his students to do good in this course.

He is a good guy BUT He is making easy course to hard one. Didn't ask any questions from the textbook or slides, so what was the use of getting the textbook if he wasn't going to use it. Lost so many points for quizzes and exams because he made it unnecessarily hard. Didn't respond to any of the emails, take another professor if you have a choice.

Not a big fan of this professor because he takes too long to release the grades of assignments and quizzes, causing others to postpone their decision on whether or not to drop the course. Plus, his quizzes are difficult; quizzes should be easy marks and should ask questions directly from the slide, but they are not.
Excellent Prof. Knows his material well.
I really learnt a lot from his class particularly Excel. Hes very flexible and gives you extension to submit your assignment without any stress.
He is a good person, but grade so hard
Amazing Prof. Very friendly and understanding. Really enjoyed his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: AMAZING prof.! Put in the effort and you'll do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Top class Prof. Really learnt a lot from this guy. His class inspired me to change my major to BTM.
The Prof is good but his TA was a tough grader. Highly recommend for MIS students.
Awesome Prof! One of the best at teaching online. Class was always fun and engaging.
Literally the best and most understanding professor ever. He's a really good teacher and accessible outside of class. Assignments are easy, exams are fair. He's so cool!!
His exams are very straight forward and are based on class discussion and tutorials. His exam was open book which was amazing but you need to study to know where all the contents are.
Although the class was from 7 to 10pm, I looked forward to it every week. He is so chilled and flexible and very understanding of student workloads.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not a very good teacher and confusing as to what you need to know for tests. Class is relatively easy tho

Professor Ohiomah was a great teacher & I hope to have him again in the future for a different class. He's chill & understanding & easy to talk to, and helpful. & I learned alot of useful info from this class.

Great Professor. He does the MOST to ensure you have everything you need to succeed and is very helpful when you reach out to him. He is more than fair in every deliverable that is graded and gives you a lot of time to complete the assignments. If you are willing to put in the work and attend class you should have absolutely no problem.
He is so easy going and genuinely cares about student workloads.
Amazing professor, amazing personality and really helpful/friendly with his fellow students. He is probably the most approachable professor i've seen

Although the deliverable structure expectation seemed to shift a bit, the professor made the content (that could have been very dry) an engaging experience. Alhassan often used our classes research topics (which shows he remembered our work inprogress) to relate it the course matter.

Professor Alhassan Ohiomah knows the subject very well and his teaching style is excellent. He helps in every confusion related to the subject and is available to answer any doubts afterclass hours too.
Hilarious teacher, good course. I learned a lot about technology and its reaction to business and the applications as well.

The prof for this course is extremely understanding. He would sometimes postpone an assignment during midterms for example and I really appreciate that. He is a very nice person as well as a prof and would always come to class prepared.
By far the most understanding Prof at the Telfer School of Management. He's very flexible and gets student feedback for components of the course.
Good guy and very flexible with assignment deadlines

This Professor has unrealistic expectations for his student it's almost like he doesn't realize that we have other classes. You will have 7 days between each group case study and he even gives you the midterm 2 days before a group case is due.

Professor Ohiomah is a great teacher who is passionate about the applications of technology in business. His lectures are wellstructured. He's very accessible outside of class if students were to have any questions.

The prof for this course is extremely understanding. He would sometimes postpone an assignment during midterms for example and I really appreciate that. He is a very nice person as well as a prof and would always come to class prepared
Professor is extremely understanding of student's schedules and ensures that what is best for us is what happens. Overall an excellent teacher that puts the students first.

Changes assignments' deadline multiple times without any notice, requires students to purchase access codes that completely useless, can't teach properly. Need to attend 80% of the class in in order to be eligible to write the exam. Avoid at all costs!!!
Really nice and chill. Class consisted of case studies and final.
The Professor knows the subject very well and knows how to teach. He is very open and communicates clearly with students. I hope to take a class with him again in the future.

Pretty straightforward prof. This class isn't difficult if you go over notes and go to your labs. It is easy to fall behind, but it isn't too hard to catch up either. Purchased the e-textbook but barely used it.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great teacher, but you definitely have to put in work to learn. If you ask him questions, he loves explaining the answers and will often stay in the room until the next class starts. Tests make sure you know the material through and through, and are usually exactly 50 minutes worth. Book only for homework problems.

Total Magoo, useless in class and during office hours. Has more knowledge about the subject than most, but his ability to teach and transfer this knoledge is atrocious. Test guidlines are absurd, not to metion the test are ungodly long. (8 pages in 50 minutes) Do not take this maniac unless you like torture.

Lectures are fine and the quizzes and labs are light work. The midterm exam multiple choice were similar to the quizzes, but the long answers are tough. The professor was really sweet until it came to the final, the final was comprised of stuff we never learned at all and was an overall mess

Although recorded lectures get boring and monotone from time to time,(prof doesnt do weekly classes which i would prefer)and using Teams as courses website is a bit struggling,Prof. Ali is a great prof. He returns to emails lightning fast, his methodology is very clear when solving problems and the exams are pretty straightforward. Solid choice!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The prof encourages and motivates students to do better. Do your best, state assumptions, and get your thoughts and points across if you can't completely answer the questions. Quizzes are not that hard. He gives a lot of asynchronous lecture content except for the tutorials. For exams, it's enough to study his lectures and do the textbook practice.

He look nice and sweet on the outside, but he'll wreck the crap out of you when correcting the exams. I get a feeling that this behavior is because he can't understand someone else's way of solving a problem. If it's not like he does it, he'll consider you wrong, even though you get it right. Make sure you study his way of solving problems.

He is a really nice guy. Although his lecture could make people confused somepoint, he made this course pretty straightforward, just like CVG2140. Quizzes are like free mark giveway. We have 70+ average on the midterm, but he still provides a makeup quiz for boosting grades. definitely would take with him again if have a chance.
Nicest professor Ive ever had. Clear expectations and fair grader. Easy to do well with him as your prof
Okay prof, hard to hear and understand, but the exams are fair and he marks super light, bless him.

Hard to pay attention during the lectures, makes multiple mistakes in his lecture slides and basically just reads off of them. He doesn't know what he's doing most of the time when doing practice examples, and it just ends up confusing you. Labs were god awful and vague as well, but were graded easily. You won't learn a thing, you might pass though
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Cute old man, very caring. Gives good exam/midterm reviews. Easy to get an A, just study his reviews.
Easygoing, nuff said
Amazing prof, he goes straight to the point. You don't need to attend classes, he posts everything. YOU MUST GO TO MIDTERM/ EXAM REVIEWS, he basically tells you everything on the test.
Best prof that I have had for any materials course, screw the other prof
Easily my favourite professor at Uottawa, 100% recommend :)

I took ARB2912 but the website is not letting me choose it for some reason. However, she is an amazing instructor who puts in the effort when teaching the course and wants her students to succeed. I highly recommend enrolling in her classes as they're interactive and very beneficial!
LOVE HER! Content is easy to understand, and homework isn't time consuming. If you're reading this, make sure to download the textbook on Anna's Archive for free!!!

She is caring and an easy grader. There is a group project to do, but it's easy. She gives free points by attending class. You need the textbook to do practice questions in class, but they're easy. I recommend her because she's not out there to crush you and she helps you substantially and if you put effort, you'll get good grades.
Amazing

Words cannot describe how amazing she is. This is usually the case with Arab professors who teach Arabic culture / language. Very kind and caring, actually listens to students and what they want. The course is super easy and fun, you don't need to know the lecture content to do the final project which replaces a final exam. No stress whatsoever

Knowledgable, accommodating, and engaging. Course was very straightforward: weekly tests (3-5 questions) which were easy, attendance + participation marks, and a group project which she marked generously. Highly recommend the professor as she teaches more courses in the department too!
Best prof I've ever had. If you're looking for an easy A+ this prof is the one to go to. She's awesome!
easily the best professor I had during my time at university. also a very easy course for an A+ I think I ended the course with over 100 because she even offered a chance for 5% bonus
Amazing prof! Without a background in arabic I was able to understand.

This was my second time with Prof. Kawalit and I absolutely LOVE her! She is very kind and obviously cares about her students. Homework assignments were mandatory, but just marked by whether or not you did them. The format was very difficult this year (Adobe Connect), so if you have a virtual class, make sure to study more throughout the semester.
Super sweet and helpful. Very good teacher. She wants students to succeed and gives so many opportunities for u to do well. Learned a lot of Arabic with her.

Dr. Kawalit is legit the best prof at uOttawa, no joke. I'm taking my third course with her and she's just amazing! Teaches well, cares for students, likes to have discussions, and all that good stuff. She makes content really interesting. If you have a space for an elective, take any class with her!

Prof. Kawalit was my best professor this year, hands-down. Her lessons were engaging, she truly cared about us, and she simplified difficult concepts. I went into the past semester with virtually no knowledge of Arabic and came out prepared for my next Arabic course. I am forever grateful to this prof and her delightful class.

Take any class you can with her! She's so kind and caring and really tries to help everyone out. Sometimes the instructions may be a little unclear but once she clarifies you realize how simply it really is. ARB2101 was an elective for me and I don't regret taking it at all in fact, any other class she teaches I would definitely take!

At first it was tough to understand her, but you get used to her lectures. Midterm is a group presentation, very easy marks, the 30% of the year are 5 Brightspace quizes done at home. She is very carrying if you go ask her questions on person. Very nice prof.

One of the most amazing professors I have ever had in my life. She is so caring and so patient. The way she conveys information is flawless and so easy to retain. She is a fair marker and she gives you points wherever she can, because she genuinely wants her students to do well. This professor is a treat.

Fantastic professor. Conveys the class material in a very clear and concise way. She is very creative, vibrant and positive. Helps students of any origin speak and understand all information in Arabic in class. Is very respectful and is definitely one of my favorite professors in the Arabic department!

Professor Ayandé is kind and genuinely cares about his students. He's always willing to meet outside class to address concerns and share any feedback. I learned the importance of attending and participating in class to get the most out of it. His vast knowledge and the research skills I gained are invaluable, especially for those pursuing academia.
Fantastic professor. Very understanding and helpful to his students. If you are committed and interested in his course, it's a very rewarding experience.

This professor is truly one of the nicest, most caring, thoughtful professors I have had in my 3 years of being a university student. I highly recommend taking his entrepreneurship  class even if you're not a Telfer student ( being a communications student) I learned a lot and it really does set you in life to be more creative and hands on!
The class taught me a lot in Entrepreneurship and was enjoyable to take. The teacher was helpful and was easy to ask questions.

While I appreciate his passion about the subject, the deliverables for this class were very unclear. The class had to ask and clarify what was expected for each report, resulting in myself being even more confused. This made the class very frustrating. 

The interactive presentations were good for understanding course content and were engaging.
Un bon Prof ! J'ai aimé son cours et surtout sa façon d'amener les sujets à l'étude.
Cours captivant et le prof est vraiment bon dans son sujet.

reviews.comment: Good prof!

reviews.comment: Pire prof !!Il s'attend à ce qu'on fasse des lectures de 10+ pages chaque sem mais ne donne pas un cours de qualité. Il interrompt les pendant les présentations, n'écoute pas et s'attarde sur des détails inutiles. Lui même ne fait pas ses propres lectures et n'a jamais rien de positif à dire sur les travaux. rapport de 30 pages à faire….
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Le prof le plus confus que j'ai jamais eu, il se contredit et se fâche si tu lui pose des questions auxquelles il sait pas répondre. Quand 3/4 de ta classe n'a pas compris et n'ose plus poser des questions, c'est le prof qui a un problème. Il pense que faire peur est pédagogique et donne de mauvaises notes.

Explications vagues et imprécises, sur tout: organisation du cours, programmation des présentations orales, contenu enseignés. Évaluation arbitraire: n'utilise pas sa grille de correction, commentaires très généraux qui ne justifient pas la note accordée. Très condescendant et toujours sur la défensive. Menace si des questions incommodes.

Ce professeur, je ne sais pas si c'est un problème d'ego ou autre chose, mais on a toujours l'impression qu'il est en compétition avec nous. Les commentaires sur nos présentations n'étaient pas du tout structurés. Rien n'est jamais suffisant à ses yeux. Il se focuse uniqument sur les points negatifs.
Excellent course and a great Professor. Good success in your your academic career. Thank you for a great session!

A good Professor, he knows very well his subject matter and takes time to explain the details of what he's teaching. He makes you get prepared for the quizzes, assignments and midterm by telling you what to study. For sure, I would love to take another one of his classes. This was a nice learning experience!
Very good Prof.
An excellent professor who knows very well his subject matter. For me this was a wonderful experience. I will recommend you this course.
A very good professor

C'est le professeur le plus inutile et le plus nul que j'aie jamais eu. Ses examens sont complètement arbitraires et comprennent de nombreuses questions qu'il n'a jamais abordées en classe. C'est du n'importe quoi. Ses critères sont ambigus et le feedback est inutile. Il est incroyablement désorganisé et peu accommodant. À éviter à tout prix.

Évitez ce prof à tout prix. Ses examens ne sont pas du tout bien structurées, c'est du gros n'importe quoi. Il duplique plusieurs questions, il y a des fautes partout. Il y a certaines questions auxquelles on ne peut même pas répondre... C'est impossible d'avoir une bonne note dans ses examens.

C'est la première fois que je déconseille un professeur à ce point. Il n'y a pas de cours. Les étudiants font des présentations sur les 300 pages à lire dans la semaine et cela fait office de cours. Il ne donne pas de rétroaction claire sur les notes et se perd dans ses "explications". À EVITER À TOUT PRX !

This prof is probably the worst prof I've ever had. His exams are awful, they do not reflect anything we learned. Some multiple choice that says choose all that apply. Very awful prof. Goes through the slides in 10 minutes and the rest of the time he's kind of just babbling. DO NOT take this prof.

Prof Lewis made 3hr lectures fly by quickly! Her lectures were easy to follow and she is super funny. Assignments were not super hard, she was easily accessible outside of class and she gave great feedback!

Honestly, Professor Lewis is pretty good. The short stories and books chosen are pretty cool and interesting. You're assesed on weekly one-pagers, a debate assignment/ mid-term, an essay, and a final exam + free 10% for participation in the dgds. She's also quite funny and has a great personality. Would take again for sure.
I like the energy of prof Lewis. I like the way she communicates. She is a simple person and easy to deal with.

I took Prof. Lewis's ENG 1120 class last year, I really liked her, but she rarely showed up. We hardly ever had Monday classes, which would be her lecture periods, and Wednesday would be group discussions. It was my fault that I failed this class, but she failed me by 4%, so I'm pretty upset she didn't let me make it up or give me a chance.

Professor Lewis is an amazing instructor. She is caring, understanding and extremely passionate about her material. This was the first English class I enjoyed since the books she used are easy to read and relevant to today's society. She also gives ten percent for participation in group discussions. Take this if English isn't your best subject.

The favourite teacher I have ever had. 
Unlike many teacher she sounded interested in what she was teaching and the material was fun. She took the time to talk to her students and form a connection

Very caring and smart. She's funny and gets to know her students well. Not a hard marker I would say fair and totally possible to get an A. She is very refreshing and easy to understand in lectures. I really enjoyed the class. One page of writing a week tho but not hard writing mostly. She is also very understanding & answers emails. I recommend.
Absolutely amazing prof!! She truly cares about all her students and is very enthusiastic when she teaches. A real gem of a prof at uOttawa.
She's an awful teacher, I reccomend you do not take her. She's very confusing and doesn't care about her students.
Ms Potter seems over her head teaching undergrad, she would be better grad professor she gets off topic and can be confusing but she is easy, as long as you talk to her you will get an A
She's the worst teacher I've ever had on this campus.
She is very kind, very helpful and she definitely knows  what she is talking about. She's competent. I find her to be a little fidgety but no serious complaints!
one of the best in york!! Love her~

Really nice professor. I was in quite a small class so my view is going to be skewed but she made sure everyone understood the content and was very easygoing with assignments and got to know everybody.

The deadlines, for the most part, were rather loose. There were lexiques that we had to hand in, and I handed mine in a week late and got full marks, as did other students.
There was a lot of participation, presentations, and group projects, but the class is small and everyone worked, so it wasn't stressful.
The prof is really nice and supportive.

Andrea is the best prof I've ever had. she truly cares about her students and made time after class for questions. one negative is that she took a while to give back grades but i would still recommend her!
hands down the best prof i have ever had

She is a kind professor, but if you are looking to get feedback for your work and improve your french, this may not be the course for that. It is REALLY difficult to reach her through email (hardly replies), and when asking her for feedback, she gives super simple answers. As for her evals, you don't get feedback for them either.

Dr. Vinet was a very kind teacher in class - she made sure that everybody was on the right page with what to do, since her class has a lot of small projects to work on. I found that she wasn't very easy to get a hold of outside of class over email, or by booking an appointment, but you can always catch her after class to ask a quick question.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: She's an easy marker and is really nice.
She is a great prof, and helps a lot for me to continue to learn french in uottawa, it was a really great start and hopefully she could teach me again!!!!!!
She is a great prof with clear grading criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: In her class you will be able to learn the French language in a positive, fun atmosphere. She is really kind to all her students.

She was my favorite FLS prof I've had thus far at the university. As long as you're making effort and participating in class, she will recognize your hard work and give you a good grade. It's easy to participate in her class as well because she's very engaging and loves her students. I love this prof so much TAKE HER CLASS!!!

She is one of my favorite professors! Andrea made classes lots of fun. She taught a lot as well. I love talking with her after classes. She explains stuff really good and she will use lots of examples until you really understand it. I recommend her class 100%

She is the best, 100% recommend her to anyone who's looking to take a helper course for their classes in French. Real gem, super accessible outside of class, and because the class size is so small, you develop a great relationship with the prof and the students.
Very kind. Super easy class, small size which makes it easy for discussion. If you go to class and do the work you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Fantastic prof!! Participate in class, do your share in group projects, and do the small assignments, and you'll get a good grade, guaranteed.

Super enthusiastic, funny, and friendly. Def rec. Makes FLS enjoyable and her projects have minimal instructions which makes it really easy to succeed in and be creative (extra marks for that). Very easy class for extroverts, might be a little tougher for people that are shy or don't enjoy group projects .. but it is an ORAL discussion class sooo

Great prof. The course is an easy A if you do the homework but I feel like I learned a lot about French pronunciation. My skill has improved greatly. She cares about your learning and your grade and even customizes the course somewhat to each student.
