She builds a lot of grade forgiveness into the class.

Bonnie Schroeder needs to be removed from the Fisher staff. At least in the capacity she currently teaches in. I could see how she may not be as terrible for statisticians/math majors, but she cannot relate to low level statistics students comprehension. The material is already difficult enough as is. We as students need to take action against her.
Extremely difficult, mandatory attendance, yet completely useless. I guessed my way through this class. Thank god for the extra credit.

The class is standardized, so I don't know if another professor would've helped. 40 EC points from HW and extra 10 from info sheet and volunteering available (do if you want to pass). Group project are very confusing so ask TAs for help. Heavily relies on statcrunch but can't use for exams. Able to use note sheet for exams but only helps so much.

2 section tests that you were able to use your online resources. This helps you understand the material throughout the year but not when it comes to exam time, where you have to teach everything you learned a different way. Extra credit helps. Would have failed with out it. A great professor would have changed my outlook on this class. Never again

This class is unnecessarily hard. My biggest advice is to get an early start on the 3 case studies because if you wait- you'll be sitting in office hours surrounded by 50+ equally confused classmates. The case studies are graded super harshly but TAs help out a lot. The HW is also very hard but is extra credit. Go to lecture & recitation for pts!

This professor is awful. For the group case, one of her files shows that we should put the page with our signature as the FIRST page. However, another file requires us to use it as the LAST page. She can never go through all of her slides in class (she got 30 slides but she just talked about 20 of them). Don't choose her as your professor, RUN!

Avoid this professor at all costs. If you're teaching hard material, then you should try to help your students as much as possible, not leave them hanging before exams that make up a large portion of your grade. This class is so disorganized and chaotic. Terrible all-around.

Recitation class, she is one of the worst lecturers. If you did not like 1430 it will be a struggle. Just try to take Draper, there is not enough space in this review to complain well enough.

I will say if she still has "optional homework" DO IT, that is the curve, there is no curve.

All of the assignments are graded tough

Overall, this was an unnecessarily difficult course. You'll need to know how to utilize Stat Crunch and Excel for most assignments but the exams are entirely paper and pencil. I would recommend completing any extra credit and optional work as lecture videos and lecture itself provide very few examples, which is my main complaint with this class.

Horrible professor. Anyone who says the reviews here are overexaggerated, are simply lying to you. This class is only 3 credit hours, but trust me when I saw this: Treat it like a 4 or 5 credit hour class. The average student will need to dedicated at least 12-15 hours/week outside of class to at least get a C.

Easily the worst professor in Fisher. She adds so many extra steps to this class. This class is already difficult, but she makes it more so.

I was a 4.0 student up until I had her. If CSCC still offered this class, I would've taken it there. Sadly, she was the only available option to me at OSU.

Students were doing fine with recorded lectures by other teachers. The act of making class attendance mandatory went against what she declares in syllabus; you cant trust this class structure. Would definitely recommend terry klinker over her anyday.

This class expects you to teach yourself advanced statistics in itself. There is mandatory attendance, group cases, and weekly homework on statcrunch, whereas you can't use statcrunch on exams. Don't miss any extra credit opportunities. A very difficult class.

Never seen such a bad professor. Students did not understand her lectures in class and had to watch the videos when they got home. But she then canceled posting videos on the Carmen made by other teachers because of less attendance. Then, my grade gradually went down to C.

I don't understand how Bonnie is rude to students like others say, she seems like a nice lady. She gives a fair amount of extra credit which really helps because this class is pretty tough. But, Bonnie is an EXTREMELY boring lecturer, especially in her lecture videos. It is nearly impossible to learn anything from her lectures.
Hard project

This professor is very poor. Honestly the worst professor I have had since being at Ohio State. She swears that the reviews on RMP are not accurate, although I believe the fact she even tries to argue against them shows how bad she is. I only have 350 words so I will sum her up as being a rude, very non-motivating professor. Does not belong at OSU.

To be honest, Bonnie doesn't know what she is doing in lectures. Let alone the course curriculum is ridiculous in teaching the pre-technology methods of analyzing the data. It is disappointing to see a such high-rank school as the Ohio State business department is yet outdated and insufficient. Ohio State needs better professors.

Very unorganized class. The weekly structure they use doesn't line up with any other class I have ever taken. Weird due dates, weird weekly schedule, and confusing class. Other than that, Bonnie does a decent job with her lectures and she gives a large amount of extra credit which definitely helps. Be ready to be confused though, not super fun.

The class is hard and she teaches mainly how to do the stats work via online but tests are by hand on paper, so difficult to do well sometimes. If u put in the work and ask questions you can get an A.  She is very kind and wants you to do well. She will help you with the group cases and offers ALOT of extra credit. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT.

class is booty cheeks - which also describes bonnie. the teacher needs to retire she is so bad. I retook the class at another college and learned SO MUCH MORE than with bonnie's teaching. the class is solely based on learning by yourself. TA's - cheeks. Lectures - cheeks. Bonnie - cheeks. in the end, she need sum milk and retire.
Probably the most difficult class I've taken and unorganized too.  She does give extra credit if you attend class however.

awful at teaching. when i took her class, she would barely do the math problems - just talk over them.  This is an awful way for visual learners to learn MATH - let alone stats. . this made the class 100x harder - even going to some of the TA sessions with her did not help me. Avoid if possible

Honestly I didn't think this class was that hard. Homework is optional but if you do it you get extra credit. If you actually try on the homework you will understand all of the information/topics!!!!! Bonnie as a lecturer was alright but when does anyone actually learn anything in lecture? Do the hw and practice and you will get an A in the class.

This class is quite difficult, especially at the beginning and towards the end, but there is a ton of extra credit opportunities (so do everything you can!). The weekly cadence took me a month to master, but stay on top of everything. Bonnie does care, so go to office hours (hers & the TAs), but I often was just confused on everything.
Great prof, very smart and engaging. I recommend attending class to gain insight into projects/lectures as these things are not always mentioned on Brightspace.
This course was well structured and delivered, making complex concepts accessible and engaging with a strong emphasis on "practical" application.
Very disorganized and doesn't practice what he preaches with regards to pedagogy. I feel like I wasted both my time and money on this course because of his poor leadership skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great prof overall, took the time to get to know me

Super nice and obviously loves his job. Gave us chocolates multiple times throughout the semester for no real reason. Fun and easy assignments and even more fun to be had in his classes. Probably my favorite prof I've had so far at Bishops.

She's a great professor who is passionate about her job and mythology. Her lectures are all pre-recorded and she posts weekly journals/questions. Overall her class is super easy and one of the best asynchronous classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Her lectures are long videos but they were useful for the assignments given. She gives good feedback so make sure to try in her journal questions. Don't let the work pile up, class consisted of weekly journal questions, a critical essay (4-6 pages), and a final exam which are written responses.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I took her class online (asynchronous) and I totally recommend her to get this Gen-Ed out of the way. You have weekly journals, one midterm, one final and one paper. The midterm and final are super easy. You can turn in late assignments and she won't penalize you. This class is an easy A. Just listen to the lectures and do the assignments.

Dr. Burke was a great professor for my Mythology course. She gave great comments to the journal question responses and was very informative. She is very real and non-judgmental. If you need anything literally just reach out and she'll help assist you. She is very passionate about this subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Although the entire class is just lectures (which is hard not to be since it's an online class) it is super easy and interesting. She is very lenient with grading. If you are a day or two late she will not penalize you.

This is my first time taking mythology and learning about the different gods within several myths. She is very passionate about what she teaches, and it was easy for me to understand such complex topics. You really have to watch the lectures because the midterm is based on that. One of the best professors I've ever had.

(Actually HUMN115) Dr. Burke was fine. I mainly wanna use this to explain why you shouldn't take this *class.* The Iliad and the subsequent readings based on it are so needlessly esoteric and complex that this 100 course is really more like a 300 in terms of difficulty. You have to be at a super high level. Do not take if you want something easy.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Prof Burke's class for mythology asynch. Class was extremely easy, very few assignments. only like two major papers, but she is very lenient with grading i think. class as an easy A.

Took the 8 week online program with her and it was an easy A with very light work. 2 tests, 1 essay, and they're both very easy if you watch the PanTop recordings she does. Weekly journals which are INCREDIBLY easy and you don't even have to watch the lectures to answer. Would recommend to get the GenEd out the way.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Burke is passionate about mythology and it is clear to see during her lectures. Sometimes she adds a little too much personal information into her lectures, but I did not really mind. She understands many students are taking mythology for a requirement so she does not expect students to do the weekly readings on their own.

Honestly, a pretty great professor to take online. The online lectures are long but you can listen to lazily while flipping through the powerpoint. Not a ton of work just a journal response every other week and chat groups the opposing weeks. Gives nice feedback no matter the quality of the work and grades easily.

Took this class because it fit into my required curriculum outside my Bio major. Burke is a very chill professor. She genuinely enjoys commentary in class, but doesn't get much participation as 90% of the class goes on their laptops to do other work. Take this class if you need an easy A and aren't afraid to write a few analytical papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is very nice and does not give many assignments. However, there are heavy weekly readers that you have to keep up. They will be on the midterm and final exam. Lectures are boring... need to take notes and stay on top of the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: she is a very nice lady and attendance is not mandatory. only assignments for the semester are three 1o page papers, way to much work for a gned requirement
reviews.rating_tags: SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her lectures are generally incredibly unfocused for this class. Her assignments, readings, and papers are completely irrelevant to the lectures. Her focus and lens that she views the material through is obviously slanted towards a certain field she likes. However, that is completely unrelated to our study of mythology.

She's really cool and laidback. I took this class as an online course and totally looked over the first paper that was due. Instead of docking my grade, she let me hand it in before the weekend despite it being a week late. Her tests are also really easy. As long as you pay attention to the lectures and take notes, it's impossible to fail.

The lectures are really boring at times but if you pay attention and take notes its impossible to not do good. She posts all the powerpoints online and tells you exactly what you need to know for tests. Also only 5 short papers throughout the whole semester. Super easy if you're trying to kill a GNED.
For an online class, she is amazing. She is very understanding and always ready to answer questions. Her feedback is great and she couldn't be any more clearer with her lectures.

One of the best professors at MSU. She knows what she's talking about and makes learning about myth really interesting. She is very down to earth and so nice. Gives you everything you need to know for exams and quizzes. Would definitely recommend her and take her again if i had the chance!!
Great professor overall. Easy assignments and easy tests. Nothing to complain about.

She's a great teacher.  Although it is necessary for you to go to class, if you take the notes she gives on the power points you will pass.  There are five assignments.  Two tests, a project, a term paper, and a final.  It is very simple and she makes it very interesting.  Great person and a good class!

currently taking her online class one assignment, a journal entry a week or a chat online for an hour. interesting conversations in the chat. very open to opinion on religion and is not critical of your views. does not grade down because of certain beliefs. i recommend her for an easy online class. one paper and one test which I didn't get to yet.
Sweetest Woman Ever! Take this class, she is very straight forward with what she expects from her students. <3 She makes the class fun.
Very helpful and lenient. Easy course. Online chats or journals. One paper and one exam. Definitely take this course.
Amazing experience learning with this professor. Definitely recommended, very helpful, understanding and supportive

She does not take attendance. The material seems overwhelming at first but the exams are pretty easy. Everything is open book and open notebook. If you take reasonable notes and print her power points - it's an easy A. 3 equal weight exams and 1 research paper. She responds super fast via e-mail and helpful during office hours.

Bryan is so sweet and genuinely cares about his students. There were multiple assignments in this class which gave many opportunities to raise your mark, but they were never overly stressful. Keep on top of everything and you will do great in his course!

Very chill professor, as long as u put the effort in to do the assignments, you will do well. Make sure to know the grammar well enough for the quizzes, they aren't hard as long as u understand it. Overall, I put a decent amount of effort and I managed to get an A+. It is not very work heavy at all and very manageable with other courses!!
hes such a chill prof

He's really chill, kind and sweet. There are very easy-to-follow recorded grammar lectures to watch and he goes over the related exercises the next class. The early writing assignments progressively build up to the final argumentative research essay, which eases the workload. Lectures are clear and easy to follow, and slides are actually useful.

Cares about his students and is willing to help if you ever are unsure or need more clarification. He responds fast to emails and grades very fairly.I had his class only once a week for 3 hours at a time so it could be heavy some days, but he would always acknowledge long lectures, give breaks, and end classes early if you were done all your work.
He can be repetitive and boring sometimes but overall he is super sweet and will make you approve the course

Prof. Grilli is so chill and sweet. His grammar lessons can be confusing but he goes over them + answers questions. All of his lectures and lessons set you up for success for the final essay. I found that he was an easy marker + didn't provide a lot of feedback, but he has a lot of students. He clearly really cares about teaching and his students.

He is a very chill guy and you can tell he really does care about his students. Sometimes it can get a little bit boring but that is to be expected with an english class. Attendance is not mandatory but like every other english class, there are grammar quizzes and assignments almost every class. Definitely recommend!!

Great Professor. Very chill and lenient with work. Attendance isn't mandatory but there's in class assignments and little quizzes (very easy) so I'd recommend going. He's very fun and tries to make lectures actually useful by reading articles that are relevant to today's world.

Chill guy, can't say anything bad about him. His lectures are usually really short and only last 30-60 minutes. Lot's of in class quizes and assesments so make sure to show up, but they are very easy. Very kind and helpful when you need it. Classes can only get so "fun" for an English class so he is trying his best. I'd recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith was an amazing professor and super engaging during the course! The only assignments there were was 4 in-person written essay quizzes covering material during lectures and in the textbook that he would provide.

Professor Smith is a great teacher and it is clear he is very passionate about what he teaches. If you want to succeed in this class, you need to take notes on the weekly readings. For the quizzes, he gives you an open-response question weeks in advance so you can prepare to respond in class. Fair warning, he doesn't always post chapters promptly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Four quizzes that are 25% each determine your grade. Professor would not be punctual and would release reading assignments and quiz prep on his schedule. Little to no respect for students, everything I learned in this class was from his book which he regularly assigned 120 page readings for the week. Way too comprehensive for an intro class

Dr. Smith's approach to a boring 100-level survey course is sweeping in its breadth and scale. While his class is nominally chronological, he presents a philosophical, non-temporal, meta-narrative of power. Smith's lectures are eloquent forays into debates on the origins of homo sapiens, consciousness, the scientific revolution and modern academia.

He likes to talk about his own book and accomplishments. I would've liked to hear about other people's contributions to the field. He cannot handle being challenged. Also, getting him to honor approved accommodations is like pulling teeth from a lion. Good luck!
He uses his own textbook that he wrote. Class is myopic.
He is disrespectful to his students.

First science credit that didn't make me miserable. This class is completely essay based so if that's your thing you'll love this! The teacher is super communicative and nice. Expectations and criteria for projects is very clear. Fair grader.

Genuinely loved this class, and learned so much about archaeology and human history. Textbook is written by him, and was informative, easy to read, and super interesting (no cost too). Short weekly essays based on the reading, no exams! I would absolutely recommend this professor, and I look forward to taking his other courses. 10/10

This class is pretty much straight to the point, you read a bunch of chapters and summarize them the way he wants you to. Nothing more nothing less. If you need a sweat free lab this is the route to go.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There were 3 quizzes and 5 essays across the 8 week term. Each essay was about 600 words minimum and the quizzes had about 15 mult choice q's if there was a quiz. There are 13 chapters that he assigned from HIS OWN WRITTEN textbook, which is nice because he knows it well, and its free. Cameron is extremely passionate, so that's great! Bit hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: it was a little sketchy that we had to get the textbook he wrote, but he very obviously puts a lot of time into it. he even updates it consistently. we had a multiple choice quiz or essay due every week, but they were relatively easy as long as you read the chapter associated with it. he was very easy to reach and super understanding!

Professor Smith is very easy-going and lenient with due dates. His textbook is very cheap compared to other textbooks. Not the most interesting class, but I would recommend it since it gets the job done.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I wasn't so sure about Dr. Smith at first, I get a weird vibe from professors who write and require their own textbooks.. that the student has to pay for. BUT his text book is significantly cheaper than other ANTH books, he's very responsive to emails, lenient with due dates, clear grading, and the assignments are straightforward. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: You have to read the chapter and write a 400-600 word essay each week. The professor gives you the structure of the essay and gives tips on how to write it. He is even flexible with the due date as long as it's not unreasonable. The only way to fail is straight-up not to do the work at all, a great class for any major.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: He grades very easily if you put effort on your essay. The book was easy to read and understand. The Professor is tremendous in many ways. I would take another class with this Professor for sure!
good teacher would take again. hard to reach over email
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Loved this class. Basically you write a 1.5-3 page paper every week on the reading. It's not difficult and very interesting. The teacher is even flexible with due dates which is very nice if you get sick one week or have to concentrate on something else for a day of two. There is no textbook, he uploads the reading for you which is great!

I really liked him and the course a lot. It was straight forward and easy as long as you did the reading and the assignments, no harsh deadlines, no tests at all, just weekly reading and assignments. Some of the readings were pretty long but that's all you had to do all week other than reply to the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took his online ANTH102 class, and it was pretty easy. There was one essay a week (1 to 3 pages), but he allowed you to turn them in late by a few days, since he knows students lives are busy. He graded pretty easy, in my mind. Essays were just out of the textbook, but you don't have to read word for word to do well on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--So many papers

reviews.comment: Nice person. Gives the test questions beforehand and will help you if you email him your answer before test day. Materials arent exciting if youre not interested in anthropology. Textbook isnt necessary; at the end he even steers away from the textbook. Fairly tough grader on essay. Has lecture recordings if you miss class. Good prof overall
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing class! For an online class, the course material is organized and delivered in a way that makes it clear and easy to understand.. Expectations are explained up front so no hidden surprises. All reading is presented in PDF format, so no books to buy, and all the material ties in well together. Take this class you won't be disappointed!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Smith is passionate about archaeology.  Unlike almost all the other professors I have had at PSU, he is clearly actively involved in research and in publishing papers.  He is a very good lecturer.  If I were in his shoes, I wouldn't be nearly as tolerant of irrelevant questions.  He relies heavily on overheads; he should post them on d2l.

They were intro classes so not too intensive but definitely not something you can pass without doing the work and attending class lectures. I liked him because to me he is the quintessential AnthroArchaeology professor. He definitely comes off as a archaeologistanthropologist first and a teacher second, not a bad thing. Also quite the cutie.
Not what I expected at all, he's super nice and funny but it seems like more of an hour long ramble than anything. I wouldn't recommend unless it's directly related to your major.
Really nice guy, super passionate about anthropology, and interested in helping his students. If you aren't passionate about the subject, however, the class is very dull.

Dr. Smith is a devoted professor and archaeologist, this introductory class was easy and insightful. He made the subject exciting and interesting, and he was always more than willing to meet with students during office hours. He provides exam questions a week before, and they are in essay format. Grades were based on three exams.

Very passionate about anthropology and primates. If you don't share those passions, skip this class. Lectures were borderline unbearable. Gives you test questions ahead of time, but they are usually on topics not thoroughly covered in class. Be prepared for a lot of self-study and internet trolling. Really nice guy, though.

A great teacher and a surprisingly talented artist. Friendly and composed. He made his students laugh a lot. He tells you exactly what will be on exams (all essay form) and even drops the lowest grade. Gives good feedback and seems to be well organized.

The general consensus is that he's passionate about his field, and that is an understatement. He has a tendency to get a little ahead of himself when he gets pumped. Be prepared for a lot of self learning. He will iterate some points of the text and will walk you through most of it but you need to do the reading. And he's quite easy on the eyes.

Great and passionate professor. Knows his stuff and wants you to succeed. The only thing is he isn't so good about getting papers back to you in a timely manner.. There was one map quiz, an article review, a midterm, and a 8-10 page final paper.
Good guy, interested in topic and it shows. He really wants to teach an in-depth early hominid's class, and this also shows. Worth taking classes from.
Top notch.  Great lectures, highly involved, good sense of humor, helpful.

Cameron was my first teacher at PSU, I took his freshman inquiry class on anthropology. His instructions were clear, his lectures were engaging and I gained a genuine interest in anthropology after taking his class.

Tells you the questions on the midterm ahead of time. 3 fairly easy writing assignments and one 8-10 page research paper..I quote this man: "I'm not in the business of ruining people's graduate school prospect because of something like a midterm"

I had him twice. His syllabus was the exact same for both classes.  Lectures were exact same too.  He tells you what is on the test beforehand, but his expectations for the class are unclear.  Disorganized lectures, assignments, and overall class.  Passionate about the subject so if you are an anth major you're in luck.  Rarely returns email.

Smith is so cool! He's willing to help students out and his assignments are very fair. When he has tests, he tells you ahead of time exactly what's going to be on them. And if you feel like you deserve a higher grade, he'll let you argue your case and change it for you. I love this professor. I'm going to take as many of his classes as possible!
I love this teacher, I felt no stress when attending his class. And I'm just taking another class of him right now.
You can tell he's passionate about his field, but he's a little on the scatterbrained side. I didn't turn in half the assignments and got an A, so no complaints.
Very good teacher! passionate about arch, and makes it interesting.

Very knowledgeable/elaborate and passionate about subject; offers many opportunities to get involved in archaeology department; involves class in discussions; many different mediums of expressing subject (overhead slides, bones, video); straightforward but thought-requiring tests; good sense of humor and very approachable; few simple assignments
very passionate about the course.  lectures are comprehensible.  highly recommended.  you'll feel what i'm stating. hurry before his class gets packed!
he knows what is talking about and gives several examples if you don't understand.

He's nice, his lecture material is interesting, he's really interested in his subject, and the difficulty is pretty average.  I've taken two classes from him, and I would take another.  He's also cute!

He really seemed to be passionate about the subject.  This class was great for the first couple of weeks then he started forgetting what he had already taught and would repeat lectures several times.  He also kept losing people's papers and forgetting to give us the handouts to our hw. He was disorganized but still very passionate about the subject

I loved his class.  He was so passionate and knowledgeable about archaeology.  I already loved the subject, and he only made me love it more.  He was a great professor.  I would take another class from him anytime, and I plan to do so at the next opportunity.
No Comments

I took Intro to Archaeology over summer term. If you do not find evolution, cultural studies, or archaeological information interesting DON'T take the class, it'll be boring for you. It can be tedious. All in all he is an awesome teacher, he is really passionate about his field of work. He tries to squeeze as much info as possible into his course.
Love Carlos. Friendly, helpful and realistic about expectations for the class. Also an awesome photographer. Highly recommend this class!
Quizzes and assignments are tough, and the lectures are very boring. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS !!!
Nice professor. She looks serious but I think she cares about classmates.

reviews.comment: ESL 2361 should be a light course but she is giving a lot of homework and assignments. It's good for practice however the course I took (other English courses) in the fall term is less courseload than this. This class is also boring too.
There are many homework and assignments in the class. She sometime gives you feedback as well. However, I dont like she always mandatory students to turn on their web cam.

reviews.comment: Worst professor. Grading criteria are very vague and have many quizzes that are not even helpful for learning. You will get some feedback about the assignment, but they are very dry. Avoid if you have other choices.
Although she looks unfriendly at the first time, she is a nice professor actually. She cares about the students. She will answer your question patiently if you ask her.

reviews.comment: Worst professor that i've seen in my life. She didnt give feedback to us. Quizzes are difficult even though you have done the preparation. There is lack of interaction in the class. It is also mandatory to turn on the camera during the lesson. She will show her impatient face to the student when the student is asking a little bit more questions.

Very nice lady. She does not seem nice when u first met her but u will find she's pretty cute after few lectures. Classes are kinda boring but u can definetely learn things from her well-organized lectures. We do grammer test and the grading criteria is tough, u should read the textbook and finish the grammer exercises then u'll get good grades.

This class is interesting because it teaches you good skills to write and read in english but can also be boring because there is no oral interaction. The professor looks like unfriendly but she is nice if you study and do your homework. You have to read a lot, homework is heavy but it permits you to pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Her class is kind of boring, but you certainly can learn  stuff.  She barely smiles but she does have a soft heart and is willing to answer all of your questions. Her quizes are easy but sometimes you will not have enough time to finish. However, her final is very fair and easy for students to get a good mark. Overall, she is a good professor !
she is good

She looks unfriendly to students but she will let everyone in her class pass the course. She is a very nice lady and will always give you at least a B to let you pass ESL as long as you finish all in-class assignments and journals.
Never gives appropriate feedback, the final exam was nothing like what she said or what we did during the whole semester, if you have another choice don't take her class

She is unorganized, VERY BLUNT and condescending, you never know if she is laughing with you or laughing at you. All in all, if you're expecting to get an education you paid for do NOT take Catherine Buchanans course. She cancelled SEVEN OF OUR CLASSES FOR WORK PERIODS… YEAH WORK PERIODS FOR A 3 PAGE GROUP ASSIGNMENT!!! WTF this is university!!!

Prof. Buchanan is a very good prof. Sometimes she can forget the names of her students... but besides that she taught a good course. There are several group projects and participation is necessary. You are graded on your participation throughout the semester (10%), so if you engage frequently its easy marks. We did not read a full book, only texts

Hands down, one of the worst professors and teachers I had in my entire life. Be aware of taking any course with this professor. She changes modes faster than the speed of light, has unclear grading criteria, near impossible to get an A+ in her assignments. If you did take her course, ask the faculty immediately for re-grading requests.

Prof. Buchanan was super nice, funny, and made the lectures interesting. I will say that it can be sometimes unclear what she's asking for on assignments, but she is happy to clear up any misconceptions. As long as you check over your assignments for grammar and clear/concise answers, you should do well!

For a class that is literally called "reading better in French" there is surprisingly little reading and a massive amount of group work... I don't understand the positive reviews here. I did okay through her course last year but the professor is frustrating in her feedback and while nice, she can sometimes change moods faster than the wind.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Literally the BEST french prof ever. The class honestly felt like a family and her feedback was amazing. We had the choice to do the exam or not. Even though it seems like she was just easy, she made us work, and my french greatly improved. I would recommend taking a class with her a thousand times over, I do not understand the bad reviews.
Harsh Grader and participation heavy.

The professor is very much a tough grader and regularly makes unnecessary grading criteria. It does not matter if you put 10 hours of work into a 2-hour assignment and even have it looked over by an actual Francophone AND a French studies major. It feels like you cannot achieve high grades in this class no matter your effort...
Professor refuses to change grades or even consider changing them and believes that University does not allow contestation of grades despite uottawa bylaw 10.3....
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Buchanan at her best makes her lectures enjoyable and fairly easy going. But many times she can be quite loud and frankly blunt to an almost insulting degree. Her feedback is often times lackluster and she is also obsessed with students buying/using the Antidote grammar corrector and does not believe even if you do use it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This is undeniably the worst professor I've had in my 4 years of undergrad. She paints a picture that she cares for her students but is quite the opposite. She never attends office hours and is extremely unorganized. My entire class was confused by her instructions. If you can avoid taking her class, I highly recommended doing so.

I really liked this professor. Makes you work for grades and gives you valuable feedback both when reading and writing. Was disappointed with my first grade, had a meeting with her and after highlighting what I could do better/ my strengths I aced everything from there on out. I would take another class with her but she's not for shy people.

THE BEST PROF EVER!!!!! She will make you love french, unlike so many other profs I have had. She is funny, SUPER engaging, she cares about her students. I literally can't say a single bad thing about this prof. SHE IS A GEM!! Please take her class, you will not regret it.

Professor Buchanan is unclear about her expectations on assignments, then gives zeros when the formatting is incorrect. This was not just an issue for me, considering she sent a mass email to the class refusing to change any marks since so many students were justifiably upset. Never experienced anything like this at UOttawa before

She is one of the best profs I've ever had. She is so sweet and very clear on her expectations. I have taken her classes many times and wish they could've all been with her. (Note: don't be shy in FLS though as practicing is how you improve. And Buchanan knows this)

Prof. Buchanan was by far the best prof I have every had at the university of Ottawa. she is extremely engaging and makes everyone feel as comfortable as possible during her classes. I am now taking another course with her this semester (FLS3571) since she was so great in FLS2741. She is extremely clear with expectations and will always prepare you

Loved her as a prof, I never minded going to class. She goes at a great pace that assures all are on the same understanding. Participation matters, she includes everybody in her lectures. There is a good amount of homework and some readings are difficult but she is very helpful!

Best FLS prof I've had so far. She's a pretty easy marker for homework and the midterms. She makes sure everyone participates and will call on people about assigned questions. There's quite a bit of work towards the end, with numerous projects on the same day, but you have all semester to prepare, so it's not too bad.

The best FLS prof I've ever had by far! She's super engaging and not only wants you to succeed but she wants you to improve and learn new things (academic + cultural). She's a fair marker so the course isn't an easy A with eyes closed, you have to put in work, which is very different from most FLS classes but way better bc u learn rly useful skills

She is by far the best FLS prof I've ever had. She gets you to participate without completely putting you on the spot and she is hilarious! This has been one of the least stressful classes I've ever taken and it was super easy. She also picked really interesting topics so this class never got boring, even for an 8:30 on a Monday

Professor Buchanan is one of the best profs I have had at the University of Ottawa. She is extremely engaging, funny, and genuinely cares about her students. Her classes are always enjoyable and if you follow the rubrics for assignments you will find it easy to do well. Can't say enough good things about her.

Pf. Buchanan was a very caring teacher. She is a tough marker and has high standards but if you work hard and go to CARTU to get help when needed, you won't have a problem acing the class. The midterms were pretty easy and classes were always engaging and fun! Be polite to her, participate in class, do your homework and you'll do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: This prof i great! She was approachable and I knew what her expectations were for the class. If you don't use Antidote, she won't accept written work, so make sure to use it for any assignments you hand in. Overall nice person who wants her students to succeed.

Absolutely loved Catherine Buchanan and would 100% recommend to any student who's taking FLS courses. She genuinely cared about her students and made the course material interesting. Definitely, would take another one of her courses.

Prof. Buchanan is a very sweet woman, and is clear about what she expects. My French was below the average level of the rest of the class, and at times I felt patronized by her because of it. The class is participation-heavy, but she is really easy-going.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I have literally no idea why anybody recommended her to me. One of the worst profs I have ever had and i normally ace fls courses. Her requirements are very unclear and the majority of the class failed the first assignment! AVOID HER

Loved this prof! She's very understanding when it comes to mental health and is hilarious, always joking around! She loves what she does. Assignments are somewhat difficult, DO NOT WAIT TO THE LAST MINUTE I SPEAK FROM EXPERIENCE. Tests are easy and overall a good atmosphere.

Alright prof but can be very energetic one class and completely silent the next. Little respect for personal space and very loud. Insane amounts of assignments sometime 3 or 4 per week and extremely tough grader. Would not recommend this course for a person who is shy

Had her for a French class, found that she was rude often unhelpful, and though it says not to write it, she did pick favourites. In a class of approx. 15 students she didn't know my name by the end of the term regardless of participation. Textbook is not worth the buy, used less than 10 times. Uses personal opin .when marking vs. effectiveness.

She's equivocal: sometimes she's very quiet and supportive, and other times she's very loud and intimidating. She's also very blunt, which can make it difficult to approach her and ask for help. She'll help if you do ask, though, which is nice. Her volumetone me uncomfortable, though. Weekly assignments (1-2)+oral presentation + midterm & 2 finals

I really like her as a person, but I found the class quite difficult and sometimes hard to follow. But she will help you if you ask for it. Just make sure to really pay attention and participate.  If you're really shy, this class is not for you.
She is phenomenal. Very kind and genuinely cares about her students. Someone who was born to teach, I think. She is also very funny and encouraging.
Absolutely fantastic!!!!!!!! I highly recommend her!!!!
This professor is fantastic. Tests can be hard, but she is a fair marker overall. Classes are fun and engaging. It was a pleasure taking her class. Definitely recommend!
She is super nice and very relaxed. She is a little nutty but that's what makes the class fun! Time spent in class is amusing and easy, but she can be a hard marker for tests and assignments.

Such a sweetheart. Really clear in what she wants, gives you good grades, just participate and she will love you. So energetic, which is awesome when what you're learning seems kind of useless, but you have to practice your french somehow.

Mme. Buchanan is a very kind caring professor! She is very approachable and assist you if you are having trouble with anything. Very fair marker and  in order to do well in her class, make sure you have the work done even though she does not check if you do it or not! Highly recommended as a professor! I would love to have her again! Merci Madame!

Mme Buchanan is incredibly sweet and funny. She is a great prof, and conveys the subject matter well, and she is also really understanding. She's a fair marker, and is willing to go over your exam if you disagree with a mark.
Great prof! She is very caring, and really loves to teach! Put in the effort and you'll do very well.
Best. Prof. Ever. She is such a personable lady and is an absolute joy to be around. She sincerely cares about her students.
Great prof!! Very helpful and she tries really hard (and succeeds!) in making the class relevant and interesting. Do the work, know her expectations and everything goes well.
Amazing professor. Willing to help and wants students to do well.

Had her for a helper class for geography and absolutely loved her! Extremely friendly and wants you to do well. Great teacher, fair tests, and manages to make what could be a pretty boring class interesting. Would definitely recommend her!
Best prof EVER! Participate in class/do homework and you will get an easy A!

I had her for the FLS helper course for a Geography class. She's extremely personable and nice, but one thing that rubbed me the wrong way is that she didn't show up to a couple of the GEG lectures because she felt she "already knew the material enough", which is a little bit neglectful. Fair tests, entertaining classes overall
great prof, but be prepared to learn and listen in clas.

Great person, very unclear prof. Tries to explain material but if you don't get it too bad. The textbook was clearer than she was (if you're good at teaching yourself I recommend the text) Tests were extremely hard, did not reflect course material, majority of my class barely passed the midterm. Love to chat over lunch with her but not in class!

Wow, worst professor ever! She is always late, never organised, and isn't clear about what she expects from the class. She may be a nice person, but she is hardly a good prof. avoid taking a class with her if at all possible.

she can be very understanding but at timez not sympathetic...shez a nice and easy teacher...but don't bother asking her what you're supposed to do cause she's jus as lost as u...rite everything she sayz down or u'll b lost the entire semester...if all else failz...the least u can get is an 80
I would highly recommend her as she has made boring grammar lots of fun and she is not judgemental.
Great teacher, really care for her students and very friendly!!!

She's incredibly understanding and approachable. I enjoyed her class a lot. She isn't afraid to have a little fun with things. Her tests were challenging but fair and she's great to talk to. I was intimindated by her on the first day but in the end she turned out to be an awesome prof.

Awesome prof, created a really friendly atmosphere in the class. It was never intimidating to open your mouth for fear of making a mistake...that just added to the fun. Tests were challenging, but fair.
Amazing prof. Good relationship with her students and makes classes entertaining.
No Comments
Awesome prof. Class is fun, she's entertaining, and you learn an amazing amount.
Amazing professor! She was understanding and willing to help however she could. Taking this class was like having a mentor, not a professor who lectures down to you.

Professor Van Vliet is an awesome professor- very sweet and caring and knows ALOT about what she is teaching. Definitely recommend her for Lit & Learning! She really cares about her students and wants them to do well
awesome professor, when you write your papers have her read them before the due date, she fixes everything and then make the corrections and you have yourself an A, dont be stupid and jsut take her

She is amazing. She has helped me a great deal when it comes to my Sociology major.

Prof Kim is an amazing professor. She is very challenging and expects every student to expand their intellectual abilities. Her class has been more valuable than most classes I've taken. She is very intellectual. The class is challenging, but once you get used to what she's looking for, you get the hang of it and it's fine. She is very helpful and always willing to put in extra time to assist you. Great prof.
Prof. Kim is amazing! She is really smart and really pushes students to do their best. You need to work hard, but it's worth it!
conflict and genocide, a good class very difficult and you need to be invested in order to get anything out of it but if you are up for it, its worth it!

Professor Kim was amazing, im not sure why everyone gave her such awful reviews. Yes, its a hard class but you will definitly learn alot and expand a lot of intellectual horizons. She also challenges your own previous thorughts and works hard to constructivly critisize and improve your writing.
Brilliant scholar but disorganized and overly demanding professor.
Nice prerson, not the best professor.

Come on guys, Prof Kim is a really good teacher if you have her really explain things. she's very enthusiastic and helpful if you give her the time of day and actually TRY to think outside the box!
Very hard and isn't clear in expectations.  Has a hard time connecting with students on their level.

she cares about her students and wants them to learn the material. she will help you if you ask and make sure you understand. she does give a lot of work and is a tough grader. but love her anyways!!

Chantal is a great prof. Makes her classes very engaging. The other person probably just got a bad grade

This professor made me hate my life. I would rather eat a book page by page than ever have to deal with her incompetence ever again. She's rude and she doesn't explain requirements of projects. This woman is sharp! I loved her. She takes her time with you if you need help. She is concerned with you, not her paycheck, and that's what I love about her, Hola, la Professora Karam!!!

She is a WONDERFUL teacher! She cares a lot about each and every one of her students and weather or not they learn. I absolutely loved her! If you don't know spanish and want to learn, I suggest taking any class with her. She is wonderful!

Great professor, fair grader.

Dr. Fennell is a great professor. He really wants his students to succeed I took chem 1314 and chem 1515 with him because he makes things understandable. Dr. Fennell was an amazing teacher. Chem is a hard subject, but Dr. Fennell tries to make it as interesting and understandable as possible. I would definitely recommend him as a teacher. I would take a 4th year class with him if he hosted one, 100%.

Would def recommend, super relatable, provides insight on what legal practice looks like in real life. Grading expectations are high but if you show to classes/ office hours, he will guide as needed! Don't take if you can't attend or don't like a challenge. Do take if you want to explore real-life practices for law. One of my fave profs ever.
