reviews.comment: first half of the term you don't need to show up to the lectures because you can easily understand from the slides. Midterm was simple too, but be more precise with your answers(which are on the slides). Second half of the term go to DGDS. overall his class SUCKED and you'll hate every single second of your life in his lecture. good luck!!!

Overall ok, monotone but honestly tries to be engaging. Has a hard time expressing himself in english (stutters, doesnt finish sentence). Reads from slides every class but interesting material. Goes through examples in class. You can tell he cares but hes not the best lecturer. DGDs help alot and hmwrk is mostly clear/easy. Monotone dresser tho :)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: This prof is really nice and filled with good intentions, but can be monotoned. Because his power-points are so complete and heavy, he did not add additional information in class. Therefore, I did not see the need to show up in class, because all the information was in the power-point. This course has a lot of rote learning but pretty fun.

Not a bad guy, just not the best prof. His powerpoints contain the most basic information and leave out the required information to really learn the material. If you just use the textbooks he gives you, they give better info than Gustavo.

I really liked him as a person because he really liked me and was really friendly, but he was not amazing at explaining the concepts. If you're an anglophone like myself, his accent might be a little hard to understand. Overall nice guy but not a great teacher.

I took him for LIN1710 and LIN1720 back to back. Hes a very nice guy, but he mostly reads off the powerpoints which arent always very clear themselves. The instructions on the practical worksheets and take home exams are ambiguous at best. Linguistics is obviously a complicated subject, but he does not convey it well.

He's a very kind prof, passionate about the subject, but isn't rly captivating when teaching (even he said it himself "je suis un peu plate et monotone jle sais"... 4 papers (hw), 1 midterm & final.... linguistics is specific in some fields so he's very picky when grading, gotta have the right term, not even a synonym... Is sometimes unclear

Really bad teacher. His classes are not interesting at all. He only reads the slides, he is not able to properly correct the students homework/exams. Most of the time he can't answer the students questions correctly. GOODLUCK

I had two classes with Gustavo LIN1710 and LIN1720 and it was the worst decision of my life. He is very unclear and marks super hard. if you ask a question in class he will read the answer off his power point slides (which he reads off of each lecture so you may as well teach yourself). The TAs weren't very useful either.

The power points are just heavy, he repeats himself a lot which kinda leads to total confusing. He answers your questions with more questions, and he basically makes you feel like your incompetent when you make him repeat himself during the lectures. Thank god for the TA in that class and the assignments because the exams were impossible...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I had Gustavo for two classes in my first year: Linguistics 1720 and 2720. He is very unclear and goes over complicated concepts quickly. When we don't understand, he says "How!?" and then re-explains it in the exact same way. His powerpoints are so cluttered. I got an A or A+ on every assignment and then somehow failed the exam. Our TA retaught us
Lots of work for sure. Make sure you dont skip classes and go to the DGDs (that saved me!)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Lots of work but make sure you go to the DGDs!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Phono is tough but I really enjoyed prof Beritognolo's teaching and his TA was very helpful. She's funny and caring, she doesn't let you go until you get it!!

His powerpoints are heavy and tests are hard. He seems intimidating in class, but I went to his office hours a few times and was really nice and supportive. DGDs are very important if you want to pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: This prof knows a lot about linguistics but he's not very clear or organized and with the content being quite complex, it gets confusing. But we were allowed cheat sheets on midterms and a couple papers that helped your GPA. He's not the warmest person either. The content is interesting though. Perfect knowledge of French is a must.

He was an okay prof, can sometimes be hard to understand him in class, but that's why you got DGDs and office hours.  Posts his slides on BB. His midterms and TPs are very similar to the content presented at the DGDs, so be sure to go!  Overall, read the slides, do the exercices in the DGDs and you are sure to get a good mark in class.

He was a decent prof, powerpoints were clear. So you don't really have to do the readings. But the lectures were really long and boring. Mostly because the content itself was boring so not his fault. He has an accent too, so if French is not your first language it might be a struggle. The dgds are extremely important!

The best math teacher I've ever had. Seriously, take his class if you want to truly learn. It's challenging, but the way he teaches makes everything click. Plus, he has some of the best shirts of any professor I know.
Very entertaining professor with clear lectures and lots of examples (which is appreciated). Super clear grading criteria too !

Amazing prof, such a funny guy! Even in my 5:30-8 he'd keep me entertained. He does lecture recaps at the start which really help! He's organized with beautiful, easy to follow notes. His tests are super easy as long as you study before hand, and you can bring cheat sheets. He tells you what's on it! All you have to do is practice (he posts lots)!

Very good prof, explains things clearly, gives good feedback, is clearly passionate, nice etc. He posts his notes and they are very clear, organized and well written. He literally tells you what kind of questions are on the midterms and the final. No homework but he gives tones of optional practice problems. Great teacher, highly recommend

LOVE! Such a good prof! I had him for differential equations (his first time teaching it). He was so well organized and knew what he's doing. Super easy to follow in class and notes are clear and understandable. He cracks a few corny math jokes here and there which lightens the mood. All in all take him if you can, he's awesome!
He explains everything super thoroughly and says exactly what is going to be on the midterms/final.
He explains everything super thoroughly and says exactly what is going to be on midterms and the final

Absolutely amazing professor. Explains everything very clearly. Has pre recorded videos on every topic in case you can't make it to a lecture or you don't understand a concept. He also provided a skeleton for the midterms and the exam so you knew exactly what would be on there.

Guy Beaulieu is a very very good prof explains properly , gives midterms skeleton etc. but the only problem is that he is a very tough grader. but i realized this year that you will never find a good prof either he will be ass at teaching or tough grader. but would definitely take him again.

Guy is a great professor who not only knows but explains concepts clearly and also has recorded videos of all lectures (but doesn't post in-class notes as a result). Guy also provided skeletons for midterms and exams so I got away with not having to study some concepts. Would take him again for a future course if I have the chance!
Professor Beaulieu is a great teacher who conveys the course material in a very approachable way
Amazing professor, teaches with passion and his lectures pass by very quickly. Really recommend him!!

Literally the best prof I've ever had. Easy pass if you write your notes in class and pay attention in lecs. Hardest part of it is mobius. 10/10 came to class on Halloween dressed as the count from sesame street

MAT1322, second calculus, is one of the hardest classes an engineer will take. of course he must mark hard and be ruthless (hard course), but he makes it so that if you work hard and put in effort, you will pass the course. very good at teaching, very good assignments for reviewing. allowed a cheat sheet for the midterm and exam. solid professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Worst Math Professor ever. He does not care about students and does not teach with live lectures, instead uses last year's prerecordings. Tests are brutal and ridiculously heavy loads compared to the last in-person exams. I have received A+ in other mathematic courses. This is the first time I ever received a lower grade than a B in a math course.

His first time teaching this course and it shows. Slaughtered us on the 1st midterm, but he pulled it together after that. He delivers the content well, calculus III is all practice. Course moves quickly, the vector calculus portions are probably the most important to know.

Guy Beaulieu est un excellent professeur qui a réussi la transition à l'enseignement en ligne. Les cours sont pré-enregistrés et l'heure de cours est une période de questions. Il est souvent disponible pour discuter en vidéo. Il explique très bien les concepts.

Alors la BIG RESPECT pour ce professeur. Lecture fluide très bonnes explications, il donne des devoirs chaque semaine cela peut paraitre mais c'est le seule cours ou j'étais à jour en plus il vous laisse des "how did i do" et 5 chances de refaire les devoirs. Le prof a bien maitriser la transition en ligne. Il peut meme vous appller pour vous expli

I was told Calc II was gonna be one of the hardest course in my program. Beaulieu's teaching made it manageable. One of the few profs at uni who properly transition to online teaching and landed on his feet.

Best math prof ever. After getting a D+ in calc 1 i kinda started to hate math but guy's lectures are so fun, i started to like calc again! He's a great lecturer and explains things so well! His notes are also so clear and easy to follow. Very approachable and he always give a clear outline of what to expect on tests.

He's not a bad professor per se, but his notes are unnecessarily complicated. If I wanted to learn word for word from the textbook then why would I ever come to class? Prep101 is the only thing that saved my grade. He's a nice guy, and enthusiastic about what he does, it's just that as a student that doesn't really help me at all :(

Best prof I've ever had. If you get the chance, take his class. He's super clear in explanations and his notes are extremely thorough, detailed and easy to comprehend. Evaluations aren't hard if you prepare enough, similar to other profs and previous years.

Dude guy below is the best of the Calc II profs. Lectures ensure you understand all the concepts covered & if not, he's very clear in explaining the question you have. Talks slower when he knows a confusing topic is being discussed to ensure clarity. Swag

Best. Prof. Ever. Not only does he answer emails in under 2 minutes, but also posts all lecture content, worked solutions, DGD questions, their worked solutions, and extra info on Brightspace. He's also super helpful and clear in class.

One of the best teachers I ever had at uOttawa. He explains the concepts very clearly and pick challenging questions from the slides to reinforce the explanation. He also cracks jokes in class, and is real easy-going and approachable. He always tells in advance what parts of the chapters will be tested in the midterms to help students prepare.

WORST math prof. AVOID AT ALL COST. LAZIEST MATH PROF I HAVE EVER SEEN. Takes notes directly from the textbook and uses slides to explain. His way of teaching a math class is horrible and doesn't have office hours And the WORST of all HIS FRENCH IS HORRIBLE. MIDTERMS MULTIPLE CHOICE!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: WORST. No office hours. No reply to e-mails. Useless lectures (copy/pasted from textbook). Exams are all multiple choice -- NOT good (your method may be right, but you'll still get a 0 if you got the wrong number). No calculators! Most students aced the 1st midterm, so he destroyed us in 2nd/3rd midterms... Avoid if you care about your grade!
Just an all around great prof. Very thorough in lectures and gave practice questions with solutions for each of the lectures that filled in any gaps. If you pay attention, you'll do well.

Great lectures and interesting guy. Got tickled on my second midterm yet thoroughly understood the material. Questions are multiple choice a negative sign cost me 16% of my grade. Emailed him in regards to discussing the grading as I thought I was worthy of a better grade yet he never responded to 2 of my emails. Other than that he was good.

Really great prof! He spends a lot of time in class going over the process of solving different problems step-by-step. His notes are super clear and straightforward - he posts them all online! The course itself is not hard if you ask questions right away when you get confused and practice. Enjoyed being in his class!

His in-class examples go very in depth on how to solve the equations step-by-step and he's overall a very caring prof and has a super friendly personality. What made this class hard is the final.. really tough and it's worth 50%
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great prof! He posts all the in class examples, and outlines all test questions.
He is a really good teacher but the notes he uses are not very good so be sure to take your own notes. He is also a beauty
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The lesser of the evils of MAT1332 profs. Going to class not mandatory as all powerpoints are posted online. Midterms were fair and represented the online homework quite well. Exam was super hard but with lots of practice not impossible. All midterms and exams are the same for all students, keep in mind.

He is a great prof! His lectures are different than other math courses as they're on slides, but he spends time going through examples so we can understand step-by-step what he did. He outlines everything on midterms and exams. He also spends time outside the classroom before and after class for extra help. Truly a great guy and a great prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: I disliked his method of teaching off slides and He spends most of the time talking instead of solving problems.

Guy presents the concepts in an organized and straight-forward manner, and includes LOTS of short examples in class that allow you to understand the steps for solving any type of problem. The midterms were fair and the final was pretty easy, as long as you put in the effort throughout the semester to understand everything. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Awesome teacher, the course tho is not awesome. Cal2 is the hardest course I have taken. but if you do your homework and understand it well, you'll probably pass. He is a great teacher, funny and energetic. midterm are really hard so prepare to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Young and enthusiastic prof. Homework reflected the material well and helped me prepare for the tests and final.
Good professor, helpful, undestanding. Evaluations reflect exactly what we saw in class, easy course for those who study and practice.

Best math professor I've ever had. He explains things very well and does in-class examples. The DGD before tests covers everything that will be on the test. He gives 3 tests during the semester which gives you the chance to make up for tests you haven't done well on. Marks fairly and wants you to succeed! Great prof!!
Sucks up to students. Ugh!
Best math teacher I've had at U of O, and very easy on the eyes :-)
One of the best teachers at U of O; has rollerblades which double as shoes
Great professor who values research and science

Dr. Khalil is truly one of a kind, he teaches passionately and wants his students to succeed. Make sure to ask questions as this course is research heavy, and many techniques can be done in numerous ways. His assignments are very helpful for exams as well.

He really cares and takes student's feedback. His midterm was challenging but the final was easier. The assignments were pretty doable as well. He also started rating the slides by how likely the content would be on the final which made studying easier. Definitely a content heavy course so you have to study but a good grade is very feasible.

Hadi is a very kind professor who wants his students to succeed. The course material was a bit challenging but that is the nature of the content. Despite that, this professor provided a lot of resources, and created q&a discussion boards to answer questions about assignments. Just make sure to study in advance and avoid cramming!

Such a great professor! At first, he seemed a bit disorganized and unclear BUT he truly listens to the students and wants you to succeed. His strides in teaching our course improved tremendously because he truly cares for you and your understanding. He explains his topics concisely and answers your questions/doubts! HIGHLY RECOMMEND :))))

Dr. Khalil looks out for his students and regularly take feedback from them. His tests are very fair and provides extra assignments to boost your grade. His slides can be a bit messy but as long as you go to class he explains them well.

Hadi is a great professor, slides provide good context but going to lectures will truly help you understand the content. I believe that the midterms and assignments are very very fair, if you know and understand you will easily do well. I recommend that you stay a little bit after class so you can ask him questions and he answers greatly!

Hadi Khalil has decent content but his way of giving feedback is like when your crush is sending you mixed signals over text. You never seem to know when your questions in class will be answered, your emails will be replied to, or even how your midterm went unless you beg for his attention in the zoom calls. Proceed with care 
🚩

I had a valuable learning experience in Professor Khalil's course. He explains complex concepts clearly and introduces practical applications. He fosters an engaging and friendly atmosphere and goes above and beyond to make sure we understand the slides. His teaching method piqued my interest in healthcare. I highly recommend taking his course!
I love him, hes the best frfr

Just wanna say I think the previous reviews here were fabricated by him. Overall hes not too bad, his slides are vague and explains much more in depth during the lecture. His instructions sometimes are unclear but he always tries to clarify with questions. Not bad but not great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best profs I've ever had! He taught a very difficult course and managed to make it extremely manageable and stress free. He provides all the information you will need in the lecture slides and in class explains everything very clearly. He is the most accommodating prof and truly wants everyone to succeed in and outside of his class.

Dr. Khalil is an engaging and honest professor who cares for the success and wellbeing of his students. He is knowledgeable and passionate, with extensive research experience in the field. He always addressed questions and concerns to the best of his abilities and testable content was clearly indicated beforehand. I'm lucky to have taken his class!

Professor Khalil is an outstanding educator and mentor. His passion and mastery of the subject bring the material to life. He is always supportive, accommodating, and patient, ensuring we understand concepts thoroughly. His personal touch and career advice make him a remarkable professor. Highly recommended!

I've only had one class so far but I've never met a more lost and mean prof in my life. She was yelling at students and kicking them out of class like it was highschool. Her lecture was students yapping for 3 hours about pop culture. I'm scared for the quizzes. Oh and she doesn't answer her emails

If you ever need help in her class all you need to do is ask. She is very helpful and friendly. She is always in an upbeat mood in class which makes it fun to learn, her lectures are pretty long though.

Heather really knows anthropology and so it makes the lectures long just because she loves talking about it, but it's bare able! Make sure you really read and do the study guides because the tests are hard! There are around 2 extra credit opportunities, however I wouldn't rely on those.

She was a very nice professor.  I had no interest in the subject whatsoever so I often found it difficult to pay attention during her lectures.  That might've been just because I had no interest though, she is very passionate about what she does.  Also very understanding.  She clearly wants her students to do well and get a good grade in the class.

She's a sweet lady. Her lectures are interesting and she will help anyone who needs it. Very interested in whether or not her students learn. Wants to get them into Achaeology. Tests are easy, there's extra credit and missing a few classes won't kill you.

Open book quiz and midterm so that's nice. But theyre super hard. So beware. Short term paper. Boring class. Boring material. Textbook is useless so save yourself the money. Be sure to study for final. Don't worry about low grades.. she has a nice curve.

This class was the most boring class I have ever taken in my life. Heather drones on and on and on and on and is super monotone. It was honestly the worst class ever, material wise. It is a pretty easy class but since it is so boring it is hard to pay attention. Don't take with this teacher if you have a choice.

Courses are burdened with lengthy readings and unrealistic expectations for the undergraduate level. Their tendency to reference theories beyond the scope of the course alienates rather than engages students. Nonetheless, Abbot demonstrates expertise in their field and maintains a supportive attitude toward students.

*For ANT3341*
She's nice but I think she's still early in her career and is new to teaching. Some of the readings were a bit philosophically intense compared to other anthropology classes, with a lot of information thrown at once. She's nice if you do talk to her in person though. Review the "right to opacity" before taking the class. Hard grader.

If you like anthropology, Abbot is a terrific professor. She knows her material extremely well and encourages interesting discussions in class. She is very kind and always willing to help out. She gives extremely detailed feedback if asked. Heavy on readings but if you show up to class, you'll be fine. Overall, she's great!

Incredibly tough marking, including "spelling and grammar errors" which aren't actually there in the assignments. Lectures are dry and HEAVY on participation and reading. Concepts are really interesting, so it sucks that she's really not a great prof. Very entrenched in academia, and it feels like she expects students to be too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Don't take this class or this professor. She doesn't have any notes or PowerPoints for like any of the class since all of the learning material is based on presentations done by students. She doesn't teach anything herself and relies on readings and students for teaching material.

Such a sweet prof, very accessible, incredibly knowledgeable. People who complain just underestimated how much they need to study and think this was a bird course. Study smart not hard: she gives hints throughout the term. Show up, take good notes, and review, an A is very possible but this is not a bird course

Honestly a good prof. Exams were a bit difficult, any of the readings and teachings are fair game. But Quizzes were an easy A if you memorized the glossary terms. How well you do in this course is entirely dependent on you. She gives tons of hints during class so show up, read, practice stuff she mentions & you'll be fine. She's very passionate
unless you like anthro, avoid

I wouldn't recommend her ANT 2128 course!! because her teaching during lectures is quite boring and monotone. She does seem nervous which doesn't exude much confidence for us students but beyond that, it makes the information come off as unprepared and confusing. The content is subjective in terms of like/dislike. Last min info, test heavy, avoid..

(ANT 2128) -- She's a nice lady but unprepared making us students unprepared as well. In addition to lots of readings and heavy content. First day of class we were told we pick groups in class #2 and start presenting the following week.. As others said, if you want to take this as your bird course/easy elective, don't.

I chose this class as a 'fun' elective, but it turned out to be the worst and hardest course of the semester. The midterm had three 'short-term' questions, which were actually one page long and covered obscure topics no one would expect to study. The professor doesn't provide a final exam outline and simply told us to 'know everything. DO NOT TAKE

It's not necessary to attend lectures, but I would recommend because she hints at answers. Lectures can be boring and sometimes she's hard to hear and often needs to repeat things. However, she seems very kind and interested in what she teaches. Beware that the midterm was quite hard in comparison to the tests and final, so study well for it.

This prof is the nicest person, making a subject people don't find interesting, cool.She's always available to answer questions and made content easy to understand as she repeats important things. It is 2 quizzes,a midterm,and a final which isn't hard if you pay attention in class.Everyone who says she's a bad teacher clearly took the wrong class.

Feels like someone let a middle school student run the class for the day. Has no idea whats going on, sidetracked every ten minutes, slides are irrelevant and incoherent. Expectations for the midterm+exam are not communicated, study everything. You cant help but feel bad for her, its obvious shes far out of her depth, the woman will shoot your GPA.

Took as an elective. When lecturing, she speaks too fast and when she repeats important quotes, she always changes the wording? Her slides are almost useless as well, the information is hardly relevant to the topic. She also goes off topic and rambles on quite often in her lectures... also gives no guidelines to her tests or what to expect

Hate her, provides no framework to study for midterm, stutter, talks quietly and monotone and gave no study guide or any idea of what to study for in the final. Gets lost in her lectures, do not take this class as an elective its harder than it may seem and there's a lot of important readings.

Lectures were pretty necessary to attend as she only posts the important slideshows and terms. She speaks very fast but makes a point to go back over the important info which is nice. Very few things to be graded on but quizzes were easy as long as you were familiar with the terms. Better for people who have background knowledge in anthropology

She doesn't put slides online to "encourage people to come to her lectures". Her lectures are incredibly boring and she gets lost so easily. She just jumps from one thing to the next like there's no tomorrow so you're better off just reading what she tells you to read and make your own notes because her lectures add virtually nothing. Okay grader.

I had her for ANT1101 and it was a really good introductory course to anthropology. She does speak monotone, but she repeats important things that we should note down multiple times so we can get it written down. Only 2 quizzes worth 15% each, 1 midterm worth 30% and final exam worth 40%. The 2 quizzes are extremely easy, only multiple choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She does not present well at all, she looked like she was about to cry every single time. Her lectures are though, they are so hard to pay attention to, she speaks really fast. She will go on to say really important and long quotes that are not on the slides so she will repeat herself multiple times and will change the wording each time.

I was in Professor Abbots FEM 3105 (Feminist Theories) class and i loved it. I would highly recomend taking class with her. if you miss a class, you will need notes from another student becasue she does do a lot of lectures without slideshows, but her effort to get students engaged and make sure we understand is worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's nice and well-informed but the lectures were so boring. Lots of talking at you with nothing to supplement but bare-bones powerpoints. Huge focus on ethno-musicology so if you dont find that interesting then maybe skip. 3 MC quizzes, 1 paper, and exam was essay questions.

She's well-informed but having her for an 830am class was rough. Boring, boring lectures. Content overall was interesting but a really big focus on ethno-musicology so if you don't find that interesting might be best to avoid. 3 MC quizzes, one paper, and essay question(s) exam.

She's OK if you're like me and are just there for the humanities credit. Lectures were boring and no recordings but important slideshows are posted. Evaluations were easy. Just memorize the terms she posts + do the readings + UNDERSTAND the key points. Plus she'll sometimes hint the exam questions lol

Prof. Abbot is a tough grader fs but she was always very well-informed on what she was talking about. If you want to do well in her class you really need to pay attention to her lectures and readings, but overall I found she was a good prof. She did sound nervous in lectures but the content was always there, if you're in anthro I'd recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Doesn't post slides to encourage students to go to class. Likes to yap. There were 3 multiple choice quizzes that were very easy. However, tough grader on the midterm and final.

really seems like she doesn't want to be here - her lectures are boring and she seems unsure about what she's saying. her quizzes are really easy (except she lost a bunch of people's quizzes) but the ONE midterm featured three "short answer" (page long) questions based on random stuff where you don't know what she wants from you. avoid at all costs

Good prof except lectures are very boring, didn't show up last half of the semester unless for something important. Very easy class gives great feedback but be prepared to write a short essay on the first day of class (its not graded don't worry).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Gourgem is a kind and passionate teacher. Despite the course material being slightly boring, he clearly cares to make it engaging through the use of Wooclap quizzes in class, which proved to be quite fun. He is very flexible and understanding. This class (ENG1100) is essentially impossible to fail and constitutes an easy GPA booster.

He was okay. Lectures are boring and aren't really needed but attendance is still mandatory and taken every class. Covers basic topics that should be common knowledge. Quizzes are online you can access lecture slides and cover topics for every two lectures. Midterms were easy and don't require much effort. Speaks quietly during lectures.
Extensive reading and writing and attendance required. The final exam also requires the writing of an essay as well as an examination paper, which is based on some reading excerpts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: The course isn't in a lecture format, so beware; its a discussion based on readings which you must do to get a participation grade. If you're passionate about the readings and book, the course will be easier. The marking isn't particularly difficult. The main reason I give a lower grading is because the classes aren't very interesting.

I do not recommend taking a class with this prof. Lectures are long and very boring and he just expects people to be interested in the topic just because he is. Seems nice, but is extremely rude and defensive if you email him about anything to do with assignment instructions, grades, feedback, etc. Just is not willing to have an open discussion.
He just read slides that weren't even made by him. Often awkward silences in the lecture, and he seems not to know what he is doing.
Had him for modern controls, he was chill and very nice!

The professor makes expectations clear. He is very accessible outside class and by email. The course has a lot of labs, so be ware of that. He has an accent, so I recommend sitting near the front and making sure you understand him on the spot.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He tried to code during class with students, but I don't know why there are so many negative reviews about this. He was so nice once you approached him; he cares about his students! I recommend taking his classes, as he makes the lectures more enjoyable
Some students had problems with coding concepts, but he genuinely cared about his students, answered questions, explained the class material very well, and tried to ensure everyone understood.

reviews.comment: This prof is terrible. During his lectures he would not make his own slides, read off of them and try to explain them and then he wouldn't even be able to do that. Attendance isnt madatory but i would recommend going because u need to turn in ur hw. And there is one 5 page paper due at the end of the semester about anything in theater. It was an easy A

Lots of Dr. Le's 1/5 ratings seem to be a product of students not attending class or doing homework. Dr.  Le is extremely clear on what he puts on his exams and doesn't require you to study more than what is going to be on the exam. Dr. Le was very funny and had great lectures.

251 is more about understanding the concepts than actually solving tricky math, and he is understanding of that. *Note: This is for MATH 241 (Calculus III)

Professor Le's is very clear about what material will be on exams, and will often cut unrelated/superficial material from exams.

I was in 241 it just wasn't an option here. His accent is hard to understand in the beginning but not too bad once you get used to it. Had him for Math 241 which this website will not allow me to select. My main issue with Professor Le was the lack of consistent expectations. The worksheets seemed to be on random topics which may not pertain to the coursework that week, and most annoyingly produced illegible hand written notes that it is unclear if he even understood at times.

Hung Lee is just god-awful. He is very hard to understand and doesn't explain anything in any detail. 

If there is another math professor, TAKE THEM!

You will struggle if you aren't seeking outside help (Google helps more than he does).
Extremely hard to understand. Ruined my semester and slowing my graduation.

If you are worried about calculus at all I wouldn't take him because he is not easy to understand. His lectures are okay but he is just too difficult to understand. Dr. Lee truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He's super approachable. best prof ever! not good at speaking english but care abt ur grade. definitely take him again

J'ai juste arreter de me présenter en classe et j'ai quand même eu A+. Elle est, probablement, une bonne prof pour ceux qui ont de la difficulté.

Dre. Delorme is a good prof and makes the course interesting. The midterms are easy. Exam reflects lectures. Two books to read for the final exam. Does make you work to obtain a good grade but fair. Overall, this course prepares you for university.

Two books to read for the final exam. Does make students work to obtain a good grade but fair. Overall, this is a good course and prepares you for university.

reviews.comment: She thinks she's funny but she's not. She makes a LOT of mistakes (in class, power points, even in the comments she gives). It's easy to have a good grade, you just have to study a little bit. Class attendance is mandatory because you can't have the notes elsewhere.

reviews.comment: I missed many classes, and just by reading the notes I was able to understand everything. This class is fairly easy if you have a good basis in french. This class does has a semester group project and is just sucks. Make sure you have good partners from the start because it is a long project. She does guide you very well for projets and exams.

reviews.comment: the lecture itself was soooo boring (i skipped most of my classes) but the DGD's were mandatory. the expectations of your work is very clear in the syllabus and she goes over a few examples of what the work has to look ike before handing it in. that being said, its an easy a

Avoid her if you can. She is a really tough grader compared to the other profs for this class. If you take a 3 hour lecture, she will make you stay there for the full 3 hours. Her lectures are long and boring and she can be rude. Also make sure to review your tests because she makes a lot of mistakes when correcting.

her explanation is ok. however she is VERY rude and boring. I consider myself really good in french since i always had A's in french classes but with her i can't seem to get more than a C+. even when you ask her questions she makes you feel stupid. getting a B in such an easy class is ridiculous. she's a really tough grader. avoid this teacher

I enjoyed having her as a teacher! She is very enthusiastic and knows how to teach. Although alot was review from highschool, it made it that much easier. Other than reading your novels and writing essays, this was a pretty layed back class. The TA for DGD was amazing as well; very helpful teachers on both sides.

Le cours de français est très facile, le contenu est très bien expliqué, et la professeure fait en sorte que le cours soit moins long. Elle est très claire dans ses explications et dans ses attentes face aux travaux à faire. Je recommande à tous de suivre son cours!
She's a good prof, explains things well and manages to keep your attention. She is however very rude and makes you feel talked down to.

A fun course, and she talked about her two academic interests: concentration camp literature and literature by immigrants. Really easy course. My only concern was that she was a little direct at time; for example, she would shame you in front of the class if you arrived late, though she would often be late herself.
very smart and easy A if you attend class and DGDs.
No laptops or cellphones allowed in her class. If you always listen, it's a really easy class. Only tough part could be the big assignment. Participation is also really important to her.
She is a very good professor. I learned a lot in her class. She is really organized!
Good prof overall
Worst teachers!! Shes so boring and very rude!! I will never recommend her to anybody NEVER!!
Very rude. Also a really boring class and she doesn't make it interesting.

Although the course itself is painfully boring, this prof finds a way to keep your attention and she delivers the material in a clear and precise manner. She was very helpful in providing reading aids for the book we were studying. Since this course is mandatory, might as well take it with a prof who will help you.
This class is soo boring

The class itself is pretty boring but it's not a reflection of her teaching, more just because it's a french class. No one ever showed up, and you don't really miss anything but I would suggest reading the books she assigns.
HORRIBLE TEACHER. I would not recommend her to anybody. EVER.  She is awkward and boring.

The material she was teaching was interesting but she was not. She made me want to sleep in class. I still suggest a class with her if she's talking about the Holocaust. She knows alot about that topic.

The chemistry is very easy but she extremely frustrated she took three point from my exam because I didnt write my last name beside other pointless but the one for the name was very shocked because I did not see instructed grade like her.

The highest overall score in my class was an 83%, not a single "A" in the class.  The majority of students failed or dropped before failing.  Very disappointed for an "intro" class.  Teacher is ruthless.  If you are 1 minute late turning in homework or labs, she will not accept it, which means you'll miss on the lab portion of the class.

She's very strict and expects too much from her students. You can't really ask her questions because she won't really give you an answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Not an easy grader, do the homework because she quizzes on it often! Attendance is mandatory, she will be rude when you ask questions so prepare yourself. Consider another professor for your own sake.

had a teknothat was all essays: history of chemistry and marked down for incorrect Grammer. Your friend may get more or less points for the exact same answer (she's not bias just inconsistent). Made a girl cry once in lab for a spill. Will degrade you. "You Should know this" is her answer if you ask a question

She is a smart woman who definitely loves chemistry. She can come off as stuck up. Extremely difficult and picky grader(I got -10 points on a test once for improper sentences and grammar) even though the answers were correct. While she is a good teacher, she could stand to calm it down a bit.
She grades very hard but her lectures are very clear and her exams are not very hard.

There were multiple readings and things to do per week that were unrealistic to achieve. When we were required to speak Cree, she would take marks away because we didn't sound fluent while speaking. I would email her for extra help, she would ignore emails or just say to check the course material. Does not care for her student's. DO NOT RECOMMEND!

class content was pretty organized and clear, thoush she wasn't great at giving feedback.  not totally sure how fair the grading is, seems a little wishywashy. assignments/exams just from easy enough to extremely difficult w no preparation. either way the ONLINE ASYNC language class was a mistake...

reviews.comment: This is for Cree 100. Julie's content was very straight forward and she provided us with a lot of voice recordings and examples. I did not speak with her directly, so I cannot speak to her response time. The work is a little tough, but as long as you are consistent and putting in the work then you will do well. I found my marks to be fair.

DON'T TAKE HER!! The class may seem easy, but she provides very little and inconsistent feedback, will not be accessible for basically the entire last month of the semester, when asked a question will give false answers, and if she makes mistakes, will refuse to fix them. Her grading is all over the place, based on some abstract metric.
I did well in this class but had very little interaction with the prof, so I can't say much about her. Get ready for a LOT of studying.

This is for CREE 100, but the code is not showing so imma just speak here:
Julie is not that good, the content is easy but she makes a ton of mistakes marking and then refuses to fix them. Also, there is a huge jump in difficulty near the midterm and then again near the final. That being said, this class is defo a GPA booster, easily 95+ if you try

Julie is a very nice person, and easily contacted for any questions. However, if you haven't taken her for the 100 lvl course I do not recommend her for this one. As she uses her own specific words, phrasing, and sounds that are not taught by other FNU instructors. Which for myself makes it difficult to continue building upon my previous class.

Julie was  a fair but firm marker who was always accessible to her students outside of class. There is a lot of material but if you engage with the material and create a solid schedule for yourself you can do very well in this class. Cree on its own is a tough language, and if you did not take CREE 100 with Julie it will be a learning curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: For final exam he has given us a 15 page paper on a book as well as a research paper to create within a 5 day period. the title and including 3 key words is worth 1 point while a 1000 word literature review is only worth 2. He makes no sense, we did group work and every single person has not had anything good to say about him. I recommend you avoid

Stay away if this course is important to you. He is nice enough but his explanations are unclear and he does not schedule in advance. His assignments will never be explained in detail and he does not indicate their weight. If you like to prepare in advance and avoid surprises, choose a different prof

I heard horror stories from past group members urging me never to take a course with this prof and I listened to them in the past but in my last year I had no choice as this class fit my schedule perfectly. I was worried for no reason and honestly questioned the validity of what others have said about him. Easy A + he's big on group work, nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Park's biggest problem is clarity. He seems to have a difficult time explaining himself and when questioned about it, he can get defensive. He doesn't seem to be very organized and frequently changed due dates. As for the grading criteria, it's pretty much a guessing game, basically hit or miss.

Assignments don't make sense, grammatically they are full of errors. His expectations are not clear and his feedback is little to none. Slow at marking and only 3o students, half of which dropped out. Lectures are repetitive and we are tested and evaluated on to topics not covered. Very rude to students and doesn't follow course description

reviews.comment: OMG. don't even try, seriously you will want to cry. he taught the class completely wrong and will constantly make you feel awful. all he does is yell and call people out personally to make them feel bad infront of the whole class. assignments dont have a rubric, and is full of spelling errors & if you try and email him about it he wont answer it.

reviews.comment: Do not take a course if he is the prof. very unorganized and very unclear. Assignments rarely relate to the lectures. Slides are 200 pages long and don't talk about anything. No textbook.
Unclear and confusing with almost every aspect of this course, completely disorganized

A lot of assignments in this class. Instructions for midterm and assignments are unclear, and he takes a long time to grade things and get them back to you. Participation matters but he does not make it clear what you need to do to get the participation marks (i.e. just be present in class or to talk in class).

Prof Park took a less than interesting subject and did the best he could, which paid off. He is  super nice guy and despite his accent his lectures are interesting. Assignments and the exam were reasonable, although having to do 2 full census reports and a group project was definitely enough work. Attendance is taken.  Overall pretty decent!
Passionate about his field and the topics discussed in class. Lots of repetition in his lectures, but if that doesn't bother you, go to class and you'll do just fine.

RUN! I wouldn't say this is a bird course (Science Major). Yes the material is very straightforward, it's the prof that makes it difficult. Impossible to get time with him outside class hours. The TA is your friend, ask  for clarity on the assignments (50% of mark) bc prof is extremely picky. At the end I got a good grade no clue how I got it!

He is a horrible professor and I didn't like him at all. His assignments are unclear and he enjoys making his students feel bad when they ask questions. He doesn't reply to emails and he doesn't care about his students. He never posts marks on Black Board learn and his assignments are always marked late. His final exam was also hard and confusing.

He is tough to understand, gives out a bunch of assignments with no clear grading criteria and his tests are tough. He doesn't give out marks. Instead he gives you a letter for your grade so he can change your grade later. He asks his TA's to give out a B average. Then somehow everyone got a higher mark in the end. He bell curved one assignment
He's a funny guide and his exam was really easy. His class was not the most organized though. His assignments were easy but included little instructions/directions/
Terrible at explaining everything and doesn't give you anything to study for the final exam except for a list of words he's never even mentioned in class.

This class was interesting, he demands respect from students during lectures. Assignments given throughout helps with grade, they're very easy. Midterm and final were easy as well. Attend class, read and follow the study guide given for class and you'll be fine! Don't bother trying to write everything down, he will post all the slides before test

Great prof! Can get mad when students annoy him but just respect him and don't talk during the entire lecture. Gives participation marks which is always an easy bonus! Assignments are clear and he answers questions in emails or in person really well. Put a little effort and use your textbook for an easy A on assignments! Gives study guides!

Jungwee Park is halarious! He adds alot of slides a little last minute but they are great reviews of the chapters and gives study guides. Answers emails quickly and is willing to meet outside his office hours. Four assignments and one essay type which boost your grades. Make sure to add alot of material from the textbook! Very straight forward prof

This professor does not care about his students at all. Assignments are super unclear and irrelevant to course material. He tends to get off topic and is super rude. The TA's are also super hard markers.. Avoid at all cost..... you have been warned.

This professor is horrible.  I don't even know where to start.  Unclear assignments and gets bad grade because there were no guidelines.  Lectures are extremely boring. Slides are posted a week before tests and are irrevelant to the lectures (because hes off topic). Worst. Worst worst. Yelled at a student in front of the whole class!!! Rude.

assignments with unclear instructions, will maybe go through 5 slides in class before he goes off topic (on a lucky day), never seem to know what he wants from us, theres a TA that only answers emails twice a week, posts lecture slides (all out of order) a few days before the midterm and the final wth new material.

THE WORST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD IN UNIVERSITY (I'm 4th year BSc). Completely rude and condescending. EXTREMELY unclear. His tests are directly from the textbook but it will be the points you didn't highlight because they were irrelevant. He doesn't post slides until the week before the exam and his lectures are useless. Avoid. Avoid. AVOID!

Weekly assignments, participation marks and a final exam (worth 50%).  He tries to make the course interesting, stats is a very dry course. Lot of assignments to make up marks. Heavy use of the textbook. Weekly assignments are very interesting. If you study hard, you can get a B.

Park is unclear with almost every aspect of this course. He is completely disorganized, unwilling to answer your questions, and if he does he is completely condescending and rude. He has weekly assignments that the grading scheme makes no sense for, group projects, midterms and a final paper. He is unapproachable for help. DO NOT GET HIM.

The syllabus is garbage pay attention to his announcements on virtual campus. He doesn't really understand questions from students, and if you constantly ask the same questions to clarify , he will loose his temper and yell at you. He isn't a good prof ,but if you do the work you should pass. Summary assignments every week to help gain marks.

It's easy to pass the class but he is extremely confusing! He has a temper and yells at students. I'm not sure how he is a professor to be honest. He's extremely unprepared and it feels like he is learning the material with us instead of knowing the material. Reading the textbook is so much more easy than going to his lectures

Does not give any feedback on assignments(literally 0). Very unclear as a professor. Used slides from the textbook and clearly didn't read through them before the lectures(acts surprised by example scenarios).  Goes back on explanations and changes mind throughout the SPSS portion causing massive confusion amongst the class.

Absolutely terrible. Gives little to no direction for tests, essays, or group presentations. Asks for your home address (why??) and claims to memorize everyone's name (he doesn't). Lectures do not reflect anything on his slides and also do not reflect anything on the test. Teach yourself from the textbook, that's where he pulls all his exam qs

I have had Professor Park multiple times during my time at the University of Ottawa. First, he is very educated and well-spoken. Second, he is hilarious. Third, he is very fair. Highly recommend taking a class with him. All you need to do is show up to his class and pay attention and you will end up with a good mark.
Life course events course: Park is a very enthusiastic teacher. I enjoyed his lectures, learned much from presentations. I feel that this course was a good educational experience.
Professor Park is very clear in his teaching. He has a great class organization.
The course was fun, informative and inclusive. Park is an enthusiastic teacher.

Dead boring, incoherent lectures, with mandatory attendence. He makes students do presentations so he doesn't have to. His assignments and midterms are also ridiculous, not reflecting what you learned, and he is shockingly unhelpful and uncooperative if you have any questions or issues outside of class. Definitely avoid him if you can. :/

This class a waste of time. The lectures were an incoherent, incomprehensible mess and the assignments and exam did not reflect the material covered in class. I can honestly say there was no value in this course and that I did not learn anything, other than that I should follow my instincts when I consider dropping something the first week of term.

The prof is all over the place during class. He doesn't use his ppt (doesn't post up the slides either). Spends the entire 3 hour lecture playing a movie or giving examples. I didn't learn anything new (everything was common knowledge). I did like that marking was distributed among assignments, attendance, book report, group presentation.

I find Professor Park to be very well spoken, and to always convey his message clearly. He is a wonderful prof, and makes this theory course even more interesting. I would recommend this to anyone as well as any courses taught by this prof.
I liked Park's enthusiasm and good humor. He makes students to actively participate in the class; he demonstrates great knowledge in the class.

He goes off-topic so frequently that I usually have the urge to get up and leave class. It is like the Jungwee Park Comedy Show every lecture. I do not know if he is a smart man, considering his lectures are almost 100% based on the textbook. He is also difficult to understand sometimes due to his accent. How do people like him get to teach?

Park is a straight-shooter, he tells it as it is. Average lecturer, not too bad. Gave out a lot of assignments. Not afraid to call people out for disrupting. All in all, Park is an average prof, stick with him if ya have him.

Some students have bad things to say about Prof Park BUT I've had him for methods and stats and I very much respect him, and his course format. Instead of putting all the weight onto exams, he spreads work out into weekly assignments, allowing students more control over their grades & time to really digest material. He also has a sense of humour.
It was an easy and interesting course. I did just put a little bit of extra effort and gained an A+. Durkheim is cool.

Durkheim class: super boring but you get up to 15% for attendance. he is hard to understand and his lectures are boring but it is easy to do well. he has weekly summaries you have to hand in which are awful to do but again worth 15%, so easy marks. i did the minimum and got a B+. i recommend him only because you can slack off and still do well
This is a great soc. stat course. Weekly assignments were helpful and the professor made numbers quite interesting to learn.
I think he's a very good lecturer. He know a lot and is clear about things he's explaining. This course opened my eyes to a broader understanding who people are and why they are the way they are.
Very enthusiastic teacher. I enjoyed his lectures, they were easy to follow. Enjoyed learning more about different ethnicities and I feel that this course was a good educational experience.
FUN'N EASY COURSE ON HEALTH SOCIOLOGY. KEEPING HEALTH JOURNAL WAS INTERESTING!
this prof is strict, but i gotta tell i learned a lot.

Not the worst proffesor ive had. Hit and miss if he would do a good job teaching the topic. Assignments were very useful to the subject matter.The 15% attendance mark is stupid and he couldnt even explain how he calculated it.

WARNING: Avoid this Prof at all costs, it`s for your own good. I`ve had nothing but problems and unanswered questions from this guy. If you like your GPA nice and high, then stay away from this course with this prof.

Weekly assignments took HOURS to complete. He is confusing, assignments aren't clear, and he has unreasonable expectations. Textbook will be your best friend - he was useless in answering questions. AND half the final exam was scheduled on the last day of class, same day as an assignment that he didn't do the lecture for. AVOID IF YOU CAN!
Great prof. One of those rare ones that can actually make a 3 hour lecture just fly by. I really enjoyed coming to class to hear what he had to say.

I particularly enjoyed the assignments as they applied what was learned in class and from the textbook. Interesting weekly assignments which added value to the course and to my learning. Think it was both educational and fun.

I found the assignments were interesting and it was the first time I learned about Cansim, I now use it for many other projects. I think the class activities need to be more stimulating, in my opinion. I find the teaching is good and the prof brings good points to the classroom.
This professor made stat course somewhat interesting. Assignments are very important.
He is always well-prepared. Learned a lot. Good selection of media sources.

Class could be a bit boring  but he has a good sense of humour, although kind of strange at times. Assignments are really important to complete as the T.A. gives you editing feedback. Midterm and final were not overly difficult. I really question the 15% attendence thing...

He yelled and actually lunged at me and almost attacked me when I asked him about my attendance record.You can't understand a word he's saying, he thinks he knows everything. He's VERY boring and unhelpful. He has anger management issues and does not reply to his emails. He will screw with your attendance mark in order to curve the class average

Could barely understand him. The assignments were a joke, 15% for attendance and participation was a joke. No midterm, I studied very hard for the final, it too was a joke. The book is useless and his slides suck. I would study from the slides but you're still kind of on your own. He also doesn't answer questions very well.

This class is terrible. The Prof. carries on about random things that do not pertain to the subject material. Although the course is relatively easy, listening to the prof and attending class can be difficult.
He;s a realllly reallly easy professor, like if u really want a good Mark trust me take his courses, he's very easy with his exams and papers, but sometimes his TA's are big time retards

BORING mind numbing RIDICULOUS useless assingments DEAD EASY EXAMS 15% attendance NO LEARNING finally a gun can save your life -> shoot yourself in the foot to avoid dying from boredom - this class is an easy A if you can take it  DOES OTTAWAU GIVE REFUNDS???????
This is the 2nd course I take w/ Mr. Park and I have benefitted greatly.

RIDICULOUS. SO unhelpful. Didn't order enough textbooks for the class and when I emailed him he basically told me too bad. So boring and I agree with the person who wanted a refund of their money. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Professor Park is a good professor.  He really enjoys interaction within the classroom.  Do not talk too much, he yelled at quite a few students!  He is smart and likes competition.  The textbook was very easy to read and understandable, and he posted all of his slides on the internet.  Attendance was worth 15%, which is amazing if you're not lazy!

WORST PROF EVERRRRRRRR...he is so boring, i actually physically cannot pay attention for more than 12 seconds when he lectures. the slides have 2 definitions, that are perfectly defined and he feels the need to go on about it for 45 minutes, bringing things up that has nothing to do with anything. i regret taking this course.

This professor was brutal. I emailed him a question and he told me to show up to class because he answered it in class. I skipped 0 classes and got angry in the email he sent me! The TA's dont know english either, they tried to correct my grammar even though their "correction" was wrong. If you're a business student, dont take this class!
Lots of assignments. But they are not too hard and very helpful.
I've learned a lot!

I expected the class to be boring but it was great.  We had assignments on a regular basis but nothing hard. Overall, I found the info extremely interesting and he made it enjoyable to be in class.  There were some students who found it useless but I learned valuable research tools for later in my learning.
He is a very nice teacher...and his assignments and tests are very straight forward. He is very helpful if you have any questions!
Prof.Park specializes in research, so he actually teaches this course quite well!!  I can understand difficulty in other courses with him though.

It is hard to rate Prof Park.  He does everything a professor should: he's clear, helpful, fair marker, and adds humour to the class, which makes it enjoyable, however the course content is ridiculously dry.

Class is well organized and easy to follow.  However, prof is unable to understand student's question.  Often gives answers that are irrelevant to the question.  Occassionally answers questions by saying "read the textbook..."  Not helpful at al

Weber--very difficult to understand when he is lecturing. Not helpful AT ALL. When you ask him a question regarding the textbook he tells you the answer is in there, However your question was regarding clarity of what the textbook said. A good TA helps
No Comments

He was always incredibly helpful during labs and sends out guides to help with doing your lab report. He comes off as a but awkward, but I've always found him to be incredibly helpful. I didnt have any issues with his grading, and he was always offering extensions.

Hardest grader for no particular reason. Inconsistent grader at best. Does not have a clear grading scale or rubric and will find a point to dock off on every single lab report. He does not believe in a perfect score for lab reports. Will almost never give points back unless you have a letter from God saying that he is wrong

Extremely difficult grader for no particular reason. There is no rubric for the lab reports and he randomly decides how many points each question is worth. Unreasonable expectations for a General Physics lab. Will almost never give points back if you try to dispute a question. He believes that a B is a good grade.

reviews.comment:
one of the worst prof I've ever had. Rude, mean, incapable of teaching. cannot handle late assignments.

honestly Kenshiro Morooka irl

Productive struggle is big for this professor. He also did a flipped classroom for me where you read chapters from the textbook outside of class then did the homework in class where he was there to help. You may need to ask a question in the correct way to get a helpful answer (i.e. be able to show you at least tried the problem in some way).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: I've had Prof. James for MATH 261 and MATH 262 and he is an amazing professor. His understanding of the material is great and he is very clear when explaining content. He is also willing to extend due dates which I greatly appreciate. My only issues with him are that he sometimes goes too fast and watching his content videos is time consuming.

The worst Math professor at MSUM !! I had him for MATH 210 He is an instructor that will have you burnt out and stressed even during COVID. You'll have to learn his way and doesn't have an open mind. Doesn't teach so prepare to teach yourself. Acts like a show off. Thinks everyone is a math genius. If you want to pass, take a different instructor.

Gives extra credit, cookies, candy. Does not teach much. If you need help, he does not care. If you are confused, because of a mistake in his material, he gets mad at you for pointing it out. Moody, loses his temper, negative comments. I learned a lot by studying hard, got an A, will try to avoid his classes in the future.

He is a nice person but he doesn't teach that much in the class. Basically, all you need to do is learning by yourself if you are taking a class with him. He never teaches before exams but he explains it afterwards. You better be prepared to learn all by yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very tough grader-little to no partial credit given on problems. Quizzes every week. Labor intensive. Study hard and go to his office hours- If you have questions he actively listens. He does tell jokes- usually terrible- but you can't help but chuckle and it helps you get through the class!
What can I say? He chose a terrible textbook for this class.
He spends most of his class giving you homework rather than actually lecturing. Had to do most of my learning outside of class.

Professor James teaches at 1 level and that level is not 200. he expects everybody to be math geniuses. he had is favorites and they seemed to do just fine. i have more to say but its not very nice basically take this class from any other professor you can and you will do fine. his grade F. Stay away if you can.

He is one of my favorite professors ever. He explains material really clear. You will understand the material if you don't miss classes and do homework on time. He is really helpful and inspirational.

James is a very good professor. His classes are very hard, but he definitely knows what he is talking about. You need to put in quite a bit of work to get a decent grade, but you will learn a lot from him. His jokes, however terrible they may be, do help you get through the class. He is also very helpful when you ask him questions.
Not helpfull at all and gives no chance to cover your marks or points.

In his classes, you have to work and show effort. That is how you earn your grade. He was always very helpful, however at times he may be unclear. This is his way to get students to think about the problem instead of giving away an answer. Overall I found him to be helpful, at times unclear, but a decent professor.

Justin is always the best math professor at MSUM. I really enjoyed them. Some of my friends did not like Prof. because the testes were hard. However,absolutely that you can learn a lot a tons of knowledge. He is really intelligent and interested in all topics. He is really helpful too. He is the best math professor I have ever had in my life.
Smart, but who doesn't know how to teach average people.

Although, he is very critical at grading, he does realize this. He tried to make up for this with extra credit, and even making your grade up a little bit. He is very interesting to listen to. Also, he is extremely friendly. I recommend you go into the tutor room, ask him questions, ect. Overall he's critical, but great. A lot of work as well.

I overall enjoyed taking this class with Dr. James. If you like solving problems, this course is great to take with him as he creates worksheets/projects a couple time during the semester that really make you think. He is very friendly and I am glad I had the opportunity to take this class with him.
Absolutely Ridiculous grading. He needs to realize that this is not Doctoral Thesis. Avoid at all times!!!!!!

His tests involve bunch of definitions and 101-type application questions. He shouts that M476 will prepare you for graduate school, but does not have any patience to hear whether you got the problem in the first place. He has a negative attitude toward students who cannot spear time to meet him during his office hours. He needs to work on that.

Although Dr.James does know his stuff, he assumes that the student knows everything that he is talking about before hand.If you want a good grade avoid him,if you want to struggle, know most part of the course and still end up with a bad grade take him.Nice guy but not a good professor.Also shoots down your question.

He was not a good professor for me. Math is my worst subject and he didn't make it any easier. He's a very smart guy, but too intelligent for me. I need math to be dumbed down for me to understand it. Prof Goyt and Lynch are much better.
HORRIBLE! He was very rude,he made you feel very inferior. If you went to his office constantly I found you got a better grade. His class was hard as well as his tests. I will never take him again!
I have never liked math.. but I really didn't mind it with him.  He is the best math teacher I have ever had.  If the typical math teaching style isnt for you, take a class with him!!!
I thinks that Dr. James is a very good and helpful professor. I took Calc-2 and Calc-3 with him.
I took foundations of geometry (think high school geometry on steroids). The class was good, with not too much homework. He challenged us to think and to learn something new.

His jokes tend to be really cheesy, but if you can look past that, he is a good teacher that will go over half the problems in the worksheet. I found that annoying because I didn't have trouble with the worksheets, but others found it helpful.  And he has "reflection papers" and if you do all three, it's an easy 30 points.

He tries to be helpful but his way of explaining things is hard to understand and sometimes makes things more confusing. If you understand math then I would recommend him but if you have trouble with math then I would find someone else. He's a really nice guy and really cares about students but..He is also a REALLY hard grader.

Idk what everyones talking about: Prof. James is a horrible teacher b/c he expects you to remember everything he says & is unhelpful. My friend got help from him on an entire worksheet & got +5/10. How does that happen when the teacher helped him w every problem? He's also stingy w points. I'm an A/B student- he doesn't set students up for success.

The best math professor at MSUM, which isn't saying much. If you HAVE to take Math at MSUM, I would suggest him. Don't make the same mistake I did; Do all of your work on-time and study hard. If you do that, you're golden. Very nice, approachable, and a great teaching style, but don't let the low work-load catch you off guard. Study hard.

He goes through the theories of many different formulas and explains how they came about and how they work, but then he doesn't follow up with many examples.  This is not very helpful if you learn by example.
nervous, kinda nerdy... rdidculous
Professor James is an excellent professor.  He is always willing to slow down and make sure you are understanding the material and really makes learning calculus fun!

I thought Professor James was pretty decent. I had to take his class at 8:30 am, and I didn't particularly like algebra whle waking up. He knew what he was talking about and was extremely open to questions. I found the class to be boring, but it's algebra. He is extremely helpful outside of class. Very Accessible.
He almost made calculus interesting, and he's really funny in a nerdy mathy way.
Good teacher, nice guy.  Tests were difficult, but I would recommend taking a class from him.

Math is really not my thing but for the first time I actually liked the class. I had to go to the tutor a few times, but when I went there they said that they hardly ever saw anyone from his class there. His tests are a bit hard but he grades very easily.
Alright teacher.. tried to explain to the best of his ability but I still had trouble and had to get some tutoring to pass class. I would reccommend but tests were a bit tedious.

Fairly Good Professor. He can be confusing at times but he is quick to answer questions and clarify. He is willing to sit down and help you during his office hours and is very approachable. I would take another math class with him If I needed another one. One of the better math professors at MSUM
He is definitely willing to work with you and assist you in whatever way he can. He is quick to respond to emails and such. Definitely a teacher i would recommend!
Very approachable teacher.  Kind of a dork, but overall pretty cool guy.  Gives a lot of credit if you try hard.  Answers all questions and will explain as much as needed.

He is a pretty good teacher he knows his stuff, he can be kinda jumpy at times and jump onto a different part of the problem and then jump back which can be very confusing if you dont know the material, nice guy

Dr Lee is funny, laughs at his own jokes lol. His lectures are kind of boring and they last for 3 hours! Exams are not hard but not easy. The study guides help a little. He is not a hard grader, takes of little points for little mistakes

He will encourage you to use the TLC but then tell you they are wrong.  A lot of homework, a lot of labwork, and he makes you do labs after tests.

I really enjoyed Eric's class.  I thought at first he would be difficult, but I actually found him to be really helpful.  He tries very hard to answer your questions completely.  He is fun to watch in class too.  I would take him again.

I thought Dr Lee was pretty good until I took classes with other professors.  He skips many of the important parts of the courses and focuses too much on the math and science.  Does not use the book, so I wasted $95.  Was truly exposed when he subbed in lab.  He is a nice guy and tries, but isn't a great teacher.
Follow up from my last review. Hope you keep on teaching Professor Lee!! You're going a great job at what you do!

Professor Lee is a pretty cool professor. The only thing that is difficult in his class is that you have to put in the time. The grade you get is an accurate reflection of what you put into the class. My grades, at first, were horrible, mainly due to the fact that I didn't know how to study for the class, but also, because I didn't put in the time.
Very thorough.  Goes over everything in detail.  Covered the material we needed to know.  Keep on top of things and you will do fine.

I found him to be very knowledgeable about the subject matter. Not sure why others have rated him bad. If you put in the time you will do fine. He goes out of his way to explain things if you ask him for help.
Entertaining style of teaching.

After already having earned a bachelors degree at another institution, my experience with Dr. Lee is one the worst that I have ever had within any educational institution. Dr. Lee does not foster an acceptable learning environment. He is doing Delta College and their students a great disservice by continuing to teach. Avoid at all costs.

I just can't understand how he keeps this role.  Hard to understand.  Doesn't seem to have a lot of operating experience.  Doesn't seem to be able to relate the course material to the real world.  Take Matt or Joel instead.
If you can avoid him DO!!! He is very unclear and super fast pace. Beware
Very hard to understand not very easy to talk to. Didn't learn anything.

Pascal Kacou was one of the best teachers in you may wanna take in international development. He will always be ready to listen to you, caring and straight forward on his exams. He's an excellent teacher
you won't regret it
just amazing :)
He's just the best prof :)

Pascal Kacou is a kind professor. His assignments are very straight forward and he is available to meet after class. You can tell he is passionate about what he is teaching, and is earnest about not possessing all the answers/solutions to the issues discussed in class.

Professor Kara Cybanski is the BEST prof I've had at uOttawa thus far!! Her ability to switch from English to French to Spanish to ensure everyone understands the lectures is inspirational! Great Prof! She goes over the material in every language and explains everything clearly. She loves feedback and getting the students involved. Easy and clear grading criteria. reviews.comment: I really liked this class. The material was really interesting, and the prof conveyed the material very well too. However, for some reason, McCuaig asks his T.A. to mark us harshly. That being said, it was very difficult to get anything over a B+ in this class. This class had a midterm, a song analysis, a final paper, and a final exam.

Unlike the other reviews here I took his course before 2021 so it's probably Keith instructing the TAs to reduce the class average every semester rather than bad TAs for a specific semester.
