Doesn't answer emails and  calls you out infront of the class. very rude and will see an email coming up every week saying "DONT EMAIL ME FOR QUESTIONS" throws in lame jokes during class and wastes time.  Did the whole assignments and class on my own and struggled  with zero help from him.

Dr. Gildea was certainly a character. Was he funny, sure? Did he make a lot of jokes instead of taking the time to properly discuss important assignments? Sometimes. Did this strong disbelief in rubrics throw me off? Maybe. Were the assignments easy? Yes. But did he find a way to make it confusing? Sure did,

This class was dreadful. Gildea refuses to check his email for anything, he wants all questions asked in the zoom sessions. That would be fine, if he actually answered the questions. He either gives the most vague answer or he'll call your question stupid and tell you to rewatch the lectures (the answer is not in the lecture). Protect your peace.

couldve been better but i'd rather him than the inperson prof. as long as you can write essays and summaries pretty well then youre fine i guess. work is easy but he doenst respond to emails unless you magically email him when hes looking at his computer. my grades have been fine- my gpa relied on this course since science sucks

Everything is in his lectures. Quizzes and exams are striaghtforward idk why a lot of people have a lot of questions when their questions ask about things covered in lectures. Stopped going to zoom calls cause it isn't worth it and people kept asking nonsense questions. Grades fairly if you do it properly and can actually write essays. Funny tho

His lectures are pre-recorded, I only watched 1 before never touching them again. Attended maybe 1-2 zoom calls, there's really no point since its literally a repeat of grade 12. Woke up late and missed our midterm, wrote it in 20 minutes, emailed him asking to submit cause I forgot and he let me 30 min after due. Finishing the class above 95.

Don't take this prof, not worth it. His Zoom sessions are just him refusing to answer any of our questions. Instructions are not clear and the feedback he gives is pointless (like we could figure that out ourselves without him) and funnily filled with spelling errors too, you can tell the feedback he gives has no effort put into it.

His so-called help sessions are not helpful at all. Whenever students ask questions, he responds rudely and his answers don't even help (his only response is to "re-watch the lectures"). He doesn't respond to emails either.

This prof was such a pain to deal with. He often told us not to email him with questions, his instructions for assignments were extremely vague, and his feedback was often vague as well. Every time someone had a question, he was extremely aggressive in response and often entirely unhelpful. Do not take this class.

The professor is amazing as an individual but as a teacher not so much. When it came to the Zoom he barely did anything. He would sing and talk so much that we ran out of time and could not ask questions. Although this class had a professor it felt like I was learning completely on my own. I would give it that he is lenient with his marking.

Professor Gildea is a bad prof. He posts all of his lectures online pre-recorded and hates when we e-mail him. I think he's just lazy. Also, he doesn't accept late submissions even if it's 1 minute after the deadline which is weird for a first-year prof. Also, he's a bad prof overall, his comments don't make sense and he's not really available.

He makes things so difficult for no reason. He does not explain things well enough. He is not open to answering questions in a constructive manner. He is not open to any remarking. The feedback he gives is, funnily enough, ridden with spelling errors to the degree where i simply don't know what hes trying to tell me. Dont take.

Prof refused to give clear grading criteria, and always stated that he would answer any questions in zoom meetings. Yet, most zoom meetings consisted of him being overwhelmed by questions and refusing to answer all of them? Not sure how he is still a prof as he says he has office hours which are his workshops but then refuses to answer questions
DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE.
i should have took someone else when i had the chance

super super harsh grader, doesn't give examples or outlines and claims its "high school stuff" to give one
wouldn't recommend taking this class at all!!!! When he hands back assignment  he follows with an email saying not to email him and to wait to the zoom meeting and that if you do email he will not reply, avoid at all costs!!!

He doesn't even use grading guidelines or rubrics for this class because he claims it is "high school" stuff. What?? It is like he intentionally wants to make it difficult for us to not succeed. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. And don't even think about arguing about your mark. He acts like it's a chore to actually teach. Unbelievable

Lectures were asynchronous with virtual discussion groups every week. The professor cancelled half of the virtual meetings and repeatedly told students not to email him questions. He doesn't use Brightspace, lost my assignments, and sarcastically responded to my emails. Avoid his class at all cost. I went in with TGPA of 10 and got a B.
Awful teacher. Not helpful at all. Boring and long lectures. Does not care if you are struggling. He will ignore you and call you out in front of the class. Do not take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a pointless class that thought me what not to do regarding essays and especially grammar. I took this course while being a second year and almost everything he said regarding other professors is a lie. He's very rude in emails and during lectures. Avoid at all cost

Avoid this professor at all cost. Hes extremely rude towards student and will make jokes that are offensive. I've had to file a formal complaint against him. His teaching is horrible you will not learn anything new. Example he believes conjunctions are too confusing for students therefore we should not use them on a grammar quiz.

The online class was an absolute mess. Lectures are all pre-recorded and if you have questions expect to wait a while to receive a response. Took months to get grades back and the criteria for the assignments were impossible to figure out. Would not recommend taking this course online.

Good professor honestly. I took his English online course and it was really helpful that I could just do the work on my own time. He is a bit of a tough grader. Make sure to ask questions during DGDs and take his feedback from your work and use it. Your mark will substantially improve if you do. Good teacher overall and funny guy.

He is rude and IF he answers emails they are 3 words and passive-aggressive. all lectures are pre-recorded from years ago. you will be teaching yourself. do not his class. He doesn't provide good feedback, though he does grade quickly. If you are graded by TA's he will not help you, and you will wait months to receive grades and feedback.

Professor Gildea is great. His lectures are engaging and easy to follow. The only thing I would have liked is more direction in what he was looking for in certain assignments. I found that when writing them, I was never sure if my assignments were meeting to his standards. (he usually gave outlines, but not always)
If I could go back, I would never choose this professor ever again. He has unclear grading criteria, strict marking, and expectations.

While he is funny don't let that fool you. You'd think being a professor he would be doing his job but nope. All lectures were YouTube videos from last semester, and don't even think about emailing him because he won't respond anyway, or will respond saying basically figure it out yourself. 0/10 do not recommend

In the online classes, he records all his classes in advance and then leaves all the exams and other work to the teaching assistants. He doesn't respond to student emails and never really shows up for class.

Professor Gildea is an engaging lecturer and a solid choice for ENG1100. While I was not in his group for the DGD, I did watch his pre-recorded lectures and found them helpful. The content is pretty basic (grammar, structure, etc), but it was refreshing to get a clear foundation that I know will help me with university-level writing later on.

I loved having Professor Gildea for my English class. He did an amazing job covering all the bases of essay writing, grammar, etc. I feel a lot more prepared for university than I did before taking his class. Definitely recommend!! You do have to listen to all your lectures, but the assignments are straightforward and clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Avoid this professor at all costs. He is way too demanding and nearly impossible to have a satisfying grade with him. Email responses are horrible and too vague. I don't recommend him!
it is too hard to get a good grade in his class and he is very demanding please avoid him if you can

He does a great job developing your essay writing skills and guides you through the entire process. Lectures were recorded and there were no DGDs. He's accessible outside of class and responds to his emails regularly so reach out for help if you need it! His marking can be a little tough and unclear at first, but in the end, it is fair

If you ask, he provides great feedback. This class is pretty straightforward and definitely improved my essay writing skills. The way the class is set up follows the chronological order of writing an essay and comes in handy for writing the final essay!

I am so surprised by the positive reviews on here. My experience with him has been anything but. The course is comprised of Word documents and YouTube videos. There is no DGD. He has a ridiculous email policy (not to mention that half of his lecture time is spent telling students not to email him). He is pompous and arrogant. Stay away.
His online class only have (1)video from Youtube (2)Word Documents from his email. Thats the way he teach you. I would rather than learn by myself. SB prof

I have always been pretty bad at english. I took this course so that I could learn something to really make my writing stronger, but I feel ripped off. All the lectures are old recorded videos of literally his face while he speaks. He didn't do the dgds or live sessions for questions. Overall, I just feel like this was a pretty bad course:/

He did not teach a single thing all semester. He sent us YouTube video recordings of the course when he taught it in the summer, which included incorrect information. He grades very unfairly on the essays, yet didn't teach us how to improve. I took the course with him because I saw the good rating here but don't be fooled! I get normally A's fyi

He recorded all his lectures. There were no office hours or DGDs. He does not like answering question on emails which I never understood why. He provides you all the reading material. Even if you don't read the articles you can still get an A+ It's an essay class just make sure you give yourself time to write those essays.

His class was entirely asynchronous so I did not get the chance to interact with him as I was in the TA's group, but he was entirely straightforward about what he expected from his and how we would be marked. He was very clear and his class was structured well. 100% recommend to first year students, he taught how to write essays perfectly!

Anyone taking workshop in essay writing should seek him out as a prof! He somehow managed to make Friday evening lectures enjoyable to attend. Grading criteria is clear, and incorporation of any feedback given on previous essays is guaranteed to pay off on future essays.

Great, interesting lectures and it helps that he's hilarious. Has high expectations from students and is a tougher grader, but super informative and you'll learn a lot. However, if you are struggling he isn't always accommodating - not exactly the nicest/most empathetic prof out there.

Best prof I've had in my first year so far. He knows how to teach (unlike other English profs) and puts you in position to succeed by giving you tips on how to write a good essay. Also very lenient with deadlines. I recommend him to every first year student out there.
always a fun class, the discussion group was a lot shorter than scheduled, but that should not be a problem.

He's hilarious and makes the dullest topics exciting, you'll wanna attend his classes just for fun. He's a little hard on marking, but in general he's fair with his grading. His assignment criteria and instructions are always clear.

My favourite Professor so far. He is so funny and actually makes me want to go to his classes. There is only a couple short stories that are mandatory readings. As long as you go to his class and follow his instructions, you will improve your writing and get a good grade.

Awesome prof, especially for first years who are a little scared writing big university papers. Loved his enthusiasm and energy he brings to his lectures to make learning grammar and writing less dry. Made me laugh everyday, actually learnt a lot and made me excited to go to his classes.

Great teacher, understands that most students are taking his course because they have to and turns it into a joke. Very accessible outside of class, and cares a lot to make sure that lectures are funny and keep you listening. Favourite university teacher!

Definitely one of my favorite profs that I'll remember for a long time !  He was extremely helpful and easy going, seems kind of intimidating at first but when you get to know him he's a very funny guy! He's flexible with due dates and I never felt overwhelmed in his class except for when there was an essay due. Ask for extra help if you want an A!
Class covered pretty basic concepts. He explained thing pretty well  but it was unclear how he was marking.
He's soooo hilarious!! strongly recommend

Very hard marker but if you work hard and take his advice it's possible to get an A! He is an amazing lecturer, very engaging, helpful and totally clear about his expectations. If you pay attention and apply what he teaches, you'll do well.

His lectures gave basic grammar rules and information on essay structure that was a repeat from high school. However, his rubric for marking was unclear and I was unable to make any progress in my essay skills. I would not recommend him because there was a disconnect between what he taught and the intensity of his marking.

Gildea is hands down my favourite professor. Essay writing is a boring class but he actually made me love going! He was super helpful with our topics and essay outlines and making sure we had all the tools to write an amazing paper. Always willing to discuss topics and you can tell he has a lot of knowledge in every field. Take his class!
Great guy, easy class and good feedback, he is also super flexible with due dates

Really funny guy, really straight forward. Discussion groups are really helpful, he's available and provides great feedback if you need help. Lets us out of discussion groups early; he said what he needed and you can stay if you need more feedback, or leave when you've got the grasp of that week's material

Actually looked forward to his class, when everyone participates its really fun. Always upbeat and positive. Had him for ENG1100, we did 3 quick essays with loads of time to do it and a final exam, easy stuff.
Had him for ENG1100, very very easy course. I probably would have skipped every class and just did the assignments but he was hilarious and made me want to go to to class so I wouldn't miss out

Super funny prof. He really enjoys teaching the class for the most part and knows his stuff. He's a hard marker, but he teaches you well enough to be able to do decent in the course. It's unlikely you'll get an A, but getting lower than a C in his course is nearly impossible. Loved the course with Dr. Gildea. He genuinely cares for his students.
nice prof., kind and genuine. seems to care about the students and our future. enjoyed a great summer semester with prof. gildea.
Hilarious prof. Real nice guy, and far and away the most helpful teacher I have ever had. He's a hard marker, but it's worth it to have a class with him.
Funniest prof ever. He always make sure the lectures are fun, as much as the lecture materials are just boring stuff. Def take his class again. Fun times!
He is a very understanding professor. Always ready to give advice

Sometimes I mistake this guy for Steven Colbert or John Stewart!!  Knows what he is talking about and at the same time has fun with it.  References in speech are fantastic.  Looking forward to next class

Biggest beauty on campus, took the essay writing course, which I was dreading. But came out with a bunch of useful knowledge and had a good time doing it. Crystal clear on instructions and expectations and always keeps the class laughing. I'd have to say best prof I've had at uOttawa!

Amazing prof! He really takes the time to know all of his students. Such a character! He makes a dry subject really fun. I've never been in a lecture where people burst out in laughter so much. If all else fails he could be a comedian.

Mon dieu....J'ai jamais eu un esti de bon prof comme lui! Je vous encourage fortement de prendre ce cours! Auparavant, j'ai détesté la recherche, mais à cause d'elle et sa motivation la recherche n'est plus une notion qui fait peur. Elle fait rire, en plus elle comprends très bien ses étudiants, soit anglophone ou francophone. Très hot en passant!

Great prof. The course content is very dry but Kevin makes it fun to learn and at the same time ensuring that everyone understands the content. Is always willing to stay after class and answer any questions or help you improve your writing skills.

This prof is really awesome! I had him for the general Essay Writing class (which can be pretty boring), but he really made it a pleasure to come to class. He's hilarious, very clear on his expectations and he is very fair. He is an excellenet professor, and I'd recommend him to all anglophone students taking ENG1100.
Awesome prof! I found the course content very boring as it was very similar to high school but M.Gildea made things seem more pertinent.

Awesome professor. One can tell this guy is not a snobby academic, obviously has real world experience and knows how to apply it. His knowledge of stylistic and technical writing styles are very comprehensive.  He knows how to explain clearly and persuasively. He is a really funny guy and loves to have real conversions before and after class.

Gildea is great. He's funny and interesting and very, very clear about his expectations throughout the entire course. I loved taking his class and I highly recommend him for anyone taking Workshop in Essay Writing.

Fantastic professor! Always making jokes, absolutely hilarious. I was never very good at essay writing, but he'll go through the step by step process for the Workshop in essay Writing. If you follow those instructions, you guarantee yourself a B+ at least :) I miss his classes

This teacher is great! Soooo funny and so engaging. Actually, made me want to become a high school english teacher. He makes grammaer understandable... not sound like a mathematics equation. Loved this class. We always got let out early.
He is a great English professor. He is extremely engaging and very interactive with his lectures.

SIck prof.  He made first year English a lot better than it could/should have been.  He's a great person, quite flexible, and funny!  No midterm but exam was OK...you just had to listen to his lecture, which was usually humour-filled.  Let out 3 hour lecture early most of the time, which was great.

The material for this class is very dry but Prof Gildea usually made it funny so time went by a little faster. He does save money on textbooks, but I would say to not even buy the Canadian Practical Stylist. Very clear on expectations.

He is a really funny prof. and he saves you a lot of money on the textbooks. I find that he is not clear at all on what he expects and the first part of his exam "critical reading' was NEVER taught in class! Apparently using too many sources on your research paper is wrong - go figure. It is better to be marked by the T.A.

This was my favorite class of the whole semester and I did not expect it due the the subject content. This professor will make you laugh each class and he is a very fair marker. I wish he taught the other English classes! It is very easy to get an A if you grasp essay structure and do not write passively. One of the greatest professors for sure!

a funny, vibrant professor who loves his subject matter passionately and that feeling just reflects back into his students. a very inspiring teacher. no matter what he teaches, you'll be sure to enjoy the course!
best prof ever!
Great fun and learned much.
Amazing professor. This class is super boring but with Gildea's hillarious jokes it makes it easier to sit there. Really funny, and he makes an effort to save you money on the text's for the class.
Dr. Mongeon is awesome. Learned a ton. You have to work hard, but you'll get out of it whatever you put into it.
Don't take this class
Very bad instructor - very unclear and very hard to follow. Basically had to teach the course to myself.
Very easy class! However, there was A LOT of homework, but it was EASY! Her midterm and final is taken online with open notes/books. If you're looking for an easy second year seminar, take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She was excellent.   Clearly knowledgeable in the subject.  A lot of homework but it wasn't difficult.  As long as you show up and do the assignment's you'll pass.  Easy grader.  Tests were online take at home open note open book.

She wants the class to be engaged. It made it annoying (groups teach sections some days). Read 2 books and it's a lot to balance, but reflections were easy. There's a lot of work. Tests were pretty average. Attendance was mandatory and papers are turned in hard copy. She is an okay teacher, easy grader.  The final paper & presentation was simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: The easiest grader I have had in college. A load of assignments that are extremely easy. Be ready to write a lot. Her daily quizzes during the first half of semester pushed me to read book. I actually was able to read it and it was interesting. Easy A, just show up and do the work. Slides are posted online for each chapter. 2 tests and 2 books.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She speaks perfect english and her lectures are easy to understand. She used to work for Nv Health District and clearly knows what she is doing. If you are here for a good education,she is your professor. She gives a lot of work,but they are easy and she is also an easy grader,unless your typed papers look like a sleep-deprived drug-induced mess.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Expect a 5-question quiz every class on the assigned chapter. Course consist of 4 written 2-page assignment,2 book reports on the assigned book, 1 4-page final research paper,  and a big o' final presentation top it off. Midterm and final exam are taken online with open notes. This is a very easy class if you do all the work. She is a nice teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Profesor Linh works hard in that she wants people to learn the material. She also wants to be addressed as Profesor or Dr., just a heads up. There are alot of things due almost every other week but if you do them correctly you will get and A.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Class was super easy. A lot of assignments but they're all doable. No reason not to get an A. Wish I could've had a different professor though.
Love this class. Easy A
easy A

The class itself is ridiculously easy. The workload is heavy, but the assignments are easy. The professor however, likes to be difficult. If you hate talking in class or working in groups, don't take this professor. She treats students like they're in kindergarten by threatening to pull sticks out of a jar w/ names on them if students don't talk.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is one of the easiest professors i have ever had. All you have to do is show up and write a few short papers to pass
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Beware incoming students - the class's content was cool but Kheana was not a good professor. She cancelled class many times but didn't reschedule them and was so hard to get in touch with. It took forever to get our grades back too. Don't know why she is a professor if she's not going to act like one.

Lectures were engaging and interesting. Challenged status quo thinking, found ways for students to be more involved in their learning, and provocked so many stimulating conversations and emotions inside and outside the classroom. Her teaching method is less conventional and passive and more reflective and interactive. Felt very seen and inspired.

A really nice professor but unfortunately not an interesting course. A good portion of the lectures were cancelled or a podcast was provided in lieu. I appreciated her flexibility with deadlines and that the exams/assignments were easy. The content wasn't very interesting in my opinion but she's a good professor. An easy A if you do the work.

Nice prof, impossible to contact. Communication is extremely slow and delayed. Class was interesting, but honestly more of a special topic class then social development of a child. Learned a bunch of cool things! Wish she was easier to contact though.

Poor communication—grades were often delayed, including past the drop deadline, leaving students without crucial info. Despite the course being about social child development, much of the focus was on social justice topics. Several lectures were canceled without makeup. Overall, the course lacked structure and clarity. Not recommended.

This prof is lazy, she cancels so many lectures and doesn't do anything to make up for it. She has canceled at least 10 this semester. She'll post and say grades will be released tomorrow but 6 days will go by and still nothing... keep in mind the midterm was on bright space so not like it was hard grading.

Cancels lectures often, replacing them with podcasts or nothing. 6 of 23 lectures canceled this semester so far. Grades are painfully slow, missing promised dates; group project grades were 3-4 days late, midterm grades are currently going on 6 days late. Always arrives 5-10 minutes late, adding up to 2+ lost lecture hours.

Thought-provoking material. Did in-class activities which kept me engaged and helped with exams. Encouraged students to bring content back to personal lived experiences to learn more about themselves.
Kheana's is a good and caring person. But her overloaded lectures are impossible to keep up with. She's also pretty tough on the assignment's grading, although her exams are fairly easy.

The material was interesting but she mainly just read off the slides without adding too much more information. Also records the lectures on zoom at the same time, so dont bother going to class, either read the powerpoint slides or watch lecture at 2x speed. 1 midterm, 1 case study group project and final all on brightspace (MC/fill in blanks).

Lectures were full of text so if you just study what's highlighted in bold, then you're guaranteed an A+. The format was bimodal and exams were on Brightspace and proctored over Zoom. The material itself is sometimes interesting, sometimes not. I would take the course again because it was straightforward and simple. There is also a group project.
She is super nice and her grading is fair but the lectures are not super engaging. There is way too much info on the slides and she just reads off of them.

Interesting lectures and lots of well-managed discussion. She offers a balanced approach to different theories and takes the time to answer questions thoughtfully. Online practice tests helped prepare for exams, and the option to attend class online was available in case you were sick. A very caring prof who shares her enthusiasm with students.

Very passionate prof! They made the content of this class really interesting. I thought I would loathe it. Exercises we did in class were fun and helped me study. They had practice midterms, which really helped!

I gained a lot of insight from this course. I really enjoyed the bit on self-compassion as that I never knew of this concept before. I appreciated that she took the time outside of class to have interesting conversations. The workload was comparable to other online classes. She's a straight shooter and is overt about her expectations unlike others.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: 2 take home midterms and 2 assignments. Pretty standard hybrid course. The assignments were quite easy but the exams were a bit long. If you're well prepared and attend class, you'll get a good grade. She's a great lecturer and chooses modern topics. Very kind through email and in-person. She really wants everyone to succeed & is very flexible.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Course content was stimulating and extremely inclusive. I really appreciated this. Great lecturer and I would definitely take a course with her again! She gave lots of feedback, answered emails promptly, and is very compassionate and understanding if you're struggling. Exams were a bit tough and made you apply your knowledge but I learned so much!

I had a terrible experience in this class. I had many tutors and studied more for this class than any of my higher level courses. She does not respond to emails often and I received very little feedback on the papers that she claimed were Fs. Not pleased with the money Ive spent on this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was a mandatory class I had to take. Two assignments and two take-home exams. The take-home exams would take up to a week to complete and it was very difficult to receive a good mark. The class average was very low. She had great lectures but her assignments take-home exams structure was not very well done.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Chan has become my mentor. I have learned so much from him. I can't thank him enough for helping me advance in Spanish. He knows so much about multiple areas. While he is a bit hard to deal with sometimes, and a bit old-fashioned, he truly inspires his students to learn and thrive in all areas. I highly recommend you give him a chance! Use usted!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Chan is the best prof in the Spanish department and University, I believe. He explains things until you understand it. He is there for extra help and is very sincere in his help; but don't take advantage of it, it doesn't go over his head. He's funny, but you need to be serious about the class. The work can be difficult but is prevalent&helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The best professor in the Spanish Department. The homework does require time but it helps you so much in the end. My strictest professor but favorite professor. For the rest of my Spanish degree I want no one else.

I took many 300 level and 400 level spaish classes with him, hes a great teacher you learn because you learn too many quizzes and he expects a lot buh hes a great teacher if you want to learn! Def worth your MONEY!

Very funny. Always a little late and disorganized. His tests are hard and he gives quizes almost every day but he is still the best Spanish teacher I've ever had. He explains things very well. Make sure not to skip class.
Good professor, easy class as long as you pay attention and do the work which is also very easy.

He is extremely helpful and understanding. You have to be willing to pay attention and be positive otherwise it will be like pulling teeth. Stay positive and motivated ... it will be a walk in the park and you will learn a new language.
enthusiastic....stressed the need for colquiolisms and the importance of accents....never got that in high school
Ok...I never took a class with him per se...but he helped me out a lot since I'm a Spanish major....I love him, I'd marry him
Chan is the one spanish professor i actually learned from!
professor chan is a very nice teacher.  He is very enthusiastic about the subject and is always there for extra help.  Does assign homework but overall it's a good class
No Comments

I loved having Kirsten as my ENG1120 Prof. The content was very engaging and she was incredibly understanding and caring towards her students and their success. Overall, had an amazing term with her and would highly reccomend!

Wether fiction literature interests you or not, Professor Kirsten brings so much positive energy to her classes so it makes the topics interesting for everyone. She is thoughtful and very accommodating which is great because i think being flexible benefits all students. Her slides are super detailed
Most caring prof I've had. She was really passionate and helpful. I just don't know if I've really learned anything from the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: While I wasn't too interested in the subject matter of the course, this prof is amazing. Her lectures are all super well organized and clear, as are the instructions for the writing assignments and the research paper/essay. She gave great feedback and was also super friendly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Professor Bussiere was an amazing professor. She gave a lot of options to bring your grades up and even offered me the option to submit an extra-credit assignment late for a boost at the end of the semester.
In terms of tests, there are none but weekly readings were there and we had to do weekly writing exercises based off readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Excellent teacher, engaging, caring, fast responses, great feedback, understanding, all around wonderful 10/10
super nice professor and gives the best feedback ever! is super nice with giving you extra time and wants the best for you!

Super nice prof who is very accommodating, she's on the younger side so she understands students better than some others. Interesting content with lots of genres. She gives quick responses by email too.

Kirsten is fantastic. Her material is amazing and the readings are fun to read even if they weren't for a grade. Some of the materials are also focused on indigenous perspectives, which was the cherry on top for me. Great feedback. Easy to follow lectures. Paper is whatever you are interested in. 10/10 class.
Excellent professor, easily the best I had in my first year. She has unambiguous grading criteria and fantastic feedback, and she is always willing to help.

She was an awesome professor and her lectures were always so much fun! There is quite a bit of reading to do in this course but all the stories she chooses are super interesting and really gets you thinking about certain issues. She is always available to help outside of class if you need it. 100% recommend!

honestly she's such a sweet teacher! unlike most new profs she doesn't command the classroom in a negative light, instead she does it with kindness and a mutual respect. She also lets us take a small break during the middle of the class to help us digest the info and then be able to focus for the second half. Would take again:)

For the most part Kirsten is a good professor. She is new, but you can tell she really cares about her students. English is definitely not my favourite subject, but we read some interesting stuff at least. Grading can be tough, but she gives a lot of feedback so you can improve. She also gave a bonus assignment to help students bump up their marks.

reviews.comment: Kirsten is really friendly and you can tell she cares a lot about her students. There was a lot of reading and there were a lot of assignments but overall I really enjoyed the class. I especially liked the postcard assignments because it was fun to be a bit more creative.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Kirsten is a really nice professor. She grades quickly and provides detailed feedback. Kirsten really cares about her students and wants them to do well. She is easy to talk to and gives extensions if you need one. The course had a lot of readings, but most of the stories were pretty fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Kirsten was such a caring teacher! She put in tons of effort and offered so much help! She is very accessible outside of class and answers emails very quickly. Always tried to make class fun with different themes each week! She is an easy grader and will review work before due dates. I would definitely take a class with her again!

Kirsten is a really sweet person. She cares about her students and helps as best as she can. However, I found the classes to be boring, they were repetitive (read a lecture before class, analyze it in class) and held AT LEAST 1 breakout room. You also learn the basics of essay writing already learned in ENG1100. Wasn't my jam but got still got an A

She is a very tough grader. She is also very demanding of students; for example, in her first week, she required students to read over 200 mandatory pages for a single class discussion. Her participation marks are very unusual as well; she has ranked participation, meaning even if you talk during class, your discussion marks will be ranked 1-3.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Love this professor! I enjoyed her class. She is very knowledgeable. I learned so much in this course. Your grade will largely depend on whether you attend her lectures. She isn't particularly a harsh marker, but those who miss a large part of her lectures will hardly get an A. Prof. Tatar is always available after regular office hours.
She is an amazing prof! Strongly recommend taking her lectures. Yes, she is not an easy grader, but as long as you attend her lectures and do your readings you will be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I liked Prof. Tatar. She was clear on the assignment guidelines. There was a lot of readings, but, if you manage your time well and respect her grading criteria, you will have a good grade! She is also approachable, so you can ask her questions and she will answer. I had essays and quizzes. No in class MCQ midterms, which was amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This prof has extremely unrealistic expectations for her students. The amount of work and guidelines assigned to her students is absurd to say the least. If you can, avoid this prof at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lectures were practically useless, as course marks came from two midterm quizzes that relied solely on the many various readings she provided, and, two 2500-3000 word essays. Essay guidelines were demanding but also somehow unclear? Due dates were changed sporadically. There was also a 10-minute DGD presentation worth 5%. Avoid the prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: VERY hard to understand and stay engaged in her lectures. The million readings she assigns are important as they appear in two quizzes which made up 30% of our mark. Be prepared to put a lot of time into this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Unfair grading with no clear expectations. Boring to listen to and difficult to understand. Constantly shifting and inconsistent deadlines. You should avoid this prof at all costs.

Really tough-grader and unreasonable, she does not make her expectations clear. She will mark you down for things she did not outline in her guidelines or will raise the bar from what she outlined arbitrarily. I would not recommend her to anyone looking to do this as an optional or an easy grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The 5 stars do not make sense. This prof was hard to understand, her lectures were boring, she had a clear poli bias towards a certain region which overtook all of our lectures, she assigned 4-6 20-50page readings/week which she said some were phd level?! she was not a fair grader, she took away marks for things she did not ask for.
awful prof.

Great prof overall. I took her classes twice. She is very respectful to her students,  knowledgeable, you won't feel bored during her lectures! She also is very tech savvy, so frequently uses different online tools/platforms to make her course even more entertaining an up-to-date.
Prof. Klavdia Tatar is a very nice prof and engaging speaker. Overall very friendly and straight to the point. Cares about students. I'd recommend taking this class with her!

Prof Kota seems like genuinely nice person, but his class was not so nice. He takes an insane amount of time to go through the slides, adding useless details and examples that do not benefit our education. You have to memorize EVERYTHING, and even then you will doubt yourself during the exams because of the confusing questions.
this prof puts questions on the exam that only make sense in his own head. avoid honestly.

He is not a good professor. His classes are ridiculously long, and he barely goes through 2/3rds of his slides in a 3 hour session. His exams don't test students on understanding or knowledge; they test purely on memorization of his notes, word for word. His notes contradict each other and give multiples different definitions on the same concepts.

Professor Kota is genuinely kind and wants students to succeed. Sadly, his lectures are sometimes painful. The professor drags slides out, making 25 short slides last nearly 3 hours. His evaluations are also marred by extremely vague questions that can be contradicted and based on lectures that at times contradict their sources and even themselves!

Professor Kota was respectful and approachable outside of class, but that being said, if you're a Type A student, you may want to avoid his way of teaching and his classes! His rubrics do not represent what you're being marked on (in other words, unclear grading criteria) and he will add material to his exams that we never discussed in class.

Professor Kota is very caring and wants his students to succeed in his class. That said, if you already took Prevention and Promotion of Health (HSS3508) and Health Research: Quantitative and Qualitative Approaches (HSS3101), you won't learn much in this class. Exams are fair, but you still need to study hard if you want to have an A+.
Komlan Kota is very kind and cares about his students. He is also always available to answer questions outside of class. He gives good explanations in class and I recommend taking his classes.
Professor Kota is always willing to answer questions and clearly wants students to succeed. Overall, it was a great class experience in a supportive environment.

Statistics in epidemiology aren't really my forte, but Professor Kota's clarity makes things easier. He focuses less on calculation exercises and more on the types of studies, using concrete examples, which makes the lesson much more comprehensible. I'd definitely recommend it!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Komlan is very clear in his explanations. If you go to the lectures and follow them well in class, you will certainly pass the course with a good mark, as the discussion exercises in class will often be included in the exams. I recommend him!

The teacher was very attentive and clear. We were assessed on 1 mid-term multiple choice and T/F, a group project and a final with multiple choice and open questions. Going to the lectures will really help you with the open questions. I recommend this teacher!

One of the nicests profs in the faculty and cares about his students succeeding. His course is easy material if you keep up with it and really does help if you want to go into public health or government job after graduating. Nice man and wants to see everyone do the best they can!

Professor Kota is super nice, funny, and really cares about his students. He really wants everyone to succeed, and is always there to answer your questions. We had one exam and one midterm, both multiple-choice,and a group project, I would totally take his class again, and I recommend it to anyone who wants an easygoing learning experience!

you should definitely consider taking Mr. Komlan Kota's class He's an amazing teacher who makes the subject really interesting. His teaching style is fantastic. I highly recommend it , he really cares about his students , I would definitely take any classe with him as he was teaching for 3 years in different HSS classes

One of the best teachers I've had. The material is clear. He is very attentive to our questions and is dedicated to the success of all his students without exception. His field experience in international projects makes the course even more interesting.

Professor Kota is truly an exceptional prof! His dedication to student success is evident in his unwavering support. He consistently goes above and beyond to ensure that students understand the material, readily answering questions and providing constructive feedback.
He is an excellent teacher, who takes the time to explain the material well by giving examples to explain the concepts. He is always ready to help his students.

Prof Komlan knows how to transmit his knowledge in an engaging way which is very useful, he uses concrete examples, he encourages us to participate which makes the courses more dynamic. He is an exceptional teacher who inspires his students to excel. I highly recommend his classes to anyone looking for an enriching and memorable learning experience

The teacher explains the material in a super interesting way, he uses concrete examples, he encourages us to participate which makes the lessons more dynamic. He is an exceptional teacher who inspires his students to excel. I highly recommend his classes to anyone looking for an enriching and memorable learning experience.

The prof demonstrates exceptional abilities with a dynamic teaching style that engages students. Their clarity in conveying complex material fosters understanding. Effective communication and interactive methods create an optimal learning environment, enhancing students' comprehension.TAKE CLASS WITH HIM, YOU WILL NOT REGRET! EXCEPTIONAL!

Pr. Kota is very caring for his students' success. He always took the time to repeat explanations in different ways to make sure we understood. He's very adaptable to students' requests when he can be. The formulation of the questions in his exams were sometimes a little bit tricky, but the questions were easy to answer if you studied well.
This prof explained epidemiology in a very attractive way. His teaching method helped a lot with complexe concepts. I recommend this class with him, worth it!

I love this prof. 
Even though in the exams there is some questions that need the full understanding of the concepts, if you study you will get the results you deserve. Very fair.
The prof is always available after class and support his students.

Prof Kota is very caring and wants us to succeed and to be our best version. He tries very hard to teach the concepts the simpler way, with passion and motivation.
Exams are very easy if you attend the class and understand well the material with the prof's comments and availability after class for questions!

In my 4 years of undergrad I have never taken the time to write a review but this is much needed. Kota is very hard to communicate with outside of class, reads off of his slides and even though the course content is easy, he asks unfair questions on exams that are worded poorly and creates confusion which will 100% lower your GPA even if you study.

Ive had professor Kota for two courses and I will warn you: avoid his course at all cost. He is disorganized, evaluates new concepts never seen before DURING the exam, ask very weirdly formulated questions, his course notes are pointless (he does not even consider them to write the exam), he will NOT provide a grading criteria for the projects.

Overall, I didn't have a good experience with this prof. His exams are very unfair (there are concepts we've never seen in class, question formulation is unclear, confusing or biased). He is hard to get ahold of outside of class (don't necessarily expect a response. I feel like he had many other commitments and the teaching quality suffered.

I dont know why there's alot of bad reviews but this prof is one of the best. Very caring, engages the student well, very clear lectures. Yes the exam was tricky, you need to understand everything but if I was able to get an A+ you can do it too

If you can choose another professor for epidemiology, do it. Komlan reads off his slides, but on the exams will include material he didn't teach. Although attendance isn't mandatory, his exams are out of left field and this course will most likely lower your GPA.

This professor is not fair to his students. He includes material on the exam that hasn't been taught in class and he is not accessible outside class. He grades the group project to align with his desired class average. I suggest never taking a course with Prof. Kota if possible as he is an unfair professor who is disorganized and does not care.
Simply a great professor and a great human being.

Literally THE best professor I've ever had at uOttawa! Prof Kota is motivational and is constantly trying to do the MOST for all of his students. He believes in every one of his students and will go out of his way to answer questions, clarify assignments and help you succeed in the course. Do your work and reach out to him - you'll succeed!
Kory is by far the best professor I have had. He is caring, respectful, and understanding.

He is great. He is very wise and will help you look at things differently. He gives me aha moments every time I ask him about a project. Very good instructor. You can learn a lot from him as a freshman architect

Took him last year. Kory is hands down one of the best studio instructor I ever had. He always says good morning to everyone in the beginning of the class. He always do something fun in formal studio hours in order to keep us engaged so we dont get bored and fall a sleep. He is an understandable person and doesnt mean with trading projects.

Arc 101 was one of the easiest studio class I ever had thanks to Kory Smith. Kory always tries his best to keep us awake bc it is a morning class. He always give us a fun activities to do in studio. I wish I have him for all studio class especially sophomore, junior, and senior year of college

Take studio with Kory if you have not. Also he is the leader of teaching in design studio. He always there to help me during studio hours and motivate me do well on studio class. He is pretty laid back with studio projects which help me a lot

I like Kory a lot. I am really bad at drawing and crafting, but after I have Kory as my professor, I learn a lot especially making one operation project. Basically a lenient readers who let you redo again when you fail projects for first time. Better than most studio professors

Kory is truly a gem. He blesses on the final project and allows people to redo the assignment to get a good great. Even the intentionally gives a lot of work to weed out students, talking to Kory about the project is a good idea and saves a lot of time. Asking TA for questions and help is a great idea.

reviews.comment: Kory is the best

Kory tends to say that the more you use your time effectively on studio, the more it will save your time. He also tend to not give a work when we have midterm. He tends to ask you how you do on the midterm, because he care about the tution that student pay for the ARC related courses.

Kory is a great architecture professor in UB. He is very helpful and willing to help you when you struggle with the project. His studio 101 is an easy A as long as you show up and do what he told you to.

reviews.comment: Overall amazing teacher. Its ez to get a good grade u just have to know everything by heart and u will be fine. Dont buy the textbook, bc he just dont use it. He is funny and his lectures are fine. Dont have to attend every class tbh. There is a group project(a simulation)in this class and try to get the best grade u can get, bc it counts for a lot
The teacher is not very good at giving lectures, is class is very easy but somehow he makes it tough. DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER.

Professor Apedome is one of the best teachers I've had at Telfer, he explains the course well, always listens to the students, don't hesitate to ask him questions after class. If I were to take a course in the future it would be with him.
He is a good teacher. However you need to take your time in class or after class to ask questions. He is very unresponsive on email.

Mr Seli Apedome is one of the best teachers I have ever worked with.  I was expecting ADM3701 to be a difficult module but his well-clarified explanations and a cornucopia of commendable practice exercises(Exercises sur les slides) were the ultimate cataclysts for an A level performance. I will definitely recommend this professor!

He's sooooo patient it baffles me. Seli is really passionate about business and you can tell, even if the zoom calls get super boring you can tell he's trying his best to keep it interesting. He answers every question and he's super kind.
THE GOAT OF THE GOAT, BEST TEACHER IVE EVER HAD
very nice prof, he was very helpful when asking questions
Seli apedome was an amazing professor for such a difficult course! He made it easy for all students. He would simplify though concepts and help us understand them in a very easy manner
Every time I see his name on another class, I take it. Very caring, explains tough material and makes it easier and banalized. Super nice teacher.
He is definitely terrible at explaining, but he will always take time outside of class to help the ones who ask for it.

reviews.comment: Friendly teacher Work hard to pass
The class itself is okay. Nice prof. It's easy to get good grades only if you memorize everything.
Awful class...I have to work harder than my other classes without any result, plus you have to learn by hard every detail of your lessons. If you can choose Aubert, do it
GOAT
Ce prof est dynamique et très intéressant!

Prof gentil mais cours quelque peu ennuyants. Si vous avez un cours de 3h avec lui, attendez vous qu'il prenne max 2h15. Il est un peu drôle. Étudiez bien pour ses tests par contre, il y a beaucoup de par coeur.

Very nice professor, had him in first year and once again on my last year. Caring and wants his students to succeed. Boring lectures but gives great real-life examples in class to make it easier to understand. No need to go to class but study all his revision questions!

Lectures were useless though as he explained everything poorly and slowly.

reviews.comment: Very very difficult to follow as an immersion student because he goes so slow and has a difficult french accent. The material is present in a very boring way and he makes no effort to keep students engaged. Marking was fair, classes were bad. Best to learn out of the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

Emailed him and no response. He's not a horrible prof but I would take someone else instead if I can

reviews.comment: Loved this professor. In-class lectures were fabulous and hilarious. Always told stories. Attendance is mandatory for DGDs. Exams are purely memorisation. With multiple, short answers, and long question (memorisation necessary). All the info is in the slides. Very genuine man. Never bought the textbook.

Seli is a great guy, he makes the boring lectures funny. He gives out extra marks for those who answer correctly his questions in class (0.00135%). questions on the chapter review are most likely to be on exam. the course only has one midterm and one final valued at 50% each. don't slack off.

Very very very easy class. The exams reflect all the subject covered in class and Seli was always available to answer our questions after class and during office hours. He is funny and takes the time to really teach the subjects. I would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The professor is a genuine guy but his grading criteria is awful. He is very unforgiving when it comes to marking and there is absolutely no clear grading criteria. You can do very well one assignment and fail the next. The content is not difficult, but the sheer incompetence of the grading criteria AND TA's makes this class all luck.

reviews.comment: He is very nice and open to answering questions. If you visit him during his office hours, he'll tell you specifically what he requires in the devoir. The actual lecture is pretty useless though. Everything you need is on the slides that he sends.

There is one midterm, final exam, two "devoir", and weekly DGD. For a 7-10pm class, he is very boring as he takes forever to finish one slide to repeat everything it is saying in different words. Honestly a useless class that lacks substance, but that is hardly the prof's fault. Just memorize the information and you'll get an A.

Honestly this teacher is the best. he tries his best to help his students and genuinely   cares unlike other teachers. I would take him again any day.  if you have any questions or any concerns just go see him and he will do his best to help you!  - You need to study his midterms/exams are a bit hard
He's a kind prof, but you're going to have to memorize A LOT of powerpoint slides. Exams are long and boring, but are very well reflected in the practice questions.
Hard exam but if you study your good.

He is a really nice person but as a teacher it's different. The only thing he does is reading is powerpoints so going to class is actually pretty useless. Exams are much  more about your ability to memorize definitions than actual knowledge of the matter. Sometimes I wonder if he has actual experience in what he is teaching.

This teacher wont give quiz and lot of exams there is only two exams midterm and final. If you go see him he is very helpfull and nice. I used to always skip his class and still had a good grade he also gives 0.075 points or 1 point for participation... Wich is whatever since it's so little but he is a good teacher
pretty good teacher but the exams are quite hard unless your name is Michael Ross and can remember evertything that appears on his slides.

Honestly, she's passive-aggressive and blunt with how she expresses herself. So much homework was assigned for this class but it did help me to understand my content course better. Overall, would take this class again but with a different prof.
Excellent teacher! I recommend to anyone who wants to improve their French!

I can't quite wrap my head around the negative reviews. Yes, sure there are high school vibes with her class, but she is extremely kind, answers emails quickly and her class is very easy. If you take her class you are practically guaranteed an A or A+ so long as you do the work and show up.
She really enjoys helping her students and is very kind and understanding. I highly recommend.

Very high school vibes. She can be very passive aggressive and condescending but I think she means well. Class is super super easy to get an A+ in so that's a bonus but I've had better FLS teachers. However, the assignments we had to do definitely helped for my French marketing class.

She is an okay teacher overall but beware that her attitude can definitely be off-putting and disrespectful. She leans heavily on participation in-class and she will interrupt you mid-sentence to correct your grammar or pronunciation. Also, she only allows 2 unexplained absences per semester and she will dock you marks if you exceed that.

This was a very easy class however she loves to put you on the spot. It really felt like high school all over again. A little passive-aggressive and just overall aggravating. On the other hand, her class is simple. An easy A if you show up. Get ready to be out of your comfort zone if you don't like speaking in front of everyone!
i did not like to turn on my cam
I hate her she sucks

Favourite FLS teacher thus far. I found her class to be useful and it helped to improve my vocabulary, pronunciation, and comprehension of major themes from the main course. Like most FLS profs, she prefers if you engage and it makes the course more interesting too.
He is informative, inspirational, very funny, and always up-to-date. The group projects aren't traditional, but you'll enjoy them.

Such a gem. Truly one of the best law school profs I've had. Super knowledgeable, engaging, caring, and funny. If you get the chance to take privacy with him, DO IT! Group assignments can be time-consuming but ultimately teach you a lot – they can even be fun (as he encourages creativity).  Love Klein
Terribly opinionated and arrogant.
Very opinionated and his communication is never clear

Professor Kirkup is the BEST THING that has ever happened to me in law school. He is incredibly intelligent and is very humble and approachable. He always starts off class with saying "be kind to yourself and to others". He makes you feel very comfortable to ask questions but is he a tough grader. Take his class! you will NOT regret it!

I really appreciate how Kirkup tries to present cases in a neutral way, separate from his own personal opinions on the subject matter. Class is very structured and well-organized. Very accommodating and understanding towards 1L struggles and is approachable. Ppts are very clear. But heaviest readings for this class by far, so get ready!

reviews.comment: Teaching at UOttawa Law, Prof Kirkup is one of the most engaged and enjoyable profs I've had in my Common Law studies. Interesting course design, good class engagement, and wicked smart.   Class was graded on multiple small / interesting assignments with one large paper at end.
Brilliant, challenging, and kind.
Recommended.
Haha, nice one kyle. we all know that was you making that comment...
Attractive and intelligent--perfect in pretty much every way!

He made essay writing one of my favourite classes this semester which is saying something. He's extremely kind and dedicated and really wants everyone to succeed. He gives good feedback and I found lectures actually pretty enjoyable because they were very interactive. Genuinely cannot recommend him enough!!

Dr. Kyle is a very interactive professor who provides excellent feedback on assignments. You can meet with him over Zoom or after classes to discuss your assignments. He is also very fair and offers you great ways to help boost your average through participation and quizzes.
Great prof and gives good feedback, almost always available to help improve your writing.

Super cool prof and wants you to call him by his first name. He was always in a good mood and cracked a couple jokes during lectures. He also finds a way to teach that is relatable to students. For all in-class assignments like analyzing, summarizing or finding arguments of an essay, he gives it a couple days beforehand to make it easier.

reviews.comment: Great prof overall. Came to class in a good mood and interacted with students. He also made his course relatable for his students and his office ours were incredibly helpful if you're lost or need direction for the final research paper.

He goes through all of the grading criteria with you and basically outlines what you have to do on each assignment.  He also gives good feedback on the assignments which were outlines for the final essay so that you knew how to improve and do well on the final essay.  Only downside was attendance was graded and lectures were sometimes boring.

reviews.comment: above and beyond prof, taking my first university English this year was far less intimidating than I thought it would be, and I have Mr. Kyle to thank for that
Easy going and nice. There aren't many assignments, so most grades go there. However, he isn't harsh with grading, and he gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Even though I was in a three-hour lecture block on Friday nights, I was not too upset about it as it was always a fun class. he gives good feedback and is an easy grader. His classes never disappointed.

reviews.comment: He sounded great during lectures and clearly knew the material. However, at times his attitude came across as somewhat snobbish, which affected how students perceived him. The grading criteria were unclear, and I found the evaluation process inconsistent. Overall, I regret taking this course.

I loved Prof Munro ! His lectures are fun and interactive and he knows a lot about the different subjects he teaches. His class was online as it was during the summer, but he made sure to not make it boring. Would happily take him again !

I learned the most in my entire degree in this class (I just finished my 3rd year of DVM). He is an amazing teacher and the midterm and final are fair but the two written assignments had unclear expectations. Me and many of my peers received low grades. I do think there's a lot to learn from him though.

Great prof overall. He gives amazing lectures and clearly has experience in the field. Lots of reading, however he wrote the textbook and bases his lectures off of it. Assessments are 5 discussions that are easy 100's, 2 fairly easy midterms, a final and an open-ended essay. Content heavy but overall you can get an A- if you put the work in.

reviews.comment: Lauchlan is very specific about what he wants to see in the assignments so be sure to clarify with him. He is somewhat of a hard marker but you do learn a lot from him as he is very engaging

Professor Munro is an absolute gem of a human. He really knows what he is talking about and has years of practical experience in the field. He is a tough grader and expects a lot from his students, but he is very fair. and approachable. Read the textbook, listen to what he says and show up.
