reviews.comment: His bad rating here had the whole class scared - we were wrong! He takes the "tough love" approach but is clear about what he expects and offers fair feedback and marks. Yes, you have to put in the work - but when you're learning from someone with so much valuable field experience, what do you expect? Ignore the overall rating - take his classes.

Professor Munro failed me as a teacher. He enjoys punishing his students in his spare time for his own lack of clarity and rigid colonial structures. Everyone else is wrong, he is right, shut up and listen.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was the first time Prof Munro taught online and it was great! My classmates and I always enjoyed his lectures (make sure to do the readings!). The hardest part would be the near 30-page chapters before class, along with a short book to read by the end of the semester. The Dgds and any non-class related discussion were always enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's a good prof in general. You have to read one 30 page chapter per lecture which can be daunting. He is super accessible and loves to talk to his students outside of his class. Was super accommodating to what worked for students and was an engaging lecturer. Would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Clear in his lectures as well as making them as interactive as possible given the fact that it's online. DGD participation is important and easy marks as well as helping to further understand the content. A little tough for grading but what he asks of you is fair. If you attend class,do the readings and timed practice Qs to study you will do fine:)

Munro will inevitably make you feel stupid with every interaction you have with him. He only tells us everything wrong with our answers with no willingness to provide the right answers. This is not a teacher, this is a game maker. I am always so excited to learn the content from the readings but then he shuts down everything during the lecture.

Was surprised to see the negative comments about Munro on here. I found he was a really great prof. He spoke clearly and his lectures were super interesting. I learned a bunch from him and enjoyed going to class. Also great TAs who mark very fairly for immersion students.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is a very hard marker. He expects a level of quality similar to what you would see in the field of development project management. Despite this he was approachable in office hours and his lectures are engaging. You will struggle in this class. If you want to do well go to his office hours regularly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Easily one of the worst profs I've had throughout my 3 years. Extremely arrogant and condescending, will take marks off students for no reason, clearly has favourites as two students with similar assignments can get entirely different grades. Instructions/ expectations unclear. Office hrs are accessible but feedback is never consistent. AVOID.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Condescending, and a very tough grader even though the parameters for assignments are hardly outlined. Gives vague answers to questions about assignments. We had to do presentations that were not even part of our mark. Work load very heavy. Gave good direction during office hours. Did teach us practical stuff but really needs to grade more fairly.

He definitely know's what he's talking about and is well versed in his field but He's had almost 30 years experience and expects us to know as much as he does. unfairly harsh grader. He is not clear with his instructions but yet is very particular in what he wants. Hard to do well and hard to know what he expects.
amazing-calm, cool, collected. never a hair out of place (seriously, great hair). and as sharp as a tack! very helpful and reminded me why I chose this god-awful faculty in the first place...

Professor Ewashko fosters a welcoming atmosphere where students feel embraced every day in class. You'll explore incredible classical music alongside rich cultural and historical aspects! Don't be swayed by negative reviews. If choral singing isn't your cup of tea, it's not a reflection on the professor!

Talks about himself more than anything else. Chooses music thats way too hard and doesnt teach anyone how to sing properly. Very stressful class, and he has very strange opinions on how the music industry works. Waste of my time.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He tells so many stories! Most of them are helpful and related to course content. A big thing is to be alert, since he likes to ask a lot of questions. Also, if you arent a fan of eye contact, be prepared.
Lovely.
what a sweetie! he totally knows how to teach, and how to sing.
Really Nice
He sparked my interest in singing and now I sing in a high level choir after university!

Chooses very crappy music, very opinionated with irritating views on working in the music field (getting a job and making money...?!). good at getting the most out of teaching a bunch of non-vocalists how to sing.
he's awesome! very nice and funny
he defenitly knows what he's talking about. He's more helpful when it comes to my instrument than my voice...but he certainly is a good guy.
Great conductor, very knowledgable, a fun class to take.

Ewashko has a cynical, sour, mercantile and conceited view of professional music making, which he works hard to impart to students. But while his considerable natural ability partly makes up for his lack of interest in teaching, for most, it will not inspire an interest in singing or choral music.
HILARIOUS! this man made me laugh so many times this semester. he's easy goign as long as you show up on time and prepared. knows what he's talking about.
very pompous, wasn't good enough to be a solo singer so he became a choral conductor. extremely lazy when it comes to teaching, dosn't really teach anything
definitely an interesting prof.  his expertise seems endless.  watch out for the analogies when doing choral work though.
Is not clear when it comes to assignments and tests.  Can choose better repertoire for choral ensembles.  The repertoire he chooses is not enjoyable to sing at all.
snobby but very smart and very good at what he does

Super nice and good teacher. Will always help you if you need. Will organize review sessions before exams for everyone and help everyone out. Grading is fair. Only thing is lectures are really really boring, but the project is good and the instructions are clear. Deadass recommend if ur in the french program and need to pick this guy. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
Oh man, where do I even begin? This prof was the WORST I've ever had. You know it's bad when the only thing you learn from a course is how NOT to teach. PLEASE, for the love of all that is holy, if you're reading this, RUN. RUN FAR AND FAST. Don't subject yourself to this academic torture. 

🙁
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Its his first year being a prof so I understand he's still learning but he's difficult to understand his slides are not organized well and he does not seem wiling to answer questions all the time and I find his explanation is not very good. if he did not take attendance I would never come to this class he just reads off a slides.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is his first year teaching, so he needs to improve on things for sure. He yelled at us for not having our name tags with our pronouns on day one. He just reads slides all the class long and repeats himself a lot. If we don't understand anything, it's hard to ask a question since he doesn't want to answer any.

I took ANT 110 for an elective. It was generally interesting. I am glad I took it. However I do warn you if you are looking for a class with low workload this is not that. There are several 2-4 page papers due throughout the course due on Sunday nights. Papers are based on the free online textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great teacher! Lots of awesome things to learn about anthropology!
Tough grader for no reason. Doesnt explain thing well, shes overall a bad teacher and I dont recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I liked this professor. Reading the previous reviews I think that she must have changed her way of teaching and what she uses. There was one book, which was pretty interesting, and a lot of cool videos to watch. If you're good at writing papers this will be an easy class for you. A decent amount of assignments, not difficult if you do the work

I absolutely love Doctor Weinstein. She is smart, enthusiastic, and really cares about her students. I took her for Anthropology and then for SS 400 my senior year. Love her so much, and really respect her as a teacher.

DO NOT SKIP HER CLASS! I did, and I really regret it. Not for the curriculum (she kind of turned class into an agriculture 101 class...), but because she factors attendance and participation into your final grade as a HUGE percentage. Don't skip, and honestly, don't take the class with her. Not worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: By far the worst teacher at Western. I had her for Cultural Anthropology and all we did was read 3 books and she gave us stupid assignments. She complains all the time about being a teacher. She likes to give random assignments last minute and never explains them  yet complains people are doing the work wrong. I would NOT recommend her at all.

She is a very nice lady but definitely takes favorites in her class. I really haven't learned much in her class and it's hard to stay awake. The material is boring and all we do is watch videos and have a 20 minute discussion about the book we are reading. I wouldn't recommend her as a professor for Anthropology.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She means well, she is a nice lady, but I found the material kinda boring (at times) and not easy to relate to, and the readings were just not interesting to me. I feel like this class couldve been much more interesting dependent on different topics focused on. Also, kinda repetitive. Not many tests, a few papers, plenty of EC opportunities.

The class is supposed to be learning about other cultures around the world but instead we spend the first week learning about her idol Jane Goodall and her permaculture garden which isn't even that big. 1st book is about food and isn't interesting and the 2nd  is about water. Would not recommend her as a teacher try Morrison if you need this course

This professor does not talk about culture. Because she is in charge of the Jane Goodall garden at WCSU, her main topic  was food and water. I can honestly say that even with attending classes and reading the books, I learned nothing about Anthro or culture the entire semester. Taking this class with this professor is pointless. Avoid at all costs.

I loved her class, I don't understand why people dislike her, she is funny. Yes, there are three books but they aren't hard reads and we discuss them in class. Yes, there is a volunteer project but if you pick a good one, it can be really beneficial, I volunteered somewhere that went with my major and it was great. It's not an easy A but it's good

This class was very boring. Midterms I got a B, I don't know my final grade yet though. However, GET READY TO READ. Three books to read in class, believes in what she teaches so she pushes it on her students. Funny teacher at times though, I wouldn't take it again. I got a decent grade last time around, but you DEFINITELY have to work for it.

I really came to dread attending. She responds to questions VERY defensively and makes a scene.Which is not helpful if you don't understand. Often class comes to a screeching halt to probe why we don't act more exciting. It was EXTREMELY uncomfortable. I love anthro. and I was unsure what she was looking for. She turned me off to a subject I loved.

She requires you to read three books. She ends up discussing the main points in class through videos and lectures so you can essentially pass the exams without reading the entire book. You have to volunteer for 10+ hours and then write journals about your experience along with a 5 page essay. Her personality is unwelcoming and the class is boring.

Dr. Weinstein is very tricky teacher to work with. Either you do great and understand everything, or vica versa. I personally would recommend her because I worked well with her teaching style, but to someone who isn't an auditory learner, she is difficult at times. Whether or not she'd be good is unfortunately entirely up to you. i'm of little help

SHE IS HORRIBLE. She is one of the most arrogant professors at this school. You would think if you attend every class you will be fine with her tests, quizzes and assignments but she will grade you harshly for no reason. If you seek for reasoning in your grade she will make a scene in front of the class and make you feel stupid. DO NOT TAKE HER.
I honestly didn't think it was too bad...she did have a hard time relating to student, but it was also at 8 m. I think if the kids in her class gave her something to work with it ud be tons better

She clearly picks favorites. Tries to teach a lot but has a hard time relating to students. Don't bother taking unless you are prepared to read all three books and do all the assignments above and beyond what you would expect to do.

Although I received an A in her class, it was a lot of reading and trying hard. It wasn't a horrible class, but she did require us to do 5 hours of community service and do a major project on it, which really sucked. If you can avoid this class & take someone else i would.

Being in her class was terribly sad. She has a very difficult time connecting what she is teaching to her students. To be honest, she gives up trying to teach. She is never helpful, and her comments are rude. She is very closed-minded and seems unhappy. Alas, since the ANT dept. is so small, you won't be able to avoid her if it's your major :-(

I love anthropology. If you care about learning the course content, buy the books and read them. Plotkin and Pollan kick ass. This professor, however, has little to offer in terms of analysis and discussion besides the occasionally amusing and often wildly off-topic anecdotes.

I was very excited to take this course upon reading the class description and weinstein smashed any interest with her better than thou attitude and ridiculous requests. We were supposed to drive ourselves to Uconn twice during the semester for lectures or other presentations! She was no help at all and many of the students in the class withdrew

Textbooks mandatory, same with attendance so don't skip. Hard to BS the readings because it's a lot of discussion&lectures, very clear with assignments and what you need for class from Day 1, but a lot of work. Very satisfying for those who are interested, but don't bother if you're lazy. You need to be an actual student to survive in Anthropology

When i saw the tile of he class i was so interested. however the lecture are dry and boring. only a few students were interested in the way she teaches the class. unless you have to take the class dont. if you have to take the class i wish you all the best

DONT TAKE HER!Saw good ratings on 1st page&took her. Hate it! 1st class I'll FAIL! Sick days she's spiteful&schedules you to present when you return, then fails you because you're unprepared(have to be psychic to pass). Smiles weirdly at you no matter what you say. Doesn't teach, weirdos in class teach and snap when you say anything.RUN like hell!

Lots of readings, but they are usually helpful and relevant.  Class discussions are a large part, it helps if the classroom is small.  She's fond of talking about her bunnies at home.  A very decent professor.
she's one of those people you'll just love and hate at the same time. she's also very dry, but super kind and helpful.

i love dr. weinstein! she made me change my major to ant...i've taken her over and over...shes kinda weird, but if u talk with her, shes really understanding and the easiest grader at wcsu! i'v never gotten anything lower than an A. so easy, but shes unclear about testing and changes the syllabus a lot...

She is the worst teacher here. She doesn't know what she's talking about. Unclear, unhelpful, and is shady about tests and answering questions. Don't take her class, she shouldn't be allowed to teach.
Dr. Weinstein is really inspiring. She makes we want to change my major to anthropology.   She tells great stories.

I was very interested in taking this class beforehand, but the professor was horrible and I did not like any of the material learned. We only learned about native americans, and basically nothing else. That's not what I wanted to learn about. NOBODY attended classes because she weas a boring teacher. Don't take this class with her.

This teacher was horrible! Very unclear and didnt make things amusing or fun... Was better off not going to class and just doing the work at home. She didnt tell you exactly what to do and was all over the place! Spare yourself...

Sorry to disagree with everyone but i really do not enjoy her class. I find her narrow minded and if you do not agree with her then you're wrong. Class was easy enough, no one usually shows up. But like i said before, if you don't like narrowminded people, steer clear.
Pretty good class.  other then the 15 hours of community work (which isnt that bad actually.)  shes a decent teacher

really knows her stuff, but it is pretty boring. The 15 community service hrs suck, but it does help. The book about the Cree Indians is really bad, but the Shaman's apprentice book is amazing, i'm not selling that one back. its an okay class
A really great economist.  Make sure you take her for advanced econometrics.

You have to do 15 hours of volunteer work! Not hard but a pain in the butt. Few tests and she gives you an idea of whats on it. One paper in the end on the volunteer work, 2 book to read on anthropology stuff (indians) and participation is a major factor.

Go to his office hours! I know a lot of people who struggled with his class including myself. The reason I got a good grade in his class was because I would go to his office hours every chance I got and made sure he had an understanding that I was truly struggling but trying my best to improve. He better explained the material one on one.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Caring

reviews.comment: Honestly a terrible teacher. Doesn't explain how to do certain problems, and makes the work much harder than it should be. Also speaks very broken English. DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If I have absolutely no choice, only then I will take a class with her again. I did a course with her in 2008. I would not take another course with her if I have a choice.
She is a wonderful teacher an a really nice lady!

I loved Dana as a teacher.  She was very informative and had such interesting real life examples to apply to the material. She really helped me with my project and was funny too!  I will definitely take another class with her!
Another teacher who doesn't really teach.  She simply reads power points to you and then quizzes you using an auto marking website (which costs you $25).
She is very hard marker, always read power points and nobody likes her class.

I came into this class w/o any knowledge of Python. Material is pretty easy to learn with minimal effort. Prof A is really organized with her course structure and grading criteria. Lectures important for project! I recommend investing in taking notes on lectures at beginning of semester for an easy breeze during project time at the end of semester.

Awesome prof! This class does require some work, but it's pretty easy. She understands students have lives and other classes, so she posts the whole semester workload in advance. You can choose to get ahead if you would like. Lots of reading required to get a good score on quizzes. Lockdown, no cam. Reading material free. Just take the class :)

Honestly a great teacher. She knows what she's doing. Very organized and helpful. The things she makes you do in class and for homework are definitely helpful in the career world. She's an easy grader and provides a lot of feedback. Also super laid back and easy to get a hold of.

Hands down one of the best professors I've had at SJSU. Extremely concise when lecturing. Outlines everything that is expected of you. A LOT of homework the first 3/4 of the semesters, then you're just left with a group project. The coding part is intimidating but she encourages to ask for help. Overall a great teacher!!

It is expected you are proficient in programming (python) before enrolling in this class since it is needed here. All is laid out nicely, all assignments, quizzes, exams, and project due dates are out to see. It is recommended to have a good group since parts of the semester-long project have due dates. Do your part and you will pass

The first, most important objective within this class is to find group members that are willing to put in the effort for the group project since a majority of your grade will derive from group assignments. Professor Albert is clear on what she wants for the assignments and will clarify them even further for students.

Awful teacher, wanted students to learn coding with bad guidance, expects you figure it out your own and race through learn. Will ding you unnecessary. Very disrespectful teacher, thinks she is the queen of the world. Bad class, bad learning, needs training so she can teacher better. Avoid Leslie Albert.
Easy A if you show up and do your assignments. She's a great professor but make sure to get a good group for the final project or you'll end up having to do all of the work yourself

She is amazing. She is very organized and thorough about how your work should be completed. practically gives you the code for your projects, and homework is straightforward and she gives you time in class to complete so its basically classwork and you get to work with the people around you as well as ask for her help. about two quizzes per week.
First 2 weeks of the semester, MAKE SURE you find people who are extremely good at coding. If not you'll have a miserable and stressful semester.

Pretty good prof. Alot of assignments are already open online which you can complete ahead of time. First half of the class are mainly python crash courses reviews. Last half is the group project, which she gives you 90% of the code already. Makes sure you get a good group because it will help you alot in the final project.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Make sure you get a good group! I got a bad one and ended up doing practically all the work. We still got an A because I was good at coding but if I wasnt with the groupmates I had we all would have failed. It is mainly a huge group project so the members are crucial so make sure to get good ones. And attending class also helped.

Great professor. Her lectures were good, has clear grading criteria. She tells you what she expects. Prof. A gave examples on what she wanted/didn't want. I suggest attending lectures; really helps with the coding group project. She gives some in class assignments and weekly quizzes to do before class. It's easy, just remember to complete it!

This class requires you to have a clear understanding of Python. The whole class will revolve around python; all the in class work will be coding. There is a group project which is annoying but it is a huge part of the overall grade so find some good partners. Couple chances for extra credit. She is also quite the looker.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is not clear in her instructions, most of the class is confused. Lectures do not cover much just the bare minimum. Spent majority of beginning of semester learning how to work in groups rather than actually doing our group project. Coding is not easy for most ppl and she did not offer help. Sassy and has attitude of a know it all.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: A virtual MIS experience! Dr. Albert packs essential, real-world activities into the semester. It is the warm-up for your practicum, and career. As someone working in IT, I can tell you that Dr. Albert will push you slightly less than your future boss will. She presents a great opportunity for you to learn. This course is why you are an MIS major!
Straight forward. Python group project super simple, due at the end of the semester. Professor Albert is so far the only adequate MIS instructor that Ive had at SJSU.
grades harshly and is contradictory about her expectations

Assignments, group project, quizzes and a final. Make sure you are in a group that is dedicated and at least one person knows how to code. The final is worth a little more than the project so make sure you do well on that. Overall decent class.

Probably one of the best classes and professor to take. Easy A or solid B by just finishing the semester long project. The project is super easy too because she literally gives you the answers. You don't have to be an expert on coding because her lectures have the project template for you. Overall a great professor and is always there to help.

People would say that the projects is hard because they don't have a background in coding but she literally gives you 50% of your project's code on a silver platter. You are just expected to do is fill in the blanks which can be easily done by either taking the code from the book or actually go to class because everyone ditches class.
she doesnt know coding. I dont know why she got high rating. she doesnt really teach coding, but want us to finish our project by learning ourselves.
the group project is hellla hard if you don't know how to code. no book no instruction. do it on you own. Visual basic is outdated and yet we need it for this class. Why???????????? waste of time
Quite attractive woman. Class is coo too i guess. Project base with no midterm and 10 multiple choice quiz. Quite beautiful though... ;p

Prof. Albert works remote, but generally the resources she puts online helps to be aware of what MIS will bring. The class is based off of working on a group project which helps people understand how to work with creating a project while communicating effectively with a group on a project.

She is no longer in California and teaches remotely from Illinois, which makes the dynamic a bit weird. You have about 12 5-min long online quizzes which are open book and a Final & some misc. work -- no midterm . Class is made around the big class project, which is easy if you manage time well. Our group met at least 2x a week outside of class.

Dr. Albert is a very intelligent person when it comes to teaching. She will break down concepts until students can grasp it. She is very helpful during her office hours and will guide students throughout the course project. Her industry technique with weekly deliverables helps students be on schedule with the project due date. Definitely recommend

Dr. Albert is a very descriptive professor. She will review previous concepts to refresh you memory. She is very helpful during her office hours. Make sure to review her slides and understand coding in Visual Studio. Course project is not too bad because she guides you throughout the way. definitely recommend her for 110A

She is knowledgable in her explanations and will give the feedback of a true professor. Her class is easy for those who are skilled in coding black magic but it will be a difficult class for those who are not so comfortable with Visual Studios. Going to her office hours will provide your team with the help you need so do take advantage of it.

Dr. Albert is extremely intelligent so it can be intimidating to people. However, if you put in the effort and go to office hours you will get to see why she is one of the best professors at SJSU. The class may be hard at times but you will be prepared for challenging work in the future.

Pretty straightforward class. Dr. Albert is very nice and approachable. She really cares for her student and wants them to pass. Would take her again in the future. 1 MT, 1 Final, 1 Project, and 5 Homeworks.
Dr. A is intimidating at first but she's actually really nice. Very helpful! Classes were interesting. Wish the project was worth more since I spent so much time on it.

Dr.A is one of the best professors at SJSU. She is really knowledgeable. Its really awesome there is no book for the class. College text books are just TMI and her readings and lectures are concise and to the point. She grades pretty generously and the term project was really fun. The only bad thing I can say about her is that she is an Apple hater

She's a good teacher but she changed her format a lot this semester! There is no book, so posts discussions on the website. And, there's only one midterm and one final. The project isn't worth as much as we'd like so do good on the exams! She's really nice to talk to you though.

Definitely one of the top profs. at SJSU! She is quite attractive and intelligent, which can be somewhat intimidating. However, I assure you she does not bite! She is ALWAYS willing to help students out. She is also down to earth and pretty darn funny! Being in her class was AWESOME!!! I never wanted to miss class.

I am very disappointed with her. What is the point of peer evaluation at the end of the project if she gives 100% to everyone. All the slackers got points for doing absolutley nothing. And I didn't understand her lectures at all. She was so fast! She does not care if you understand or not. I think she should change her teaching style.

Well she's alright. I think that her lectures are pretty hard. She speaks too fast so it's hard to follow sometimes. Sometimes she helps only one group on the whole class period which I don't think is fair. Midterms were pretty straight forward. Pay attention in class since she doesn't require book. I feel it would help if she should require it.

This is one of the best professors I've had at this University. She's funny, gives real life examples, and smart! I actually liked coming to class. To get that A grade: you need to attend class, most of her essay questions for tests are in her lecture. She hands out study guides. Cases are simple if you apply yourself. Quizzes are from the PPT

She is a great teacher and you will learn alot from her. She is really smart and helpful, not to mention she is really hott too!! Only kind of down fall is that the class is difficult if you dont pay attention, so pay attention. Too bad she is married.....
Just Awesome. Right to the point, there for help and WILL help you to a further extent. easy to talk to, outgoing and best of all MAKES THE CLASS INTERESTING

Dr. Albert is very brilliant. Sometimes her answers are so complicated it's hard to understand what she is saying. The group work is a large part of the course. If you did not do well in 92 then do not expect to do well in 110A. Quiz material is so easy it's hard. RFP 'suggestions' are mandatory.

Alert her ASAP on project complications, offers plenty of EXC, will help you on term project as long as you're not brain-dead, 6 HW's, 2 MD + Final [all on Blackboard, inclass]. Nicest, caring teacher I have met.

Outstanding professor.  Her tests could be hard for some but grading is extremely fair.  Ensure she is informed if group is not pulling their weight on project. Knock out as much Harvard Business School work ASAP to work on project and use the NING website when in doubt.

I highly recommend this professor. She is very well versed in programming in general and explains MS Visual Basic clearly.  The project was on the difficult side, and prior programming knowledge is very helpful. She is willing to sit with you to go over your code and even redo the project to troubleshoot.

good teacher, way better at explaining vb than ROLDAN will ever be. class is pretty straight forward, hw and quizzes r pretty easy. Group project is HIGHLY involved and will probably decide your grade in the course assuming u get good grades on hw and quizzes. so find a good group otherwise ur screwed. cool class, cool teacher.

Knowledge of VB is assumed, since BUS 92 is a prereq., but she does a quick review of the main topics. Course project is highly involved. Uses VB and Access. You are given a lot of autonomy for the project, and it's due at the end of the semester in lieu of a final.

The class is an advance version of 92. If you took Roldan in 92 then this is a breeze because Prof Albert is more lenient on your coding and is willing to help you if you have any questions. Project was a bit hard, but she helps you through it. Overall it was a great class.

She is an awesome teacher! Very helpful & good at keeping our interest. She gives test reviews before midterms & has a tutorial day for the labs. A challenging class but not too hard. Have to write 5 case studies & do a few technology related projects (like create a facebook, etc). Super easy quizzes each class. I would definitely take her again.

The class is not bad at all. She doesn't mind if you are wrong when answering a question as long as someone answers because then she understands that people don't understand. You have 4 2/3-page cases to answer but they are nothing to stress. Worry about using Access. Most don't know it, she explains it and some dude grades it (toughly). Take her.

Hyperactive, goes too fast, thinks all students are ready for exotic programming, so she races through 3 chapters a week = figure it out on your own. Knows how to do the stuff, but doesn't teach it well. First reaction to honest comments is always defensive. However, in the end, she did respond to pleas for mercy, and backed off on the workload.

She is a great teacher and very helpful.  Lectures are fun in my opinion as she involves the class, so it does not get boring.  Exams are straight to the point as well as assignments.  She gives extra credit options too!  Highly recommended.

Gives close to 50 pages of readings per week. Wont let you ask questions during midterms. Also very uneducated about mobility issues and takes it upon herself to label these people as couch potatoes.

This was the best class I have taken at uOttawa. It was always interesting and fun to participate in. The prof is amazing and VERY fair when it comes to the exams. if you go to class and read your notes a couple times before the exam you can do well, but it's helpful if you're an auditory learner. She brings movies and candy some classes too!

One of the most horrible profs I've ever had...  Does not post everything online and expects you to know everything. She even asks uncovered questions in the exam to test your general knowledge... as if I have time to watch the news daily. My lowest grade ...

If you are taking this class for actually getting some knowledge out of it, don't do it. If you are just getting in for an easy A, you are good to go.  I found that while some lectures were interesting (2), most of them were very repetitive and did not actually yield any good. The tests are extremely easy, just memorize presentations the same day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, I recommend her to everybody. Class was solid, no textbook but weekly readings are absolutely required. There's not much on her slides and she also leaves some out during lectures so you must go to class to get the correct info. Just by sitting and listening you'll get a great mark.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: horrible. uOttawa is famous for providing profs that have zero knowledge in the actual course. Pretty sure shes a polisci prof. for a second year elective course, it was my heaviest class. all cumulative. ridiculous testing methods

Really nice prof and a interesting lecturer, she really cares a lot about this subject and it made taking the course really that more interesting. She can be a bit stats heavy on exams but she generally hints at this in class. Know definitions from the textbook and general themes from it as well. No project, fair exams. Taking class again with her
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: A nice professor, course content is really interesting but she asks very obscure questions  on tests from something she said one time during class or a tiny detail from the textbook. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Honestly, she is one of the best teachers I've had! Her way of teaching is amazing, her goals are set and as long as you listen in class, you will easily pass. Alright, to simplify things: AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS. Why? Textbook? get ready to memorize all the definitions cover to cover. 4. Gd luck if you have her!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Does not give clear expectations for exams, marking scheme is obscure and makes no sense. It is very difficult to get in contact with her if you cannot attend her office hours. Based on her lectures you would assume her course is a breeze,  although boring as she repeats examples and basic information. However, the questions on the midterms are not straight forward and are often about small details or material she decided to cover after the test. Long answer question are 1/2 pg but 20 marks. Not worth it! Avoid if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I believe this was her first time teaching the course and it definitely shows. She is extremely confused, jumps around topics a lot and has zero flow. Asked questions on the midterm regarding minute details that weren't even mentioned in class, that being said midterms and final are super easy. Seems genuinely nice, just a terrible professor.

She is prejudice and if you are a person of colour stay away from this lecturer. She does not when her white liberal feminism is challenged and lack knowledge on many issues. Do not take her class! The people that liked her class were the ones who accepted her mediocrity.

Goes on tangents which take away from the overall learning time so we didn't cover everything. Heavily based on FEM content despite being a SOC course. Teaches her beliefs as fact and does not accept being challenged by students. Tests names of authors and menial facts, but exams and assignments are easy overall if you read and attend lectures.

She was pleasant to deal with and seemed like a very fair marker. She has a loud voice so it was easy to hear her speak from the back of the room. Couple tricky questions on exams and a LOT of reading. Overall, I enjoyed the course and it was useful. Lots of examples for course material to help you understand the concepts too. :)

Great prof who is very clear but not so helpful. Class is interesting and easy material however her midterm was tricky using the best answer m/c and heavy readings based. Do the readings, go to class, study lots and make sure you are aware of definitions versus stats and specifics. Enjoy the profs lectures and videos given they are very pertinent.
Enjoyed the lectures, she is a great lecturer, no papers, two midterm and final, just make sure you do the readings.

Very easy course. Louise is a great lecturer and gives you all the information you need to succeed. Lectures are long and breaks are short, so it can get pretty uncomfortable. Do not skip class, lots of things she talks about in class she will not post on blackboard. Lectures have a very feminist under tone, but that's not a big deal tbh.
Phenomenal professor. Best course do far!
Great prof, great course.

To put this debate to end , yes her lectures can be somewhat boring and long. No this course is not extremely difficult. And absolutely she turns it into a feminism class. Which in my opinion was disappointing because I felt I learned more about what women didn't do and what women couldn't be a part of than the actual history that occurred.
Such a good professor, really engaging. I dont know why so many people are bashing her here. If you study what she tells you to study it is an easy A Totally would take another class with her

Yes, she teaches the course from a feminist viewpoint. Women have always been suppressed in the fields of science and health care.  She's opening our minds to what a textbook doesn't mention. The content of the course is fairly straight-forward. Show up to class and do the readings, and you're golden. Very kind woman and cares about your success!

Louise is an amazing prof! I'm not sure what others mean when they say her lectures are dry. I never found her lectures boring, and the class was from 7-10. Her tests are not hard if you read her notes from class and the assigned chapters - there are absolutely no surprises. Always finishes class at least half an hour early. Overall, very friendly!
Not a nice person. Doesn't respond to most emails. And when she does respond, she gives you a sassy answer that is rude and insulting. Overall terrible prof, avoid if possible.

Super boring class. She starts the semester teaching "history of health care" then it because a women's rights course. Every lecture is all about women's roles. Classes are long and boring. Tests and midterms have random questions that aren't worth knowing. OH and you have to do volunteer hours. Overall, terrible prof. Great TA. Sucks for us Engs.

The readings are an insult to my intellectual capacity, they lack material that could keep ones mind stimulated. She doesn't respond to emails in a timely fashion. Her marking rubric only works if you write what is aligned with her views. Disappointing class. You can learn what she teaches by doing your own research.

The class lacked the critical component because this woman is not well versed in the topics. Contains problematics views on race and class. She doesn't email back in a timely manner and be careful if you aren't a speaker but a excellent writer she will try and charge you with  Plagiarism. Not a good lecturer.
Interesting material. Prof is engaged and attempts to engage class. Covers history and global information. Tests on historical facts. Posts slides with notes removed to blackboard.

I'm mortified that she can't  accept her students questioning and challenging her  arguments, that is the point of school and that is to think! She is an unfair marker, if you write from a perspective that is not aligned with hers,  god help you. If I listened to my friends, I would not have suffered through this class.

She repeats a lot of content. Her wording of assignments and exams is problematic, but as long as you know what she is looking for it is easy to produce. She teaches a feminism course yet a lot of the time some of the statements she makes and language she uses is problematic. Nice woman though.

Great prof! She was helpful and recommended good resources for my final paper. About 20% of her exams are based on the readings, if you want anything over a B to B+, you need the textbooks. Lectures were  interesting and well structured. Only complaint is thats sometimes she got defensive when students challenged her or raised questions.

i don't know why this prof has such bad reviews. I am taking her class on gender work and reproduction and i feel she really is a great prof. she always starts the class off with real world connections to the material we are covering, and i feel she really puts her heart and soul into prepping and teaching the course. Lectures can be a bit dry.

If I could turn the hands of time back, I would never have taken this class with a witch like her. I hate her with a passion. She works against her students, and is not helpful. She is RUDE and not a nice woman. Her wrinkled face will forever be etched in my mind as the worst person at Ottawa University. She should be removed from Ottawa University
Lectures are boring. Takes forever to answer emails, and is never available after office hours.

Fun lectures and interesting course material but marking scheme faulty as far as properly demonstrating knowledge of material. Unclear expectations and an inability to accept different interpretations of material.
Great prof!! Easy class if you take the time to study and take notes in class. great prof
I hated this class
One of my favourite professors at the University! Love attending her classes she is very helpful
really nice! easy class, she even took us out for beer and nachos at the end of the semester! i would definitely have her as a prof again!

This is probably the worst prof I have ever had at the university of Ottawa, her tests and midterms do not reflect coure material whatsoever. She asks random questions that aren't even releveant. Questions don't show if you understand the course. STAY CLEAR OF THIS PROF'!!!!!!!!!
This was one of my favourite classes taken while at the University of Ottawa. All the people in POL with negative comments probably failed and never went to class. Louise Rocks!!!!!!

This prof is so unprofessional. She was 5-15 minutes late for every class, late for office hours too, ridiculously late in handing back assignments, is not knowledgeable about subject matter, is not approachable, she should not be teaching at all. Would have to agree with the other comments.  A genuinely nice person, however, this professor is not accountable for her choices or actions and instead blames others.  Takes an egregious and unprofessional amount of time to hand back grades and hand out assignments.  Changes her course outline at will.

Awful professor. Works against students. Always full of excuses. Takes FOREVER to get marks back. Unwilling to reconsider grades. Changes syllabus randomly. Too many assignments. Promises class time for group projects but gives none. Gives HUGE numbers of reserve readings (more than in the $70 of textbooks). Never answers questions directly.

Disorganized, late for class, does not attend office hours, condescending, bias, too much focus on group work, expectations unclear, does not touch textbooks, useless guest lectures, exams are ok but too long, not open to suggestions or constructive criticism.

BEST TEACHER EVER !! He's so nice and he understand us as students so he's not tough on us. He's fair in his corrections and do not be afraid to ask for feedback. You can easily bond with him over non-school stuff so coming to his classes/labs is amazing. Second time with him and I would take another class with this teacher if possible lol

I had him as my lab TA and he was amazing. To have only one class and then write a lab report on an experiment done in the lab could be confusing. But Lucas was so helpful and would always give us so many detailed explanations. Literally all you have to do is ask him if you're on the right track and he'll tell you. Such a positive experience.

Talk about a complex exam.... The majority of the exam is application questions and as previously stated by other students, they are quite the challenge and seem over the top when comparing what you study and what you have to answer.

The class is pretty difficult. The midterm and final was tough- mostly applications. The labs are a lot of work but honestly the context of the course and lab was very interesting in my opinion. Lucas was patient, understanding and extremely available outside of class hours for anyone who needed it!

reviews.comment: If there is something you dont understand take the time to go to his office hours. He will give a good explanation and will help you understand the concept! If you put the effort it you will do fine in this class

Horrible prof. I can't believe i wasted tuition on this filth.

uses computer to teach instead of writing it out. has a heavy accent

He is a caring prof who is very competent.

Professor Russell made CCDP fun and tolerable by keeping things practical and applicable to our careers. He was also very forgiving and lenient with deadlines when other classes we're getting tough. Best Professor!! ever he truly cares for all his student. I would love if he takes other subjects.
ok

reviews.comment: This class wasn't that difficult but he is just the worst. How does the university even find teachers like this?!

Text-to-speech lectures: the hell you didn't know existed and wish you had never lived. Unless you want to spend hours listening to professor robot each week, avoid at all costs.
Don't waste your money

Prof. Luke is one of the nicest profs at Carleton. Clear course outline for "Research Methods". Prof. Luke made this course stress-free (a must to have thing for graduate students). Luke is a great prof for CCDP, he cares about the students and wants them to do well. He challenges students to make them better presenters and writers. He would be 5/5 if he cuLearn page was layout better. That thing was a mess to find anything.

He good. His class be good. Fun guy. Nice class. Pick a nice team.
Very easy class, lovely prof. Weekly assignments and quizzes are very helpful. Very slow and methodical which means it's hard to miss the important points. :)
Material was extremely easy, work load was minimal. Not super interesting but that's more the topic than her; she's a good speaker and very easy to interact with.
Professor Schriemer provided multiple extra-credit assignments and made it easy to get a good grade. Course material was interesting.

She is amazing! She knows how to engage people for 3hrs. Her class was SUPER fun. Opportunities to work in desired fields, and create personal career goals. The class was very homework heavy. With 2 assignments and a quiz every week, you have to at least put in an hour or 2 almost daily. reviews.comment: Course seems hard at first but if you go to lectures she makes it easy.

This class was mandatory and seemed really boring, but she makes it interesting. She's really down to earth and relatable, which makes lectures so much more enjoyable. She never kept us the full three hours. Her slides are pretty thorough so it's fairly easy to catch up if you miss a class.
Most lenient professor at uottawa. If you have any English courses take it with her.

Hate English courses but this professor was amazing. Very straight to the point in lectures. Tells you exactly what she wants in assignments so it's easy to get good grades if you follow her advice. Good portion of the grade comes from attendance as well, so it's easy to do well. Managed to make grammar and report formatting lectures not boring.
Very nice teacher

She is a very good professor. She gave very detailed feedback, which helped me improve my writing skills. She was always willing to answer questions. Attendance was worth 15% of our grade. She randomly takes attendance 6 times during online class.
Great professor, kind, conveys matters effectively and gives us examples. Assessments reflect what we learned in class, which definitely helps with learning. Would take again for sure.
If you have ENG1112 take it with her.
y

Prof Morrissey is a very good prof that knows that students have a lot on their plate. She has weekly assignments but tells you the answers at the DGDs. Attendance was not mandatory though she did take attendance 6 times randomly and that accounted towards your mark. Overall really good professor!

Never went to class but she basically gives the answers to weekly exercises and grammar quiz (15% & 10% of grade respectively) if you go, they're easy enough anyway though. Incredibly clear grading criteria and useful feedback given on assignments. Low workload, just put in some effort and listen to her feedback and you'll get an easy A.
Awesome prof
Very clear on what she expects, gives good feedback on proposals to help you improve on the final essay. If you go to class she basically tells you what's on the grammar quiz. Great prof altogether.

reviews.comment: This course is definitely not the easiest course but the professor made everything so easy. Highly recommend her.

Fantastic Professor! She is very professional but also made a few jokes here and there to keep things light. Her class is easy! In part because it is light on content, no final exam just a final report, but also because she is very clear about her expectations and she prepares you very well for each assignment. She is also a very fair grader!
She's a caring and funny professor who makes course expectations clear.

Super easy class! She understands that the course is boring and tries to make it interesting :) 2 quizzes, 2 assignments, and a take home final (all super easy) if you go to class she'll tell you EXACTLY what will be on the quiz
Easiest class ever taken.

Very easy class, super light work load, you just have to make sure you keep track of when things are due. Lectures are not mandatory, she posts everything online and everything from the quizzes are in the slides.

Took Professor Morrissey for Technical Report Writing as a requirement in 1st year engineering. Best professor teaching the course by far! Easiest A+ with the least amount of work possible. Only need to focus on 1 report the whole semester and the quizzes are straight from the powerpoint.

Amazing professor that knows a lot about her subjects. She's funny and is bound to make you smile. With that said, lectures are not mandatory for success and minimal notes need to be taken. Simply reading the slides and writing clear and concisely will ensure you do well!

Explains clearly everything you need to know/do on assignments and quizzes. Quizzes are based solely on lecture presentations. Discussion groups are mostly open sessions. Very organized. Highly recommend her. Little amount of work, so each task worth a lot. Easy marker.
Easiest course you'll ever attend, no work and easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The lecture content itself is a little boring, but she tries to finish it as fast as she can. You just need to write 2 quizzes (the content is very clear on her lecture notes posted online), no final exam (write a report in advance at home and bring it on a certain day). And she also provide a model report. You can absolutely imitate it.

The course is very boring and easy, but she does her best to teach it. Only one lecture per week, two easy quizzes and two very easy assignments, but start your final report early instead of having to write 15 pages during exam season. I did badly in every high school English course but this was a breeze.
By far the easiest prof for this class. You can not attend class and easily get an A+.
Horrifically boring class, but she does her best to make it bearable. Next to no coursework aside from the final report and much easier grading than high school english.
super nice and helpful, makes herself very clear. boring course but helpful

Take your technical report writing with her! She is absolutely amazing. You will most likely be bored during lectures but that's because the material is so dull. There will be 2 tests that are easy A's plus a paper that will require work but is still aceable.
Took it for engineering. She's the easiest english teacher (because there are a lot)! Ridiculously easy and a complete bird course. The course is very boring but she's really chill.
Very clear prof, read her lectures and youll be good to go. Work on the final report throughout the semester so you dont have too much to do near the end. Quizes are super easy and worth 30%.

She is honestly the best prof. You could ever ask for! Very straight forward,  listen to her lectures and review them as a lot of them end up on the mid terms and she's super friendly. The only real work in this course was the final report, the prof is very clear (english prof) and helpful. but be careful not to miss a quiz like I did since each is worth 15%

The nice thing about her is she's the type of Professor who knows her stuff and teaches it well. Spots to get in her class are race, really! The only problem is that she teaches a very dry subject so it would be quite obvious if her classes seem dull in interest.
very good prof, very helpful, nice about this prof is that there are only two quizzes which are grammar from high school   and a final report were she isn't strict  in giving the mark
Great prof, definetly got me more interested in english. if you have her you are very lucky. all around great prof

Great class! She rewards those who attend and participate! The lectures were always pretty interactive and the readings were interesting. Great Prof. Nice Lady. Easy marker. Easy midterms. She gives everyone a fair opportunity to do well in her course. If you attend the lectures and read the stories, you'll do great. The stories were relatively easy and the novels were short.

Fabulous professor. She goes out of her way to help her students and makes class as interesting as possible. Both the midterm and final were extremely easy as were the papers. I would recommend trying to GET INTO her class, believe me its worth it A+
EASY! we read lik e8 short stories the whole semester, and her novels are kids novels! midterm and final EXTREMELY easy ( like easy A+)but she makes papers hard so it balances out.
tres bon professeur et connais bien sa matiere
Impossible a lire son ecriture   pas claire du tout..
Vraiment facile a comprendre. Sa prends une couple de semaines a s'habituer, mais si tu fais sur de rester a jour avec les exercices et que tu comprends, sa session d'exercices est très utile.

He explains everything like 20 times
Excellent teacher loves what he does and it shows.

A genuine person who enjoys interacting with his students. Reads off the slides which can be boring at times, but he tries to make it interesting with class discusssions. His dedication to student growth and ability to simplify challenging topics truly stand out.

Professor Majed is always approachable and genuinely invested in his students' success. His teaching style is clear and engaging, making complex concepts easy to grasp. If you stay attentive and review his materials, you'll find yourself well-prepared and confident.

A lot of contradictions and not enough conscientiousness.

Nothing to complain about.

Professor Majed cares a lot about his students and helps them when needed. The lectures were simple and easy to understand. Also, if you follow what he says and re-read the slides, be sure to succeed.

Amazing person. Such a joy to be around. I am so thankful that a spot opened up in this class. Best mark I got this year. Practice, do the homework and participate and you will do great.
