Thanks for making an exam that is like your lectures without surprises! i will miss you!
Love her! She is a very nice prof and is passionate about her work. Would take again.

Great professor! I attended all of her classes so the exams were so easy. She gave us a paper to write for bonus marks. I love her she is amazing. 

Take any course with her!!

Loved her! She posts a lot of extra readings/videos + mandatory TB, never did any of that and still did great. Go to lectures bc you will have to study less. Only spent 2 days studying for final! Midterm was easy but u still need to study. Paper is a grade booster if you can write well. Bonus 3% for course reflection! Love her for that.

Very nice professor 
Her exams are easy for students who attend all classes and read the textbook!

I had the privilege of taking Professor Fseifes's course, and it was truly an exceptional experience. Professor Fseifes demonstrates an extraordinary passion for the subject matter, making even the most complex topics accessible and engaging. 

I highly recommend taking this course with her!
Not sure how the Prof does it, but he turns such a fun topic like marketing into something dreadful.
The simulation was impossible. The report no matter how much you write you won't recieve a good grade. Lectures were boring
Stay away from this prof, hands down the worst one at the University.

Unlike most of these reviews, I found him to be decent of a professor, until the final exam, which definitely was questionable and had lots of errors. His grading in my opinion wasn't as bad as the reviews, but after the midterm it did get worse. He is definitely an entertaining prof but he doesn't cover the class content well at all.
RUN GUYS, HE'S A NIGHTMARE

5% of your grade is subject to how much he remembers you. Made us come in a snowstorm to write a midterm. Easy class overall if you study the textbook. Marketing simulation quite fun, fair grader on papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very subjective when it comes to parts of grading and does not give the reminders on brightspace. Also, takes off way too many marks for small reasons. Also, does not reply to emails quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor at the University. Does not care about his students or how he is perceived as an instructor. Careless and lazy. Avoid taking his class at all costs unless you like wasting your time.

He needs to pick a new profession. He's lazy which causes disorganization. I've never seen so many grammatical errors on an exam before. Disrespectful to student by quickly shutting them down in emails by saying, “ there's nothing I can do for you”. He cares deeply about his rating on this site. Pretty sure these 5 star reviews are created by him.

Professor Bayan is straight up awful. He will complain that we are behind schedule but it is his fault as he will constantly go off on tangents about things that have very little relevancy to the topic, like constantly talking about his ratemyprof, then make us read the rest of the textbook. I suggest picking a different prof, stay far from Manoj
Manoj ur not him, these 5 stars are such fakes
yo bro u are not slick, get off your burner manoj

Professor Bayan is a great professor who cares about his students. Just like any other class, you need to study and put in effort. His midterm was very straightforward and followed a similar format to the questions posted on Brightspace. If you have any concerns/questions about the course or content, he is always willing to address or answer them.

Professor Manoj Bayan is fair, and engaging, and makes the class dynamic. He uses real-world examples that help us understand better and always clearly explains what's expected of us, which makes it easier to stay organized and prepared. He's supportive, always willing to help, and truly cares about students' success. I enjoyed the course!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hands down the best professor Ive ever taken. He covers the material well and covers the majority of the content without being boring. I highly recommend taking him if you have the chance. Ps. Ignore all the bad comments they're complaining because they requested regrading and lost marks.
Hands down the best professor I've ever taken. His lectures are so clear and contain the majority of the content without making it too boring. If you have the opportunity to take him, do it !!!!!

He quickly glazes over important course material and spends lots of time discussing real world examples that go off topic easily. Provides vague instructions for deliverables and refuses to repeat himself if clarification is sought. Grading is completely subjective for in-class participation and the midterm where he aims for a C class average.
:( Very. Bad
Very poor proffesor, lectures are very scattered and makes the class boring.

Very boring professor with a hard to understand accent. The professor shows no empathy with midterms, and is very selfish because he doesn't move around a mid term which is during class time to another day, risking the safety of its students and defying requests by first responders to stay home and prevent potential issues.

A horrible prof who did not move the exam date even though there was a huge snow storm. Now  since i live 30 minutes from school on a nice sunny day so probably 50 with this snow and a very high chance of me crashing, i have to pay 60$ to defer when he could have simply moved the date or made it online.  Manoj is unique to say the least
no comment
Professor Bayan is no bad person, but he constantly goes off-topic and his pronunciation is not clear, I won't take his course again and I took his course cuz he had a monopoly on this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I came into the course expecting something else cause of all the ratings I saw on Rate Your Prof but this prof is nothing like the ratings! IDK why people were saying all that about him, this professor cares, is helpful, and takes the time to make engaging slides and lectures. Put in the time and effort and you'll easily succeed in his class.

Prof Bayan is a nice guy who cares about his students. He always takes his time to throughly explain each concept and makes sure everyone's on track! Idk why there's some poor ratings on him, he's honestly a great prof and has great knowledge about what he teaches. He's also always available for his students. Overall, well respected prof!
The professor is very kind and cares about his students. His lectures are engaging and he has multiple exchanges with students. PROFESSOR MANOJ YOU ROCK!!

He is difficult to understand and he speaks very quickly and quietly. He's a very smart and nice guy but it's recommended to get into another stream of this class. Interesting content however the group project is difficult if you do not know people in the class. Be creative and optimistic!!

The professor is very hard to understand as we jump back and forth between chapters for the first bit of class.  Additionally, the graphics on the slides are cut off so it is important to pay attention in class.  Some positives is that the professor is always in class on time, and dismisses class also on time.
Manoj is an amazing professor! He's very concise with his delivery of the course material, and he's such a chill guy too.

Class is always interactive and engaging. You get to learn a lot of concepts about marketing. The professor uses real-life examples of relevant companies to strengthen concepts, making the material much easier to learn. Cool class!
He is very fair! :)
Loved his classes

Bayan is genuinely a good prof, why else would it be so hard to get into his classes. The wait lists are so long, I barely got in on time. I genuinely don't understand the hate. His lectures are very entertaining, he remembers his students by name, and pulls real world examples into his classes. All the bad ratings come from the same IP address🙈
He is a very nice Professor; many students don't even attend his general class, so he receives hate. But he is one of Telfer's better professors and the funniest up there with Professor Astarasky.

Taken him twice and he's very nice and engaging. I grouped up with a studious friend and other decent people making it an easier experience so look out for that. He is a tough grader assuming he has high expectations. Meet after class or at office hours to understand what those expectations are - then you'll be fine.

Professor Bayan is extremely frustrating to have as a professor. He constantly goes off topic and spends the entire lecture on 10 slides, even when the whole presentation has an average of SEVENTY. As a Marketing major, I hope never to have a professor like this again because it might make me change majors.

All the reviews are real. This guy grades so insanely unnecessarily hard. If you miss one aspect of a question, regardless of how well the rest of the question was answered, you will be given a 60% for that question. Will say good attempt then give a C-. Loves to be incredibly vague with what will be tested aswell
He's a really nice prof, lectures weren't that useful, you can learn everything from the textbook. Just make sure you have a good group and you should do well!

I don't think he's as bad as the other reviews describe him. I think he is aware of his negative reputation and stated at the beginning of the semester that he would try to change. He is fine at explaining concepts and all necessary info for exams is on the slides. The midterm is tough but final is much easier and the marketing simulation is fun.

If I can give any piece of advice, it would be to never take a class with him. The university should really consider letting him go. He doesn't really teach. You need to read the textbook to pass the class. He is also a tough grader which is interesting since he's an awful teacher.

Many people have told me he's the worst prof at Telfer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Manoj is possibly the most mind-numbingly boring professor ever to exist. I truly don't understand how he can make Marketing a boring, excruciating, time-consuming course -yet he somehow pulls it off. His lectures are the textbook verbatim, with random answers for the midterm dropped in it. So you MUST attend his horrible lectures. SWAP/DROP IF CAN
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Honestly the worst prof I've ever had. He is very nice. However, he does not teach. Everything is based on the textbook. He gives absolutely no feedback, he just says "that is wrong" but does not tell us how it is wrong. He is also extremely boring and marks participation but no one participates. He is very subjective and a tough grader.

Very difficult to understand and boring. Most of class never shows up.

Doesn't follow slides, talks off topic. No idea what to study out of 100's of slides when preparing for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very frustrating professor, seems disorganized at times, often goes over class time, has too many slides that he doesn't have enough time to go through, and does not answer any emails. Instructions for the simulation reports and the examples provided are very helpful, but portions of the grade like for participation/assignments are very unclear.

Super boring professor. He made marketing seem to be so dull. The textbook is more helpful than going to his classes. Uses a lot of irrelevant examples and is unclear about midterm and finals expectations. He also had weird participation criteria.
Average prof but the class was super interesting!

I was in both his RELI 350 and RELI 360 classes for fall 2024 and he is extremely knowledgeable. I love Eastern religions so I find his class very intellectually stimulating but I can understand how many may find it quite demanding, esp in terms of the heavy readings & the bi-weekly quizzes lol. Not the most organized prof but he is very kind!!

Dr. Desjardins is extremely knowledgeable and provides very interesting lectures and readings, although at times very long and a bit all over the place, they're always interesting and relevant. As much as the bi-weekly quizzes are annoying, they're an easy A if you put in the work.

In four years at University I've never had a class so lacking in structure. We bounced around from different countries and topics with no clear direction and lectures confused more than did anything else. Interesting content but really not worth it. His quizzes are also deceptively hard and are every two weeks. I'd avoid.

His Lectures are infuriatingly useless, readings are abusively long and complicated and entire class has no structure. I'm a fourth year and did good in this class only because I learned the material on my own which was more enjoyable. No access to lectures unless you take a photo of them. Sadly, he has no desire to share his knowledge.

Avoid! He doesn't support his students, grades really harshly, and can't even remember what he discussed the last class. I have never regretted keeping a course as much as this one (I'm in my last year), and he purposefully places his first over-ambiguous quiz after the drop date so once you realize the damage, its too late! Don't waste your money!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dry, little use of technology besides text-saturated slides, disorganized. It's a shame because he seems extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the subject, but he's really just not good at teaching. Assignments seemed arbitrary and there was absolutely no feedback given. Very pointless class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great Prof! Absolutely love the Dude! Take him !

Interesting topics and very accessible. He is monotone like another reviewer said but as long as you do your readings (which are heavy, but interesting), show up to class and listen+take notes and in general at least try to get a good grade and not slack off, you will pass. Very nice person as well during office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great professor, kind of traditional in the format of the class: teacher teaches, students listen, in this way and with the (heavy) readings, you get A LOT of info. I think he is a great teacher if you actually want to learn something on the subject of the class; but also if you want good grades because he expectations are super clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Go to an office hour or 2 if you want participation marks.  Handed assignment in a month late after breaking my leg, he did not care. Quizzes easy as long as you study. Textbook only necessary for last minute background info before quizzes. Amazing grade distribution sets you up to do well. Try to be original on annotated bibliography.

The teacher is nice, we take notes in class. The TA are the ones doing all the correcting. The tas for this class are nice and helpful. There are  4 test , he chooses the 3 best . the test involves definitions for terms and one essay question of 300-400 words. easy. and three papers ( two annotation bib and outline paper) . Highly recommended

He's very monotone and it's hard to tell when he lets out a joke. Definitely a lot of reading (3 books for a 200 class). Not the best prof I've had but the fact that you have the answers before the midterm/final, you should be able to do well on the exams. No formal paper, just an essay outline.

Lots of reading, lots of writing, but a fantastic grader that outlines expectations clearly, concisely and gives you incredible feedback. Very open to discussion, very approachable, incredibly friendly. One of the best teachers I've had.

Mr. Desjardins was great. The material is interesting and he has a very subtle & dry sense of humor that you'll catch if you listen closely. All expectations are clearly outlined, and he preps students for quizzes a week in advance. Can't go wrong.

I had him this semester for Religions of Tibet, and being extremely intersted by this topic, he makes it very easy for everyone else to stay captivated as well. Just mke sure you go to class because most of his slidesnotes shown in class end up being really important. Anyways, really good prof. I highly recommend
DesJardins is a very knowledgable and helpful professor. There are a lot of readings required but combined with his powerpoint lectures you will learn a lot and most likely get a good grade.

I have taken 3 classes with Prof. Desjardins, Intro. to Buddhism, Theravada Buddhism and Women and Buddhism. I have found every one of them to be extremely informative, and I learned new and interesting info. each time You get what you put into his classes. He is very fair, and all his comments are helpful and relevant.

Very awesome professor. Yes, you have to read a lot for his course, but why are there people complaining about it? It is a history course after-all and, in order to learn about history, you HAVE to read! Other than that, he's very nice and is always ready to help you out! Easy marker! I recommend him!

Marc is hella smart and knows a lot about Buddhism. The only thing I didn't like about the class were the readings, it's way too much. Let's just say that once you fall behind in the readings, it's game over. He sometimes goes off-topic and people have to tell him to get back on track. If no one does, he'll be rushing through the powerpoints.

Marc is so legit! He knows so much about Buddhism and is a very interesting lecturer. I wish he spoke a bit louder! The TA for the class, Howard, is also incredible. Both very approachable and made the class a worthwhile experience

He definitely knows his stuff and is extremely engaging . It should be recommended for first time students to take his intro to Buddhism before any other classes or they might feel lost.He assigns a lot of reading but it's always very interesting. Marc is my favorite teacher, I've taken quite a few of his classes and am never disappointed.
Mr. Desjardins really knows his stuff.  He is genuinely interested in what he teaches and I found him to be very approachable.
No Comments
Very knowledgeable. Engaging and helpful. Sometimes disorganized but never really to the detriment of the class. Recommended.

Intro to Buddhism.  98% lecture 100% note taking from slides.  Bombarded with way too much information.  Lots of foreign terms and dates memorization.  Very dry and facticious.  No personal engagement. Tests were ambiguous and tricky. Prof very knowledgeable, but not very approachable or available.  I went in excited and came out disenchanted.
Incredibly pompous, moody, and hard to talk to  Belongs at McGill- he will crush you before ever encouraging you
Very nice guy - not too comfortable in front of a class yet - overload of information - not a discussion based class
An easy A professor. He isn't great at navigating Brightspace, but he is very kind. Attending class isn't needed to get a good mark and he rounded by final grade up for me.

If you're in French Immersion, it's a great grade booster. It's an easy course to help you better understand concepts. Overall, good professor, he is nice and understanding. But not good with instructions. Make sure you are constantly checking the assignment tab because he will post it in there, no warning. Exams are easy, open book.

Tbh you are just re-taught what you learnt in the adjacent POL class and the lecture is boring but this was a really easy class. not sure why he is rated so low for an easy A. pretty much complete assignments, and you'll get good grade, not much to it. Take this as a grade booster, but he is sometimes late and is not available outside of class.

Loved Kapenda. He's so kind and helps his students so they're on the right path. Everything is handed on Brightspace even the exams and all of them are literal examples from the lectures. Recommend for an easy A especially if you're in immersion.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class with POL 1501 and that was a huge mistake. The class isn't hard, but he's so unclear in his instructions and his lectures are disjointed and hard to follow. I wouldn't bother with the class, and avoid him too. He seems to be set in his ways and doesn't have any plans to change them. Never responds to emails.

Man, he is a really nice guy and the classes have been pretty easy, but I don't think I learned a single thing from any of his lectures. The assignments were all confusing with rarely any clear instructions. He often showed up late to class, one time even as late as 40 minutes. I can manage his classes but it's definitely not an optimal experience.

Honestly, he's not the best. Don't take it if you want to learn something. He can be challenging to understand, which is a problem as he loves his audio recordings that sound like they were recorded on a potato. But he's a nice guy, and this class is a mark booster. Took it for the fls credit and got just that with no difficulties, so no complaints

I'm actually shocked at some of these ratings lol. I'm an immersion student and his class was amazing for me. His classes cater well to those who learn better by reading and/or listening. The TA was also good with marking and feedback. The exams were pretty straightforward, and there were textual analyses which were quite easy as well.

LOL, he replaced our sick teacher, i didn't attend much of his classes, just read off the slides, he is very boring, not very good teacher. The TAs kinda ruthless at correction, contest your grade if you don't agree, they made a mistake on mine, went from b to a on that assignment. I didn't put much efforts, just be sure to understand what he wants

I would not recommend this class. It's very haphazard and is very hard to follow. He's very unclear regarding the information he teaches. He's not the most engaging. He loves the chalkboard and doesn't use the projector for anything useful. He jumps from topic to topic, most of which is not on the syllabus. He does not follow said syllabus.

While he was a very nice man, and had some moments that made the class engaging - the debates being the best example - usually the class was very poor. There was very little communication between TAs and the prof, leading to miscommunication during tests; he was frequently late; and unfortunately his delivery of the material was not good.

I took this class with ECO 1504, and I think that he's a really easygoing and kind prof. He takes the time to explain concepts and he lets students take leadership roles.  I found this class to be extremely beneficial because we got to spend class time focusing on unclear topics/lectures. I would definitely take this prof again!

Yikes. I had M. Kapenda for two classes this semester (FLS 2581 & POL 1501) and although I have to give him slack for stepping in as a sub for POL two weeks into the semester, it doesn't excuse the fact that he's just a bad teacher. All he does is read off of dull ppts, asks the most senseless "reflection" questions, and NEVER responds to emails.

Nice man but did not seem qualified or prepared to teach the course. Lectures were difficult to follow and many of the readings were unavailable. Course syllabus had errors, and was changed often. Professor was difficult to reach and didn't respond to emails. Course was graded on 2 essays, a midterm exam and a final exam that were take-home.

Mr. Kapenda is a nice guy, but this FLS class was utterly useless. Rather than helping us understand the course material, he taught us new information new, unrelated information. He did not respond to emails quickly or helpfully. The readings he assigned were at a very high level of french, well beyond that of french immersion students.

If I had the choice between taking a class with this prof or a lemur, I'd take the class taught by the lemur. This prof is very boring, has no idea what he's doing, and takes an entire class to read his PowerPoints. There is a very clear lack of communication and don't even try asking questions, even a lemur could give a better answer.

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!! hard to follow, doesn't provide clear guidelines for assignments either on brightspace or in class, NEVER answers emails if you have questions and don't bother asking them in class either he doesn't care. Provides little to no feedback on assignments, syllabus is extremely unclear.

I usually am okay with subpar professors but drop this class. He's often late, doesn't know when class ends, forgets about assignments, teaches stuff unrelated to the course material, and requires the listening of audio files that simply dont work if you do not have a windows PC. It's easier to do the base french course without this class.

DROP HIS CLASS. I took this accompanying class to fulfill my french immersion requirements, and I wish I had taken anything else!!! He is so boring and dull and makes no sense. He forces participation. I sent many emails throughout the semester, and not one has been answered. Announced our midterm the day before. Nice guy but an AWFUL TEACHER

He's nice, a good person. But sometimes people can be good people but absolute garbage at their job. I think this is one of those cases. He'll help you outside of class hours, but I never knew what was going on, the syllabus was unclear, and he was difficult to understand in the way that he didn't ever explain anything well.

I learned absolutely nothing from this course. The prof was often late or confused about what class he was in. This was supposed to be a class to improve comprehension of POL1502, but POL1502 ended up being way easier to follow. His voice is hard to understand and monotonous, nobody was ever listening during class. Very little work in this class.
He's a very sweet person where you feel comfortable in his lectures. Material wasn't too difficult.
Did not respond to a single email I sent all semester.... Since it was on an online class and there was no TA this was very unreasonable.

Prof. Kapenda is the sweetest professor Ive ever had. He is so caring and the nicest man ever. I loved every single one of his classes, I wish I could take it again. The workload is not much, and he marks fairly. 100% recommend. Amazing guy.

I enjoyed having prof Kapenda as a prof. He is kind and is dedicated in helping his students succeed. Its a fairly easy course as long as you hand in your assignments. He may be a dry professor but I was not looking for an entertainer.

Absolute waste of a prof. Came to class 20 minutes late. Would leave in the middle of evaluations. He never had office hours and did not answer emails. He graded arbitrarily and had no reason for giving one student an A+ and another an A. Little direction in class and was a waste of time. Do not take ANY of his classes.

While the class content was very easy, Prof. Kapenda somehow managed to make it both extremely boring and extremely confusing at the same time. He was late to every class, and generally seemed unorganized. Most of his class exercises involved the entire class reading passages from the textbook out loud in unison.

His teaching abilities are lacking, he teaches as though he is giving an oral presentation and thus his lessons are often dull and not well articulated. He has no real marking scheme: my class compared results on work handed back and his corrections were inconsistent each time. Midterm structure was nothing like what we were taught & class avg sank

One of the worst profs I've come across. I'm in my fourth year biochem taking an FLS class to get my french immersion certificate. He barely has a grasp on the grammar concepts he teaches. He is terrible and answering questions. His accent is sometimes hard to understand. He wastes SO much time in class pulling up his slides.

I had him for the companion course to POL1501 and I honestly found POL easier to follow than his lectures. It's an easy A but not really worth being bored out of your mind for an hour and a half every week. His grading criteria seems random and all over the place, plus he tried to change the midterm to a week earlier with no notice.

I took Prof Kapenda's accompaniment class for POL 1501. I'm a raging anglophone, so his lessons definitely helped me with the course content. That being said, his lectures can be dry and there isn't too much substance to the FLS 2581 courses in general. If you aren't struggling with your comprehension, this class will likely bore you too much.
Prof was beyond unorganized, expectations were always unclear. The class is an easy A, but he beyond boring and made the class frustrated with his teaching methods various times.
He is such a sweet prof who just wants to give his students the best

It was very easy to do well in this class, but Kapenda is a very boring prof. If you want an easy A this is a good class, but just be ready to be bored. There were only 15 students in the class and he could not remember a single persons name which i thought was a bit ridiculous. He also doesn't reply to emails and is very difficult to contact.
Prof Kapenda is seriously the best prof you'll ever have!! Most caring and understanding professor on campus. Very clear grading criteria and a light workload. Easy A+.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Monsieur Kapenda est un très bon prof! Il donne le temps précis pour aider à tous et en fait sa classe est parfaite si quelque chose n'a pas été claire dans le cours principal (j'ai pris FLS pour ECO1502). Il faut le dire aussi, monsieur Kapenda est une personne très agréable! Faîtes vos devoirs et lisez le livre.

Although Kapenda was a sweet man, this course will not improve your French language skills, nor help you in the subject you are studying. Sure his class is an easy A, but he gives no feedback or explanation on any of the assignments or midterms.

A really amazing professor who thoroughly explains new concepts and wants his students to do well. His lectures could be a little dry and if the class wasn't 7-10 I probably would have like it better, but he's overall very good for French as a second language.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Such a sweetheart. So patient and caring. His explanations are super thorough and he's  just an overall amazing prof. His dictees are really easy as long as you do your homework (which isn't much) Definitely choose him to be your prof!

He is extremely kind and helpful. If you go to him, he will explain very clearly what was missed in class. Class might be slow, but it's easy to understand. Even though his handwriting on the board is really bad, he writes straight from the textbook, which is blessed. Just do your homework, ask questions, smile and you'll get an easy A. :)

Really boring class. I feel like if I had him for a different class I might like him better, but I can't pay attention at all in his class. He isn't very clear with what he expects from his students, but as long as you get the assignments in on time, you will do well in the course.

I had the opportunity to work with prof Kapend and must say that I learned a lot. I have a clearer understanding of the nuances in French grammar.  As a prof, he's nice, understanding and a fir marker. Thank you
Excellent professor in all the ways.
I have just completed a great French Political sc. course with this professor. He's one of my best professors; nice, competent and understanding. It was an excellent course altogether.
Good professor with an excellent personality. Patient, understanding and dynamic.
The part of the course I enjoyed the most was finally understanding the many exceptions and rules in French grammar. Previous teachers have not succeeded in teaching as well as this professor.

Interesting. Not only he helped me understand my course of International relations through discussions, he initiated us to critical thinking. For the very first time, I learned how to write a synthesis from a variety of documents. Besides, the prof. is fair and a fair marker.
I was very happy with this course in that I learned what I was hoping to learn in advanced writing. The professor showed a great deal of competence both in the French language and writing skills.
Great professor. Very knowledgeabe in French, his explanation on details was clear. I learned a lot in this basic class.

Pretty nice guy, and interesting if you actually get the chance to have a conversation with him. The class I had was pretty boring, but the content wasn't really his fault. Pretty easy going, and a fair marker, but if you don't have to take FLS, I wouldn't bother. (On the other hand, if you are looking for a good grade, it's not hard to get)

Completely unclear prof, doesn't explain what he wants from assignments. I saw comments before taking his class about dropping it and decided not to...I wish I had. His course material isn't relevant to the French course, forces students to do assignments on sections that have already been marked by the midterm. Drop his course

This prof is a nice man, but the worst prof I've ever had in University (I'm going into 5th year).  My class actually got together to try and organize a meeting with the head of the FLS department to do something about his way of teaching. Unless you can't wait another year, drop this class.

I have no idea what the previous comments are talking about! This was absolutely the worst prof I have had at this uni (& I'm in 3rd year). Do not take this class if you actually want to learn something. The fact that he's still teaching made me realize how little the FLS dept. cares about the quality of its profs. & I switched programs b/c of this
Clear teaching style, with clear assignments. He wasn't very jazzed about the subject matter. Not bad over all. Easy to understand.

Great prof. Really enjoyed his class. Seems interested in the material and if there is anything that you do not understand he is quite helpful. Slightly disorganized and forgetful but gracious for the reminders.

Worst prof at uOttawa! Forgetful, disorganised, and spoke to us in English - funny, considering we are an advanced french immersion class. Will not admit he's wrong - he made tons of mistakes correcting, I had it checked by other profs. GET OUT OF HIS CLASS IF YOU HAVE HIM!

M. Kapenda is a really good professor. He's knowledgeable and knows very well how to convey the material. It also helps that he's so well versed in french!  He's one of the best professors that i have ever had the privileged to be taught by!

a great prof! His views that he brings to the class on politics are very interesting and commical at times. they are also very similar to mine which makes the class enjoyable. Can be a bit boring at times. but he knows his politics. highly recommend this guy! i'm taking one of his classes again!
No question - best prof in political science. I declared my major because of this course. Awesome lectures, excellent course.

micheal temelini is the best prof that ive ever had. hes great when it comes to preparing for exams, hes fair with papers. will help you if you have to spend some time away from school, is very funny and makes his classes exciting. ive had him for posc 1000 as well.

he's not really a professor. hes more of an ideologue. his classes are just propaganda sessions where he tries to indoctrinate his students with his own perosnal beleifs. also he's disorganized, and becomes extremely rude with anyone who disagrees with him. not recommended.
I recommend him...easy course
very intersting and opinionated.... love his style!
I love Dr.Temelini! He is very educated in his field and he always helps to make the iformation easy to understand.
Michael is an excellent prof I would recommend him to anyone!

A decent teacher.  Good for political science because he isn't as boring as dirt.  But he has no problem sharing his opinion, and (even through he says not) he hopes to convince you of it.  Easy test and assignment. Pleasant guy to talk to.

A real sweetie. He is passionate about what he believes in, you will learn how to be a tolerant and understanding person if you take his courses. He is really able to sway your opinion in a good direction. Always willing to help students. Highly recommended.
arguably the worst prof in the department

Look, if your a militant conservative, your not going to like him. Period. If it wasn't for those people, his rating would be though the roof. Lite course load,friendly,office always open, no suprises on tests, easy marker.If your a conservative posc student @ MUN..your in for some tuff times, bub.
Love him! He cares about his students and wants them to do well. He makes course material relevent and interesting. He's always up for a good debate or a chat.
He makes class fun. Always willing to help his students - love debate. Very hot!
A great teacher who is alot more organized than most of my profs, easily understood and is almost always open for a discussion.

Great prof. I don't know what in the hell the person who said he's disorganized was talking about, as his notes are in clear power point. He's very enthusiastic.  He is left wing, but doesn't force this on enybody and, indeed, encourages discussion/disagreement with him.  I love going to this class.

The best professor in polisci. He can make the most boring topics relevent and interesting. Loves debate and he cares about his students. Always available for help or just to talk about poltics. I highly recommend any course by him. And he's hot.
A great professor! keeps you very interested in lectures. A fair marker, and tests are pretty easy(if you actually go to class)
disorganized, boring, and very left wing

Super passionate about music, and overall a great professor.
Excellent teacher: made a required course enjoyable.
Amazing teacher. Makes classical music actually interesting and entertaining. Super funny and approachable. Easy to get into contact with and easy to do well. 10/10 would definitely take him again.

reviews.comment: He is such an awesome teacher and super funny. He makes something that could easily make you fall asleep into something really interesting. He is very accessible and does everything he can to help you do well in the concert reports. His quizzes were super easy and so was the midterm. Easy class and super fun to go to. Highly recommend this prof
actual gem, recommend him to anyone

Absolutely loved him and would take again. Funny in the sense that he doesn't try too hard but still makes lectures entertaining. I have no musical background so definitely took work to memorize pieces and learn terminology, but he made it so easy to do well. Can't say enough good things about this course/prof !!!!!

Michael is honestly the best prof, he's such a homie and understands that no one actually knows anything about classical music so he makes the quizzes and midterm very easy. He's also an email ninja and replies within 5 minutes. Very easy to pass, and to get an A all you have to do is put in some effort to learn the different songs
Michael is awesome. Straight G. Take this class you wont regret it

He is such a good prof! It was his first time teaching the class, so it was quite easy. The class is recorded so you don't have to go if you can't be bothered, but honestly it's worth attending if you want to learn more about music. Before each quizz, he puts his notes online.

If he doesn't know the answer he won't even get back to you he will simply send you to another professor or say I don't know. If you take a class with him be prepared to spend the same amount of hours in lab outside of class with tutors because he is just there monitoring class that is all he is of use for.

Always depending on other professors for answers so you cant even get questions answered in class. If he doesn't know the answers for his questions and decides to mark it wrong even if it was right he will deduct points on exams.

This professor is not knowledgeable of the material he is teaching. Like other reviews state it seems as if he is learning the material 5 minutes before class starts. If you want the wrong answer go ahead and ask him questions over anatomy models and lecture which by the way are provided by another professor.

Save yourself the headache and choose another anatomy professor. Prof Yee rarely has any idea what he's talking about. he does NOT contribute to our learning when it comes to anatomy models/histology. relies heavily on Prof AB and Google. He often rants about things not important to what he's teaching. Very unprepared. Get ready to teach yourself.

Professor Yee has no business teaching. It honestly feels like he just learned the material the night before. Constantly stumbles through lectures, repeats the same phrase like he's buffering, and clearly lacks confidence or a grasp on what he's talking about. Doesn't answer questions clearly, relies heavily on Dr. AB's notes. Painfully unprepared.

Professor Yee is new and does not seem to understand how to teach at all. Flustered and trips over his own words and doesn't even seem sure in what he's teaching. Took 3 minutes one time pointing at a sweat gland and repeating that this is a sweat gland. He's nice and all but doesn't explain things well at all, relies on Dr. A.B. way too much. Drop

I took this course in winter 2025, and I needed it to graduate and I was worried because it is a difficult course, I thank God I have Prof Sayde for this course, he made VLSI and ASIC design fun to learn. I graduated and I am looking for a job in this field!
The professor should try to be a little more lively in his explanations because sometimes it can make you sleepy. But other than that, everything's fine.
The professor loves his profession and was always willing to take the time to explain the material to those who had difficulty, including myself.
Best Professor I had!!

The course taught C from “Hello world” beginners' level then things get harder very fast! This allows students of all levels of experience to start on the same page. If you're interested and willing to put the effort in, you'll do fine. Prof is very knowledgeable and helpful.

Knows his stuff pretty well, but sometimes it hard to keep track of what is saying. Sometimes, he teaches things that aren't required. Give a lot of exemple and talks a lot about the exam to prepare us.
This is for Solar Cell course at Carleton, nice and caring Prof, well organized course. I learned a lots ...Thanks. Also thank you Prof for your reference letter to my MASc at McMaster U.

I had some  previous C knowledge and got A+. Attention ChatGPT may help you get 5% for assignments but will make you suffer and fail miserably with paper-based exams that worth 75%! The professor is knowledgeable and efficiently answered my questions. Lab assistants need to prepare better, and last 3 labs were hard to an average student!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you have no prior coding experience like me, you shouldn't miss any classes, especially the first 6 weeks, everything is connected and if you do, you'll spend most of your time trying to catch up! Luckily, I missed two classes at the end of the term due to illness and still passed with a B+. The prof is just fine and he cares.

Excellent course, Excellent prof. we learned a lot about the concept and design of solar cells, I especially liked the labs and the project where we designed and tested our own solar cell profiting from the semiconductor fabrication facilities at Carleton.

To be honest, if you don't have any previous coding experience, it seems like you'll have a hard time passing this course. The professor is very monotonous and makes mistakes all the time. Even though I didn't attend the classes much, I learned everything in the labs. Don't use ChatGPT; otherwise, you won't be able to learn the course.

Very boring lectures. The professor does not speak loud enough and has a hard time understanding his own slide shows. The Professor seems competent in other coding languages, but not C. The tests and exams are graded very strictly. The final is pass or fail with one question worth 50%. If you have never coded YouTube will be your best friend.

reviews.comment:
He doesn't know how to talk to the class, he's focused and talking to his laptop as there's nobody else. Gets wrong sometimes and can't communicate clearly the content of the lecture. 
He knows that his labs are hard to do with the basics elements we learn in class and that they are for no use but he still give them, which is a waste of time.
Horrible prof, doesn't know how to explain

Professor Sayde teaches this class very well and actually gets you interested in the subject. It starts off very easy but picks up the pace near the end so be aware of that. Make sure to attend every lecture as each one has pop quizzes that are worth 10%? from what I remember and this can really help boost your grade. Midterm and final are easy.
The course content was well laid out, easily accessible, and very clear. The attendance requirement was unnecessary but less punishing than others. The professor is quite knowledgeable.
The course material was great. Only thing that needs improvement are the labs. They are very unnecessary and unrelated to what we cover during the lectures.

Very smart but poor at teaching. I had him for GNG1506 which is a C programming class. You can tell he is very good in other stuff but C is not his strong suit as he was continously making mistakes in class. His EECs and final aren't that hard. If you already know programming you're fine. If you don't, take some quick online classes before lolz.
I more or less agree with the previous comments but he's still one of the best instructors I had for this term.

reviews.comment: Professor Sayde was a really nice guy and it was clear that he is very knowledgable of his subject. There were a lot of lab and in-class quizzes (but no midterms), which helped spread out the grading. My biggest complaint is that he is quite monotone and doesn't move around a lot so it's often difficult to stay focused on his teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Well organized and well presented, couldn't ask for better.. Heavy in-class exercises and lab quizzes but on the other hand no midterm which .is fair for a C programming course.

Prof sayde is a good prof if you have him in french. I had him in English for a class outside his expertise. The class was very poor if I'm being honest. This was not fully his fault tho. If you can avoid him for this course, you should.

Dr. Sayde is a kind and caring Prof and clearly very experienced in this area. But the fact that he is teaching the course for the first time, sometime his lectures were not clear and organized, his mid-term exam was difficult. But the final exam was better balanced. Teaching Assistants were not organized in labs and did not meet grading deadlines.

Professor Sayde is a good teacher and prepares his lectures well. He has a solid understanding of the subject. In conclusion I learned a lot from the course, the Prof managed to make electronics interesting.
All what I can say is: a great lecturer, and he cares! Thank you professor Sayde for everything :-)

Prof Sayde made me enjoy solving circuits, his explanations of the theory part of the course made circuit analysis much simpler. He is very caring and kind, always smiling. 

Thank you Professor!

This guy is one of the few decent teachers, all he needs to teach the concept of computer architecture is chalk and a blackboard! Attend all lectures and labs, ask questions and you will get a good grade. His exams fairly cover of what is seen in lectures and labs.

Mechatronics is course that covers several aspects of engineering, which requires a multidisciplinary instructor. Professor Sayde demonstrated an incredible multidisciplinary capacity, the readings were well prepared and detailed. The teacher answered all my questions effectively and clearly, which helped me to get an excellent grade. Thanks!

This is a really hard course to teach, but the professor is very nice and always makes sure that things are going smoothly. Labs are a bit too time consuming. he is AMAZING and VERY VERY helpful during office hours and is always ready to put in his max effort to make sure a student understands and feels confident. I didn't like BS sequential exams

If you love asynchronous classes, this teacher is for you. He speaks slowly so be ready to speed up the lectures, but if you take the time to listen to what he explains (bc the slides are messy), it's really easy to understand. I watched the videos, took notes, watched the tutorials and had 100%. Labs are confusing so find a good partner. HE CARES
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: Great course to take honestly; I really appreciated the discord server as it allowed me to engage with my pears more and made it much easier to ask questions regarding content, and easier to get answers, since I can just scroll through what other people have asked. Labs really helped to understand the content. Overall, a very enjoyable course!

Principles and Applications of VLSI Design: This class was great. There was a good amount of questions at the end of chapters where they gave solutions later on. It helped a lot. Also the labs had a good progression and the lectures where easy to follow, complete in detail and the teacher answered my questions really quick.

It was a blessing to have Professor Sayde this semester. His choice to make the course primarily asynchronous made the content easier to learn. His video lectures are informative and well prepared. I especially appreciated how he connected the course content with real world applications.

I took this course in summer 2020. Lovely professor! He really adds to the enjoyment of this course and does the most to make our first remote/online course a great experience. Discord class server was a great idea!

Recorded lectures was very helpful and allow to go back to concepts. The exam is too long for the time given. The difficulty was decent but the amount of time to do just the first question was 1/4 of the exam time. I would have appreciated either a shorter exam or longer time. All in all, Miche Sayde is a good prof and cares about his students.
Reasonable difficulty of material. It was clear that Prof. Sayde really wanted us to succeed and he provided the tools necessary to do so.
Le cours était très bien j'ai beaucoup appris! J'aurais aimé que les séances de quiz aient un peu plus de temps. Mais ce cours m'a beaucoup appris et j'ai beaucoup aimé la personnalité du professeur

Kind of hard to understand, he doesn't really enunciate words completely (just kind of mumbles). So you end up having to teach yourself with the course notes (which by the way are from another prof. reviews.comment: very kind professor but really hard to understand what he speaks because of his pronunciation. his voice is not clear, sounds like he speaks in english and also snake language like ssssss. but he is passionate and always helpful when questions are asked

What a fantastic, inspiring lady. I took her class last winter and while I expected my comp class to be a boring, weekly hassle, Dr. (yes, Dr.) LaVigne's course was the only one I looked forward to. Appreciated the unorthodox teaching style and activities. Fun class, encouraged creativity and thinking outside the box. Valuable experience.
Good instructor helpful and fun for an online course.  Inspiring even if you are not the best writer.  Do the work and you will be fine.
Instructor made the course fun and helpful for an online course which are more difficult to follow at times.

She really helped improve my writing, and really values students expressing their unique voice and personality through their work. I felt that she was extremely encouraging and really wanted to help me succeed. The workload is pretty heavy, but her grading is very fair!

No Mid term, No Final, No Homework, No teacher/student review, No Group assignments, and she emailed all her post so you knew when to log on for updates. You won't learn anything, but it was an easy A. So my GPA thanks her.

The class was disorganized but it was an easy A. Assignments were mostly "busy work" and essays were graded quite leniently. Two books were "required" for the class but only one was used for the assignments. I would take her just because it was an easy class, not so much that it was interesting or helpful.

very unorganized.  Does not review the her assignments before releasing to students.  Changes her mind on the homework assignments after they are released.  Does not open the drop box for the assignment until two days prior to due date.

I took this class online and did the initial essay so she could see when I was at. The second week I find out she wants a 5 page essay on every chapter we read from the book, 3 additional essays and all the questions answered at the end of every chapter. Ain't nobody got time for all that!

She is an amazing teacher. Very helpful and as long as you do the work you will not fail. She is a teacher that lets you focus more on your creativity rather than the boring facts that most teachers require. There is no mandatory page limit. She just wants her students to bring their personality out through their writing. I give her an A+!:-)
Very good professor. If you do the work, you will get a good grade. Not a lot of homework, and no wasted time with "busy" work.

At the beginning of the class, she informed us that she wanted to change the course for our class. (trying a new thing) Well it worked! Very helpful to those who needed it. We actually worked in class with minimal homework, other than the papers. If you're iffy about English shes the one to go to!!

I don't understand how anyone could do poorly in this class. Papers were graded fairly and there were no tests or quizzes. Gives time in class to do your work and as long as you put some effort into it you get full credit. She sends you to writing tutors and will give you 10% extra credit if you get the paper to prove you saw one!
She was really great. im not the best writer and i dont like it but she was really helpfull and was always nice

I had this class online. Sometimes she can really be unclear, but overall she's a good teacher. Most of the class consisted of book work, we only wrote two essays. So if that's what your looking for, she the teacher for you. Another good thing is that you choose the topic for the essays, most teachers that I've had didn't do that.

For a communications professor you would expect the class to be organized and clear.  Also, maybe that the words she posts would be free of the errors she expects your papers to be free of.  This is THE WORST online class I have ever taken.  Oh, and if you want a professor who actually replies to your emails, don't take this professor.

She was very creative and made the class fun. Contrary to the one bad review she is not to lazy to grade papers. The only people i saw that had any trouble in her class is people who didn't like critical thinking because she liked to make the assignments more creative than just simple bland directions.
Great Teacher!!  Wants you to learn from her class--your input is welcome--would recommend!!!
I found her class to be challenging, but fun. The in-class exercises required thought, but Mrs. LaVigne was always helpful. I strongly recommend her!!
Pretty easy class. She can help those who struggle as well as more advanced students
Took this as an online class. High expectations, but gives great feedback on papers to help you improve.
Good teacher and class. Does not lecture too much, which is good.

Only professor who memorized the names of every student by the second class! Lectures were short and interesting. She gave us time in class to work on our papers and helped anyone who asked. She seemed genuinely concerned about us understanding and even enjoying what we were reading and analyzing.

AVOID. She is not clear on anything that she says, or does. Just another teacher who hates her job and gives busy work to pass time. She sends you to writing tutors for every essay becuase she is too lazy to grade them. She makes you buy 2 books for the class that you use 1 time each. WASTE OF TIME
I think she needs to teach better. Not grade papaers as hard because she doesnt clarify how to do them right in the first place

Very smart and wants students to learn, but comes off very dry. He promotes but doesn't really know how to encourage group learning. Grades are mostly from exams, homework, and clicker questions. Unfortunately I found that most of the additional understanding I needed to succeed in the class came from multiple attempts in completing the homework.
I had a great TA for CHY 124 as well as Dr.Bruce was always there to help.

I am so thankful that I retook chemistry with Dr. Bruce. I had Kreps before him and found he was not the teacher for me. Dr. Bruce wants you to ask questions and he wants you to understand as much as you can. Posts all lecture slides, quick emailer and even posts exam keys! Just took the final and breezed through it. Very happy with this course!

has it all. If you take Chemistry with him, you simply get it. But be aware: he wants to know in the exams.
His knowledge impairs his ability to teach fundamental subjects.  For a graduate course I think that he would be excellent.  Beware of the exams cuz it doesn't reflect the material covered in class.
Too confident for his own good.  It seemed like EVERY TIME someone asked him a question in class he answered with, "you need to know the language of chemistry."  Not helpful or approachable.
He's very nice and extremely helpful if you meet with him privately.
worst teacher on campus, confused, unprepared, can not explain hard subject

This is why I hate Chemistry.

He's the best prof I've had at Uottawa. This is for (GNG1506 btw). He truly wants everyone to succeed and he talked about making the class as easy as possible for his students. I don't know about the other classes but take GNG1506 with him 100%.
The prof was great Professor and very knowledgeable.

Very caring professor who wants all students to succeed. Unfortunately, not a great teacher since the course material was not communicated too efficiently so most of the class was self-taught. The exams were very easy and included many examples done in class, which was nice. He's a very nice and sweet person.

First time for this prof to teach System Dynamics. Bro talks to the board and even the board doesn't hear him.
Can't really explain the concepts and will sometimes re-write the textbook on the board during a 30min blank silence.
Best Prof at uOttawa.

Niccest and most caring prof from uni. He sends regular emails to make sure everyone is ok, guides us well on what to study, the exams are fair.He even joined me on campus when i was studying to help me! I asked him numerous questions during the semester and he always answers fast! I recommend! Caring,respectful and puts efforts!

His teaching improved a lot over the course of the semester, at first he just talked to the board but he's doing his best to improve and i respect that, but the only ressource we get for studying are class notes and homework corrections. Tests are easy but whole class is self taught. DGD solutions woulda helped but he and the TA never posted them.
This Professor is one of the best professors at uOttawa. Very knowledgeable and he cares a lot about his students. His lectures are clear but contain a lot of details.

Overall, one of the best CS teachers of all time. He's super nice and explains things very well. He's invaluable and will help you if you're stuck on any concept, and gives a lot of extra credit opportunities.
The best prof ever. GOAT!

One of the best professors I've had in the CS department! I took ITI1120, CSI2120, and CSI2372 with him, and he was consistently amazing, knowledgeable, caring, and always supportive. He goes above and beyond, even helping with job interview prep and career advice. Truly a gem!

He's a great prof who clearly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He likes to have a more interactive class and will sometimes give out bonus marks for specific questions so you'll want to attend lectures.

I took CSI2120 this Winter, and this guy is amazing. He repeats the idea many times to ensure all students understand. The course load was manageable compared to other CS courses. Make sure you participate in his lectures and respect the deadlines.

This prof made CSI2120 an exceptionally amazing course. He transformed how I think about code. He stood out most in his ability to connect theoretical to practical use of the concepts. His passion for the subject and his great communication skills with students created an inspiring environment that made me feel safe to participate in lectures.
The best CS professor I've ever had. He's very organized and understands his students very well, adapting his teaching style to accommodate all students. It's very rare to have such profs!

I took the CSI2120 Programming Paradigms with him this winter. He's a GEM! There's no way you could enjoy a 7-10 pm lecture if it's not with this guy! I enjoy watching his discussions, especially when he gets too passionate about some programming concepts. He won't ignore your emails like others, and he really understands students.

CSI2120 is a heavy course that covers many programming languages throughout the semester. The professor is very nice and engaging. He always makes sure students don't leave the class without understanding at least 80% of the lecture content. The midterm was fair and reflected what was covered in class. I will consider him for future courses.

The course CSI2120 taught a lot of programming language that is barely used now. Kinda unnecessary.
Professor Alnabhan is a fine professor. Will interact and give extra credit to the students. The slides could provide more information and show examples.

This guy gave me nightmares. So overrated, only the most obnoxious people you will meet think this guy is a good professor cause he makes a couple of jokes and proceeds to bombard you with deliverables. A good person ≠ good prof.

I almost failed his class last semester but retook it with Wassim this semester, and he's much better. He teaches at a fair pace, which is helpful for first-time coders. His lecture slides are short and simple, and his labs/assignment questions won't take you 50 years to do. Mohammad's exams are tricky, while Wassim's are straightforward.

He's is one of the best professors I have had in uOttawa. His classroom is full of energy. He shows caring towards his students' progress, and respect for his students as well! Definitely a must take for his courses.

I am taking programing paradigms this winter term with him. His lectures are amazing and easy to digest! Assignments are pretty straight forward. Make sure to participate in his lectures to get some rewards :)

Such a bad prof. One of the worst CS professors you'll find. Exams are there to trick you instead of showcasing what you learnt. Stay away from him and take Wasim
if you can.

reviews.comment: Great prof and a nice guy, makes the lectures "enjoyable" even if the exams can be difficult. You have to study properly for exams. He provides a detailed strategy on how to study. He also gives bonus points if you participate in lectures. I started studying the material very late so I got B+. You will definitely get A+ if you follow his study plan

Amazing! Made this heavy class very straightforward with his .cpp files, quite literally giving exact definitions that were on exams. 3 normal assignments and 2 exams with the participation marks to push your mark. After-class discussions after every section with a big smile. Highly recommend!

Great CS educator who is very nice with students and very helpful. He requires you to work a lot throughout the semester including participating in lectures and completing labs/assignments to get A or more. He is amazing in general.
The exams are very difficult and stressful but he's very good at teaching and discussing the material. I'll take him again for sure.

Had good explanations and examples for the course content. Made everything available. Provided a textbook and multiple sources, but only the lecture notes are needed to succeed. Took off marks for things I did correct, so check all your assignments after they're graded and go to office hours to correct them. Gives extra credit for participation.

Until after the midterm, I hadn't started studying in a way that would help me pass the course. I met with Prof. Mohammad, who gave me a detailed study plan. This was a huge help and key to going from failing to passing with flying colors. If you're feeling lost during the semester, talk to him!! he's an awesome and genuine person.

reviews.comment: If you complete the labs and assignments by yourself and participate in his lectures and you'll be fine.
I took him in my first and third year. He made me love programming. Believe me, you'll learn a lot from him.
Very caring and easygoing CS prof! He's also very knowledgeable in his field and can definitely help you with future interviews.
assignments were questionable, multiple choice only exams were silly, your grade isnt entirely reflective of your skill or knowledge for the course
This professor is one of the best cs professors in Ottawa. Although the course is heavy overall, the class is engaging.
Such a bad professor. He arrived late to all the lectures and made his exams so bad.
Attend his lectures and see how passionate he gets while discussing the course topics. Participate as much as you can, it really makes a difference!!!

reviews.comment: This professor is a must to have. He's super friendly and smart

Such a bad prof. Gives so much work and expects students to keep up, especially in our first semester. His exams are some of the worst you will encounter, he spends more time trying to trick you than test you on your knowledge. Very bad prof take Wassim if you can.

Mohammad is an outstanding prof who simplifies complex concepts in a well-structured course making it a perfect fit for beginners. While the assignments are manageable, the exams were challenging. He's approachable, genuinely cares about students progress, and willing to offer extra support, especially with job interviews. The best CS prof I've had

He's the real GOAT! He reorganized the C++ course in a way that condensed all the material into just a few .cpp files. He's super friendly and respectful, always willing to discuss topics from an industry perspective. He also provides interview questions related to the material. I just wish I could have him again.

Although he gives a lot of work and is a tough grader, he's one of the best professors I've had so far. He's clear, engaging, and truly cares about his students' success. He takes the time to explain concepts with real-life examples. I wish I could have him again!
Prof. Mohammad is super chill and knows his stuff. He made C++ coding way less scary. Exams were tough but fair. I'd totally take his class again.
He is the best professor, and explain very well, I really enjoyed his classes

Great professor, and he rewards class participation. Midterm was not that hard, as long as you did the assignments yourself and understood how mutable objects work. The labs take like 30 minutes weekly. Assignments are every other week, and they take a few hours at most. I believe our class had the highest average, so that says something.
the midterm was so hard, I think students should be allowed to bring ALBERT EINSTEIN to the exam for help

reviews.comment: Neven is a very engaging speaker with a good sense of humor, and as a result his lectures are quite engaging. The lowest grade Ive ever gotten in history before was A- but I got B in his.

reviews.comment: This is the one class in my life where I haven't skipped a single lecture, even when very ill. It is an extremely reading-heavy course and the assignments/lectures always keep you on your toes. Nonetheless, I learned so much in this course that will be valuable for perhaps the rest of my working life. If you don't mind the challenge, go for it.

Definitely would take this class again. The professor is engaging and actively motivates students to come to class and to participate in everything offered. There are quite a few readings but that majorly correlates with what the is taught in class. If you're looking for someone who rants in a very intellectual and teaching way - look no further!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Neven will really make you work for your grade. At the end of the semester you'll feel so accomplished. He really makes you see History in a different way, and you become more critical as a student (high school really didn't teach us anything.)  Really funny guy. Take notes during his lectures, but also enjoy them.

reviews.comment: Well, I thought he was great. A little scary at first, but you'll get over that. He is specific in what he wants, so as long as you follow the rubrics, then you will be good. If you even have discussion group with him as the professor, make sure you speak - even if it's just once. Participation is the key. Get ready to laugh.
Professor Leddy is a good teacher and makes it clear what he expects in assignments.

Very sassy, highly entertaining lecturer.
pretty dope guy!!!!!!!!!

reviews.comment: Interesting lecturer who makes the topic relevant. Hard marker but explains marks well and is clear about expectations.

Neven was one of, if not the greatest, professor I have had at Carleton thus far. His classes can be very difficult if you don't keep up with your note-making. Though, he is more than willing to assist outside of class time. He even offered extra credit opportunities! Overall excellent. Would definitely take one of his classes again.

He makes you work for your grade and teaches you to be a self-sufficient learner. He's possibly the best lecturer I've had because he makes the material relatable and incredibly interesting. He's gone out of his way to help students and ensure that they become better workers.

You will not regret taking a course with him, as long as you make the effort. He's absolutely hilarious and engaging, and takes material you've heard a thousand times and shows you a whole new dimension to it.  Essays assigned are hard but he will go out of his way to be available to help you. Pop quizzes on readings, but they're not hard at all.

Neven is one of the best profs I've had. He isn't always the clearest about requirements for his assignments but he never tires of trying to explain them and will meet students outside of class several times a week. He gives you confidence in your own knowledge instead of talking down to you.
Professor Leddy is one of the best professors I have ever had. An engaging lecturer with eye-opening approaches to the material he teaches.

Great prof. He is very clear in his lectures and is very funny. He is also very helpful. The work isn't easy, but it is well worth it in the end. I would highly recommend him to anyone who is taking a history class if you're not afraid of a little hard work.

Amazing prof.  Very knowledgeable and charismatic.  he manages to capture the attention of the entire class and you can really learn a lot from both his lectures and his guidance with the independent essays.  The course isn't the easiest, but you'll do well provided you're not afraid of a little hard work.  Very highly recommended :)

Amazing professor. He was hilarious (laughed every class) and made the course content really interesting and easy to understand. Class itself was definitely not easy, but worth-while. Take one of his classes if you can...he's nice to look at too.

Excellent, knowledge and wise-cracking prof who will wear sexy purple shirts to mandatory classes. Enjoys complaining about his salary but overall lovely to listen to and uses up-to-date essential online tools to facilitates learning and research. **He knows about this website!
Easy class. Mid term is online and free to use any online sources. Final is a project that isn't bad, took my group 2 days to finish(had 2 week to do). Homework everyweek, but really easy.

Very straightforward class. Weekly HW and a couple projects/presentations. All of these are pretty much completion grades. Kind of disorganized, People that were supposed to present in October weren't able to until late November. 15 Page paper for final was time consuming but graded easily. Easy to get a good grade, overall

Professor Nguyen has demonstrated that he is not suitable to teach the material in CYSE 445. He has demonstrated to students that he does not know the information that is suppose to be taught, but he will read the slides word for word. Nguyen has also Googled answers to students' questions in front of them. His questions are extremely unclear.

This professor's quizzes are really confusing. Average on the quizzes for the class was around 50% so if you get a 25 out of 50 don't worry. Beware of how he phrases the question. Even though there maybe another answer that is also correct, or if another security tool is better suited for the task, you expected to memorize and regurgitate the matte

Burn is such an awesome professor. Hes so passionate about the material & really engages the class in discussion so you arent just sitting through lectures. You can tell he genuinely cares about his students. If you do the readings & take lecture notes, youll definitely succeed on quizzes and tests. Hes a super personable guy. Take this class!

Uncaring and lazy professor... Started the semester nearly a week late without a word to any of us students. He then provided us a syllabus that was from a previous year. Tests and quizzes were inconvenient and only opened on weekends, through holidays and breaks. Study guides did not help much on the tests and quizzes. I was lost in his class...

He was nice and this class is pretty easy. It consisted of reading quizzes and exams. He gives you study guides that have the questions from the assessments and most answers are on coursehero or quizlets. for covid, we had recorded lectures but his lectures are very boring tbh. he drops your lowest scores too! take this class for an easy A

Professor Burn was the worst professor I've ever encountered. He's super unorganized. He posts lectures/assignments/quizzes late. He gives poor excuses for his incompetence. Big waste of money

reviews.comment: He is very disorganized and only grades you on quizzes and tests (very hard questions BTW). The final exam was extremely difficult and he is a last-minute person. He was always behind in posting lectures and quizzes. Definitely a very hard class for a 1000 level course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A thoroughly entertaining and helpful professor if you do the reading and participate. He knows what hes talking about but is severely disorganized. Make sure to do the reading questions!! He didnt post lectures until right before the final when we went online. Final wouldve been very hard if not open-note.

Nice guy but SUPER disorganized. Goes off topic during lectures and wonders why his classes are behind. 2 quizzes were delayed: he forgot to print a quiz & he gave us the wrong one. When we went online bc covid he didn't post a single lecture UNTIL FINALS WEEK in which he uploaded 4 lectures. Under diff. circumstances I would've reported himto OU
He's super nice and cool. The quizzes are word for word from the study guide. Easy A. Offers extra credit. Exams are straight from the lecture.

Professor Burn was so disorganized throughout the entire semester. Papers were ridiculous. We had to reach out to him several times to explain the papers. Almost all tests were posted late. Doesn't put any grades in so you don't know your grade until the end of the semester. Made up weird excuses to why everything was being posted late.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Burn is the worst professor I've encountered at Oakland University. He gave 5 tests within the semester and 4 were late & all crammed into the last month of class. He sends weird confusing emails with ridiculous excuses. He also made up an entire format halfway into writing a paper. Reading notes don't prepare you for exams. Don't waste your money!

This was by far the worst professor I've had at OU. The only grades are tests and quizzes, and he doesn't grade them until the end of the semester, so you don't know if you're failing or not. His gets off topic in his lectures, and it's a waste of time. I don't know my grade for the semester yet, but don't take him if you can help it!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Well this is the most disorganized professor I have ever taken we now have two tests that have continuously been postponed since February (its the end of March). reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: John Burn was a wonderful man outside of academics. During his lectures, he would continue to go off track and it was difficult to understand the material. reviews.comment: He was awesome! He is very funny and odd but he makes the class interesting. If you don't understand a topic he will easily help or explain it to you in a different way. Seriously wish he taught all my classes

reviews.comment: This course was HORRIBLE. This is an entry level course and the material he tested us on went far beyond that. If you need to take this course I would STRONGLY recommend taking another professor.

reviews.comment: So wonderful, what a man. A very odd man, but try to take once of his classes if you get the chance.

The material is really hard, especially when you take it online. Weekly homework and quizzes. Dont stress if you dont do well on the quizzes or exam, he does curve which helped out so much. May be an easier class if its in person but either way, good Professor and wants everyone to pass.

Tough class but good Professor. Truly cared about his students and just wants them to succeed. Took this as an online class, definitely wasnt easy teaching the material to yourself but Prof Burn was an email away to answer any questions. Gave a high curve so everyone who did the work, had an opportunity to pass.

This class is horrible. He doesnt grade anything, its 2 days before the class has ended and he has nothing in. His quizzes are not even close to the book. He has pushed chapters behind a week, then doubled up, making 8 things due that week. Chapters are long and he doesnt provide other notes other than the book.
