reviews.comment: The worst professors Ive had. It takes him forever to email back, hed rather make the students read rather than considering teaching. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Im gonna make this short and sweet. This class is hard online. A lot of homework, reading, and quizzes once a week. Doesnt put grades in so if youre failing, you dont know. No video lectures and very few chapter notes to help understand. If you are willing to be stressed, then take it online. If not, go for in person.

reviews.comment: So far at OU John is one of my top 3 favorites. He always came in the classroom ready to teach and with good energy. Tests and quizzes are exactly like the homework and in class questions and sometimes are the exact ones. Goes over homework questions but also collects and grades it not by complete accuracy but 100% completion.

He's funny but that's about it. His lectures get very off-topic, to the detriment of getting the material in. Delays quizzes and tests on a whim or if he forgets to bring the right test to class. Readings are normal, but its hard to find what readings you need to do, he never really tells you in class, and he goes off the syllabus from day one

His stories are insanely funny. The exams are HARD but he curves them. Someone failed the exams and somehow ended up with an 82 in the class thats how much everything is curved (thank god). Make sure you go to the lectures because youre graded on attendance. Also there is a paper to do for extra credit that can change your grade by 3% so do it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Makes class very exciting and has hilarious stories. The material can be hard at times and you may start of slow but he goes over many practice problems until students start catching up with the new material. Lots of homework which he grades mostly for completion. Generously curves the tests, and is approachable and understanding.

John is hilarious. I had him for Intro to Logic and I hate math. He is such an easy grader and makes the class incredibly fun. I struggled with the material and got an A+. His class is set up so that you do well. Great curve, great guy!

Mr. Burn is one of the funniest professors I've ever had. He does talk a lot, but he's very clear about what he wants you to do/know on homework, tests, and quizzes. Usually, he even tells you what and how many kinds of problems will be on tests/quizzes. Homework is weighted more than quizzes, and if you follow the instructions you get full credit.

reviews.comment: He's one of the funniest professors I have ever had, but he gets off topic a lot and talks about his family. He's a bit disorganized, but as long as you do the study guides, you should be good on the tests and quizzes.

reviews.comment: This class was a lot of fun. He tends to go off topic, but he is a good professor. He knows the material and explains it well. There is a lot of work that makes your brain hurt, but it is a good class to take.

PRO Knows his stuff Replies to emails Heavy curve CON Changes due dates constantly Doesn't follow syllabus Easily distracted making already dense coursework hard to follow Book over complicated, Google explains these concepts much more intuitively Grades attendance & wastes more than 1/2 of class time regularly Feedback unhelpful when legible
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Prof. Burn is a nice and funny guy. He is a bit disorganized, leading to some confusion. Still, he is a good lecturer, and his tests/quizzes are easy. Grade is based on 3 tests, reading quizzes (he gives you the possible questions), and the final. He drops your lowest test and quiz, and he gives very generous curves.

This was probably the best professor I have encountered so far at OU. I learned a lot from taking this class and John has a great personality with lots of stories to tell. As long as you attend lecture and take notes you'll pass the exams and if you do the study guides, you'll pass the quizzes!
He's such a funny guy. Gets off topic a bit, but explains homework before and will answer any questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Without a doubt one of the best professors I have ever had at Oakland. Teaches and goes over the material throughly and is very clear while explaining examples.

This was a wickedly hard class, but if you need to get it over with, take Prof. Burn. He held review sessions twice a week and responded to every email I sent him within a few hours. You can't ask for much more for an online class. Very kind professor and understands that not everyone is a philosophy major. He also gave a VERY generous curve.

Though the content in this class is extremely difficult, it is a very passable class. All that matters it that you show enough effort in your homework or that you somewhat understand the material. For as hard of a gen ed as this is, I would suggest John to anyone who just needs to get it over with.

This class was horrible. It was BY FAR the most boring class I have ever taken and It was RIDICULOUSLY HARD; this was by far the hardest class I have ever taken and it is a 100 level gen ed!!!!! The quizzes were ridiculous and completely unfair; multiple choice questions had upwards of 10 choices. Take a different class for your math gen ed!!

reviews.comment: WORST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD IN MY ENTIRE LIFE. If there is one word I would use to describe Professor Burns class it would be "chaos". He gave the worst directions, homework was a jumbled mess, and for many of the homework problems he changed the directions so that it would not make a lot of sense with the material we were working on. long story short, do not take burn for an online class.

reviews.comment: Burn is hilarious, who makes philosophy bearable by telling funny stories and offering extra credit opportunities. There are many quizzes containing questions that come straight from the study guide for the reading, but the answers can easily be found just by googling. The exams are tough, but he curves by a lot making it fairly easy to pass.

Prof John is one of the best in the department.  If you need to take this class, do yourself a favor and take it with him.  Yes, it's philosophy, so the exams can be a little challenging, but he curves them a lot which makes it all even out.  The quizzes are BEYOND EASY and boost your grade.  He's funny too, which makes class great.  Take him!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Burn makes a dry subject tolerable, but not much beyond it. You have to read 2 books and answer questions on them. His lectures can be really hard to follow at times i suggest reading the text over which he will be covering (makes understand WAY easier). The tests are nothing unreasonable and he curves them, make sure you cover the SG for the final

Burn sucks. You get two big books that he makes you read all of (answers are no longer online unless you pay). He doesn't teach during lecture, just makes dumb scribbles on the board and tells stories. He never posts your grade all year so your left clueless. EC is a 6 pg paper, no thanks. Overall crappy class and prof. Every answer sounds the same
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Burns is interesting but DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU THRIVE ON ORGANIZATION, he is all over the place & no structure! I payed attention and still had no clue what was going on, easy A  but it it drove me crazy. Exams are solely on his lectures, you should go to class. You'll do fine if you pay attention bc he puts a major curve on every exam.

He makes me uncomfortable, he thinks he's funny and he's not, gets off topic A LOT. Gives decent curves. Don't bother with the books, just use google to answer the study questions. Quizzes/exams identical to the study questions.

I dislike PHL, but I really enjoyed Prof. John. He is super funny and gives good stories to help remember material. Make sure you pay attention during lectures and take detailed notes. Great curves on exams and easy quizzes based off reading question (that you can google and get the answer word for word).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Such a cool professor. The material covered in this course can be considered a little challenging but Professor Burn makes it manageable. You have a weekly homework assignment that can be a little lengthy so try to do it ASAP. He is always willing to help and I recommend going to class instead of trying to learn it on your own.

Professor Burn was a great professor and funny. I got a 3.1 going into the final without studying anything because he curved his previous tests so nice and I did the extra credit tests. Very helpful and gives you opportunities to boost your grade. Class was a little boring but never disappointing.
There isn't a day I haven't laughed in his class and it was easy, he's a good teacher gets off topic alot but hilarious! Take him if you need philosophy I got a 4.0

If you have to take Logic as a math requirement, TAKE BURN. If you go to class and pay attention to his hilarious examples you are guaranteed to learn something. He curves quizzes and tests by a lot but you at least have to have a basic grasp on the material. There are plenty of opportunities to boost your grade but it's better to get a head start.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Logic is a tough subject but Prof Burn makes it easy if you pay attention and actually try on the hw, you get credit for trying. There are lots of quizzes and tests but he curves everything, generously. He has so many funny stories to keep it interesting and is so nice to his students. Only took the class to satisfy math requirement, but loved it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. He is very funny and laid back. Often tells his personal stories in class for a laugh and to relate the material. Also a very fair grader. Drops your worst quiz and exam and gives huge curves. The class requires quite a bit of reading but it was easy as he gives you questions to answer during the readings.

DO Not take this class online. Perhaps it would have been easier in class, but I took this class online to get a prerequisite out of the way. He assigns his own directions to problems in the book so it is very confusing to do book homework with homemade directions! He will not let you work ahead. Gives you no instruction just assigns problems
I loved him.

If you plan on taking logic take it with Burn! He makes it simple for you. As long as you show up to class, you will have a good understanding. Homework is weighted more than quizzes, so it boosts your grade in case you fall behind in a chapter. The hw doesn't take as long as he say, and as long as you follow his examples its easy.
Great professor whose funny and helps you out. However, this class gave me nothing but more anxiety. Absolutely hated logic. Would recommend Burns but not logic.

Took logic, super hard class but he makes it enjoyable and easy on the students. Go to class otherwise you WILL be lost. Tests are complicated but he is a fair grader based on if you show effort. practice, practice and ask questions. Time consuming but the best bet for a formal reasoning Gen Ed class, trust me. He's hilarious and approachable.

Professor Burn is amazing! He does assign a lot of homework, but as long as you do it, you'll pass the exams no problem. If you have a question, or need to clarify anything, he'll definitely help. His lectures are long, but he keeps them so interesting with funny stories. Also, the curve he puts on his exams are insane. It's hard to fail this class

This was the easiest class I have ever taken. He drops the lowest quiz grade and offers an extra credit exam towards the end of the semester. On each quiz/exam, he updates you on your GPA at the moment for the course which was super helpful. He knows each student by name and has plenty of funny stories about his life to share to the class.

John is a great guy. He was crystal clear with grading, so every student always knew where they stood (he updates you on your overall course grade weekly). He drops two quizzes and gives extra credit opportunities, too. Logic wasn't a super easy class, but it was certainly manageable and very interesting.

Burn is amazing! Took PHL102 with him this fall and absolutely loved the class. Lectures aren't boring at all, and he's very clear w/what's expected. SUPER timely with returning work and tests and very helpful. Not a terribly hard class if you try. GET THE BOOK because you need it for homework. And take notes on lectures. You'll enjoy his class!!!

Professor Burn was awesome! Take him for all PHL class that he offers! For 102 you need the books, take really good notes, and ask questions. Its a tough class and not for everyone but I loved it and he was great at explaining everything. For 103 its a lot of material but not difficult. Do the reading and you'll be okay

Great guy and great at teaching. participation is 15% of the grade. quizzes are based off reading only and are 15%. gives study guides the test are pretty tough you will have to study a lot but curves nice.

Burn is hilarious. Philosophy is a pretty dry subject but burn makes it fun and relates ideas to modern situations. Has a ton of funny stories he tells and really keeps the class interesting. There is a good amount of reading for the quizzes but it's all pretty straight forward. Would highly recommend!
Easy class if you pay attention during lectures and do the study guide. He curves his test and quizzes. Wants the best for his students

Homework was sometimes long out of the book but he was very helpful and it was only due once a week.  Always funny and has the class laughing.  He is an amazing teacher and if he could teach every class of mine I would have a 3.0 or above in everything!

Professor Burn is my favorite prof I have had at OU. He is not only the nicest guy, he's funny, his lectures are interesting, and he uses examples you remember to explain difficult things. He is VERY generous with his curves on quizzes and tests. Definitely an easy class to get a high 3 and even 4. He is the coolest guy ever, makes philosophy fun!

I was nervous to take his class, because Philosophy is NOT my subject, but it was one of my favorite classes I had this semester. He makes the material interesting, and his stories are hilarious. Make sure you go to class, it helps immensely. I seriously recommend him!!

I really enjoyed this class. There was a reading quiz about every week, but as long as you do the questions, you'll pass. This class was very interesting. He's a great professor and really cares about the students.

Intro to Logic has a ton of homework. I took this class cause i needed it for a gen ed. Although i did pass there was a TON of homework sometimes 4 hr assignments. Also a quiz everyweek. John Burn is a nice guy but his class is confusing. He grades on a huge curve.

Excellent teacher. You must attend class to understand the homework and quizzes. There is a big curve for each quiz and midterm which helps tremendously. He truly wants all of his students to do well. Would definitely recommend taking him for any philosophy course.

Makes the class fun.  Drops 2 of 7 quizzes at the end.  Curves in the area of 30%. I see a lot of people saying you have to read, which won't be true for a lot of people.  I haven't read the book, just listen to this golden God teach.
Such a fun class. It was the highlight of my semester. His lectures are very engaging and he is a really funny guy. You have to read A LOT for this class to have any luck passing his quizzes.

He is a very nice guy, but the class pretty difficult. Either you get it or you don't. If you have to take this class for credit, I would recommend taking him because he gives good curves and cares about the students. However, if you don't need this class, I do not recommend taking it at all as it is difficult to grasp.

Professor Burn is such a great professor! Yes, logic itself is hard, but he explains it very well. Most of the tests are hard, but he has a huge curve for everything so don't worry about not doing well on them! He really cares about the students and is really nice and super funny. If you're taking PHL-102, take him as a professor!

Very fair! If you study (use note cards) you will get a good grade. He understands that some people have a bad day when it comes to quizzes and exams, so he drops one of each. Very funny and very interesting guy! Don't feel overwhelmed if you look at how many slides his PowerPoints have, he skips through most of them.
Great professor. Fair. Willing to work with you. Must go to class, take notes, and pay attention...like any other college class. He's really nice, and has some funny stories to tell, too.

4.0! Burn is a wonderful professor! He made class and learning the philosophical theories fun. He always tells funny stories! He curves everything! Just study the power points for the exams. And the quizzes are the same questions from the reading questions. He also drops lowest quiz and exam.

love love love him! first professor at OU that I like! tells funny stories an the class is easy for the most part! do the questions for the quizzes & look at the slides for the exams! Highly recommended that you take mr. burns!!

Professor Burn was one of the best professors I have had at OU. He makes the subject interesting and accessible. He tends to go off on tangents but they are funny and are good breaks in between topics. He makes the material easy to learn. I went out of my way to take him for three classes. Grades with a curve. Great prof overall. Easy A.
HE is the nicest professor ever very friendly and he made the class fun and he is extremely helpful. he looks a lot like Gotye

I took his class when I was a freshman. Let me say that he was the funniest professor I've ever had. It was an entertaining class. There was many reading assignments, but you'll do well if you don't wait until the last minute. His tests are fair and he curves, which is a bonus. I definitely recommend him.

Professor Burn is really nice and is always available to answer any questions. He grades extremely fair and his tests and quizzes are manageable. The homework assignments are very helpful and the class was definitely beneficial! Definitely recommend taking him!!

Funniest professor you will ever take! He cares and wants you to succeed and he makes class fun. The subject was difficult for me but I wouldn't have taken it with anyone else. 6 quizzes (drops lowest) 2 midterms & a final as well as hw for every chapter. Sounds like a lot, but he's fair. Curves everything! You need the book. Gives EC opportunities
Funniest teacher, take it with him!!!!!! Curves so much on tests, and always keeps the class interested and laughing. Great person.

Super easy class to meet the formal reasoning requirement! His curves are ridiculously high and he makes everything so easy to understand. Has an optional ch. 7 quiz & hw at the end, so if you work hard all semester, the last two weeks are REALLY easy. He's also adorably quirky and funny. Take him & only him for PHL 102!

There are 6 HW assignments through the semester that EACH take a minimum of 2 hours to do,  but he grades on effort, not right or wrong; 3 quizzes; a midterm & final. He does his best to make a difficult subject easy-ish. If you need this class, take it with him and only him. You need the book.

He's a awesome guy. Very interesting lectures, tells a lot of good stories. If you're ever confused he'll always has no problem explaining it again.  He's very understandable when it come to emergency and sickness. Very Approachable. He's a teacher that you want to go to his lecture. Use your book, always read. He uses the books a lot.

John is an awesome prof! He makes class fun and is really funny. Lectures are power point slides, and some fun movies too. Don't stress about taking notes in class... do the study guides and reading questions and you will be fine. I suggest to split up reading questionsd w classmates it works well. Oh and he has a great curve. Four-pointed class :)
Tests are so easy, he gives a huge boost in your grade for coming to class. Also all the tests are curved, and a 95% is a 4.0. I would suggest taking him, even if it's just a gen-ed.
You get what you put in, that being said, it was always an entertaining class! Wasn't just one viewpoint, encouraged different opinions, which was nice.

Burn is a character! I enjoy going to class and listening to his lectures and stories. Tries to explain things as well as he can but is super disorganized and all over the place on powerpoints. Loses focus very easily, but one of the nicest/funniest professors ever! Test are hard but he rounds! Take him for philosophy classes!

One of the best teachers I've ever had. I wasn't too sure about this class going in but he made it so interesting. He had funny stories that kept me engaged and a true enthusiasm for the subject. The course is very easy if you just go to class and pay attention. I highly recommend this class and this teacher (he drops lowest quiz and hw scores!)

He was a pretty cool dude, very laid back and understood his students didn't want to listen to him rambling about philosophy the whole time. He would get off on tangents, but it made the class more entertaining, in my opinion. The course work was hard, it was a lot of memorization, the exams were hard as well.

He is really really nice and tells lots of funny stories but he does not explain things clearly at all in the least bit. I found this class extremely difficult and I worked very very hard to understand it and I just couldn't. I need it to be explained better and more than just once.  you have a quiz every week as well as about 3 hour long homework

Goes off on random tangents and stories that become distracting from the material. So much memorization and goes through lecture pretty quickly. Interesting topics just hard to remember. He's a funny guy,and a cool professor, but I had no idea what was happening I ended up remembering his stories more than his material. Ended up dropping the class.

Just finished taking his class as elective. Would recommend it to anybody, regardless of their major. Teacher is cool, laid back, not too strict on attendance (I think he allows 6), and he tells u everything u need to know for exam. No homework or quizzes. Only 3 tests and a final exam. Book helpful, but not necessary, I didnt open it once.
He is awesome! Drops quiz and homework grades and curves grades as well. Always willing to help. He makes class enjoyable because he is hilarious. Best professor ever.
Very caring guy -- he brought donuts on the first day of class! He sets you up for success, so make sure to take his course!
Not a lot of work in the course, but the lectures are a bit long. As long as you study the topics that he highlights as important, you will do extremely well in the course.

reviews.comment: He's an excellent professor. He cares more about his students, he's professional  and willing to help his students. I learnt a lot from this guy.
Great professor. Allows every opportunity to get a great grade.

Very nice teacher, passionate, nice to chat & debate with. Easy grades. No homework and midterms+final were either take-home or online. Does change dates without warning but doesn't do it on purpose (he's just old). Would 100% take again.

PHI 1502 is a pretty dry course and he would just talk the whole time didn't use powerpoints so it was a bit hard to follow. The prof is a nice guy though. Assignments were easy but I didn't learn too much. Final exam was a take-home essay too so that was good. Overall it was kind of a pointless class.

Very unorganized. Always changing the dates for everything without being clear about it. Doesn't answer his email. 2 midterms, 2 pass/fail seminars 5% each n a take home final. The class is easy but not worth the stress caused by his constant indecisiveness. Randomly changed my grade on a midterm weeks later n am still trying to get him to fix it.

Terrible class I would never take this prof again. Class material is all over the place and you dont get proper notes. He contradicts himself and class material is already confusing. He seemed super nice in the beginning but once deadlines to drop a class passed by, this man switched. He doesn't follow his own syllabus,no updates if there are changes. reviews.comment: Mouelhi is a nice fellow. He expects everyone to participate and share their opinions, and he will absolutely grill you a bit on said opinions (so be prepared to defend them). The professor can be tough and condescending at times, but if you stay engaged and rely on resources like unstuck study in addition to the free textbook, it's an easy A. Attendance is a must to grasp the concepts.
The worst prof I've ever had

He is so condescending and super passive aggressive during his lectures. His explanations and teaching is so terribly bad that no one seems to understand and even when we ask for help, he repeats the same stuff like that's gonna help? Might complain about his behaviour honestly.
Worst prof I've had a uottawa so far.

reviews.comment: This prof is not as bad coming from most comments. Yes he is VERY monotone & you can get discouraged but it's actually easy coming from a student who never took philosophy. Overall, if you attend his class and write down what he says it's an easy grade. Yes he might not be the best but if you try and write something down, you'll get it !

Overall good prof, not very difficult to understand and was very knowledgeable about the topic. Grading was not hard at all if you paid attention and read the notes. But you had to attend the lectures if you ever wanted to make sense of the documents and bare-bones notes. Overall, I would take it again

45% midterm, 3x5% seminars that are pass/fail and 40% final (take-home). He grades VERY easy and the material isn't heavy. He's horrible at teaching, but he wrote the textbook so you're better off just studying chp 1,2,8,9,11,12. Never listened to his recordings, only read 1 document posted online, and skipped every class except seminars & got A+.

This class started off not so good, we had to complain about the teacher and we really did see change on his behalf(from an objective point of view). The class material had nothing to do with the class. His grading was harsh at first but after complaints it got way better in my opinion, still don't recommend taking him.

RUN!There isn't much I can state about what I liked about this course.His organization is poor and doesn't even follow what he states in his syllabus.For example released seminar topic 2 days before the class when we were suppose to have one week to prepare. The class is not difficult but the teacher made it so much harder for us by not giving us the necessary tools to past the class. he can be funny sometimes but can be though and annoying too

he is so rude and he doesn't care about his students his exams are not easy and not hard a lot of borings audios to hear

I also think the amount of time he gave on tests wasnt fair

the teacher would post the notes after our meeting zoom, so during the meeting he is the only one talking and you don't get the chance to ask question because he is talking about a lesson you did not read yet. you will enjoy his seminar and you get easy point.

One of the worst teacher I've ever had. Blabbles during class about random stuff and gets mad when students ask him to slow down. If you can, take the other teacher

Honestly if I had known how disrespectful he was towards students I wouldnt have taken his class. Don't do it. He is a nice prof and all he knows what he is teaching but he doesn't always convey it in the best manner. You do not need the textbook up until the last few classes and you barely use it so take pictures from a classmate.

Prof Livvarcin was such a kind and caring man that genuinely wanted all his students to succeed. He is a very caring and kind professor who genuinely wants his students to succeed. His lectures were quite boring, but it's mainly because of the material (it is SO repetitive and boring). He always mentions how his office hours are open to his students which I really appreciate.

He's a very friendly and endearing prof. The course seemed a little unorganized and the marking scheme was a tad unclear at times. He's incredible intelligent and knowledgeable. He can lecture the entire class without referring to notes, drawing on contemporary examples to consolidate your learning. I'd sign up for another of his classes.

This teacher is extremely friendly and helpful but the class is AWFUL completely unorganized felt more like a history class than a public admin class. He barely follows the texts books and i drowned myself in the textbook because i could never understand him in class. If you ask questions and make yourself noticeable it will help your grade better.

Adorable prof. Seems a little confused most of the time and the class is very unorganized/has no structure at all. Assignments are clear and he is very helpful. Would recommend him just because he is so funny and nice.

This prof is so unorganized, its insane. He never gives your exams on time and he changes the format of the assignment less than 12hrs before. We learn more about law than actually public management. VERY UNORGANIZED! If you want a clear, organized teacher than dont take his class. Aside from that he's a nice guy, who wants to help but ....
Excellent Prof. Care about his students success. Most down to earth prof at University of Ottawa
The most helpful prof ever had. He really tries to ensure students succeed. Had him for a summer class and although some of the MC questions were tricky, he still gives overall good mark.

He was attentive and helpful in answering ALL of his student's questions; regarding not only the course, but graduate application information for schools. He was very thorough in his knowledge about the course, and if you do your required amount of work, he is a fair marker. One of the BEST professor's in regards to the welfare of his student's.
Mediocre prof - very kind and wants the students to succeed, however no structure whatsoever to his classes and the evaluations do not reflect the work done in class.

Such a great prof. Still in his course but is by far one of the most down-to-earth, funniest professors I have ever had. He is very clear about what will be on exams and what he expects from assignments. He makes time to answer your questions and genuinely cares about his students. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND THIS COURSE OR ANY COURSE WITH THIS PROFESSOR

I really like this prof. He is very funny and lenient and understanding with grading. I think I failed my midterm and he gave me a few points to pass just cause he's nice and despite that I managed to get A as a final grade.

A genuine and nice guy. Can ramble a bit. Brings in free muffins once a semester. Assignments appear a bit daunting, but are honestly super manageable with a month to do each and can even be done in partners. The midterm is a bit difficult, but as long as you study the key facts of each drug and condition, it's totally possible to do well.

Out of all the profs who teach HSS4102 he is probably the best one to take. One thing I will say is there is SO much content on the lectures which can be kind of scary and the midterm is ALOT harder than the final. But he curved our grades so that saved me! DO NOT STUDY EVERYTHING it is impossible. the study guide is everything u need

Mixed feelings about this professor. His exams are very hard, so hard to the point where the class average was horrendous. But he just gives everyone free marks lol so it ends up evening out despite the class average being low.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This prof is truly a gem in the Health Science department. You learn a lot from the class and his lectures are interesting. Yes, the content is heavy and can build up but if you study you'll be fine. Midterms are fair and assignments (worth 35%) are complete boosters. Overall a very caring and down to earth prof

he is terrible. his slides are overloaded and disorganized. each PowerPoint has 80+ slides and you're expected to know every detail for the exam. class averages are always low. he offers no office hours. many students switch sections and he's confused about why he's left with no students. avoid him. he teaches only for the paycheck. embarrassing.

So many slides packed with way too much information and details. The prof seemed nice and caring but the class was unbearable. Exams were hard and you had to know the content extremely well. Hardest health sci class I've taken so far.

It's a very dense course 50-80 slides/deck but he cares so much and will do what he can to raise your marks. Exams aren't easy though and you have to know your stuff, but he'll catch u when you fall. Still not worth the hardship throughout the term, too anxiety-inducing that he had 26 deferrals/150 students or maybe it's because of the class itself
The material is very dense. 50-80 slides and I think it helps to have a caring prof like him cuz he "helps out" your grades. You must study well as his exams really test you, but it's not impossible

Professor Ron's class is hard, but he is the most kind and caring prof and my favourite one thus far! Pharm is definitely one of those class that you must study for from day 1 and frequently engage with the material, so don't let your notes pile up :)

Professor Saulnier is an excellent lecturer and a brilliant person. Exams are hard because there is so much to learn, so many questions (126 marks for 3h final), and sometimes the wording is tricky. Questions are difficult but entirely fair. He is very knowledgeable, approachable, and helpful. A true asset to academia.

Based off the content of the lectures I was initially freaking out because I was never the best "study" student (COVID did not help). However, after taking the midterm I realized that the questions were straight-forward. I would for sure study for this class but he isn't a tough grader and looks for ways to help the class do better.

Was he unfair or was it just a content heavy, comprehension-based exam? the courses Ron teaches are hard, which might not be taken into account when people are writing his reviews. I retained more studying for his exams than I did any other class. He also gives you a midterm breakdown and tells you how many points are on each lecture in advance.

Defenitely an overrated prof on this website! I mean, don't get me wrong: he is an amazing human being, really funny and talks a lot about his experiences.
But the tests are way too long, the questions are tricky and you don't get partial points when multiples answers on MCQ. 2 midterms and 1 final + 3 homeworks. Avoid him if you can!

His midterm was super unfair but overall he is a great professor. When people told him that his midterm was unfair, he made the final more easier and gave us a lot more time to do the questions + some people he shifted SOME weight of the midterm to final. He is really approachable, willing to help. Start studying 3 weeks ahead for final and midterm

Professor Saulnier really wants us to learn the material well and he is always available to answer our questions. Pharmacology is content heavy so you have to start studying from day 1 to remember all the details during exam. The assignments were not too bad as the rubrics were clear, the midterm was too long for the time given but final was fair.

You can tell this professor knows his stuff. This subject is understandably heavy and condensed, however, he was incredibly unfair with the exams and gave harsh feedback to students after midterms instead of working with us to figure out points of weakness when it came to certain questions on the exam. I would avoid if I can.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Considering the circumstances, this professor isn't all that bad. You can tell he genuinely wants to teach the students as he knows the material and he's always cracking jokes but his midterm was super unfair. The assignments were complicated but they did boost the mark. I would say take him if the class is in person... online with him is not fun.
Very disrespectful and extremely unfair in terms of assignment and midterms

the midterm was disorganized, lengthy and full of grammar mistakes. 
He purposely left the long answer for the last page and did not let you skip to that part until you finished the MC. and then surprise you with 5 long answers each with 5 different parts and 11 marks. When the entire class failed and complained he accused us of cheating.

He may have been good in person but online? No thank you. He assigned so many lengthy concept maps due almost biweekly that took some of us upwards of 20 hours to complete for something worth just a few % and was very hard with the marking. His exams take forever to complete and he really set alot of us up for failure. Take Benoit or any other prof
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Ron is by far one of the best profs at uottawa. Pharmacology was a difficult class in general, but Ron made the content tolerable and always cracked jokes throughout the lecture which helped to remember content. He is also a prof who genuinely cares about his students and their success in the class and in life. Amazing prof overall!!

Dr. Saulnier truly cares about his students. He communicates very well and knows his material. He has a great sense of humour. His exams are very fair, but you need to put in work for it because the this class has a lot of content. You need to give yourself time, at least two weeks to study for his exams. He is very fair!

The BEST HSS prof. He is caring and fair. It's a TOUGH course so study from day 1. Attend all the classes&take notes and you won't need the textbook as he's amazing. Grades the 2 papers very generously as long as you put the work in. He gives a breakdown of how many Qs and what lectures they come from before exams. Always available for help! A gem
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Ron is the best professor I have had in my entire undergrad career. you can tell he genuinely cares about all his students. during the covid-19 pandemic, he continuously checked up on all his students, and was always there if anyone needed to talk to him, even if it didn't have to do with course work. an amazing lecturer, extremely smart

This professor is a gem of a human being and is honestly the greatest prof you could have. In addition to being incredibly fair and considerate with workload and assignments, his lectures are fun and he truly loves teaching. He is inspirational and so kind, and the university is lucky to have him. Take a class with him if you can, he is the best!
Perfect!

Really fantastic prof. He cares about his students and enjoys teaching, he's also extremely knowledgeable in what he teaches. The material in the class was difficult but he conveyed it well and gave us plenty of sample questions for the midterm and exam. Two papers were interesting and pretty straightforward. Take a class with him if you can!

dont think this section will be easier than the other class because its not. Ron is a nice prof but he is still tough. I studied 5 days before the midterm and got a 66 and i study 2 weeks before the final and got a 82 so you really need to give yourself time to study because there is a lot to know! Know the disease of the day really well.

Above average prof. No surprises on the tests. Lectures are worth attending. Material is clear and straight forward. The assignments are simple and done solo. (Thank you for that.) You get the feeling he enjoys teaching. Highly suggest taking his classes.

Super nice prof that really does care about his students. The course itself is very hard but the exams are reasonable and he tries to make it manageable. However class is a bit boring and he goes off topic a lot

The course is useless, it has all the info from other courses. Ron is a decent prof his exams are based on the notes. He goes off topic ALOT. he need to stick to the material stuff. the paper wasn't provided with a rubric and the grading wasn't clear

Dr Saulnier is hands down the best prof in the HSS program. He summarizes the textbook perfectly so you don't need to buy it as he only asks questions from his slides or the rare article he wants you to read. If you study the slides and listen in class there is no way you won't get an A. He is hilarious and cares so much about his students.

This professor is very caring of his students and the assignments do give you a chance to boost your mark. However, this was his first time teaching the course so the material was dry and slides are packed with useless information. Didn't learn anything useful and the course should not be mandatory in HSS !
He is an incredible professor, who tries his best to make a difficult course, easier on his students. He is so caring and does everything in his power to help you succeed.
This course was in depth and very interesting because the lecturer made it insightful as he taught the course .

Ron is really passionate about his work and it shows in his lectures. He rushes over topics sometimes, but if you ask him to go back and clarify he's more than willing to slow down the pace of the class and help you out. Very interesting content and he's always cracking jokes to keep you engaged.
He was an amazing prof! Very kind and caring, very clear when teaching and knowledgeable.  I would definitely take a class with him again.

Dr. Saulnier is an exceptional prof! His class is demanding but if you study well and put it in the effort it's possible to finish with a 10. There's a lot of material to study however, he tells you which drug to learn and will only make you memorize the generic OR brand name. He cares about his students and really wants them to succeed! He's great

Let me tell you about Prof Saulnier! He is the best teacher in HSS. You actually learn something coming out of this class. He delivers the content clearly, his power-points are great & his exams are fair. He also gives students a second chance if he sees you really are putting some effort in his class. He's a great person and a great prof!

This prof is awesome! He is extremely fair with his exams. He only makes you memorize either the generic or brand name of the drug. Explains things very clearly and gives little personal jokes and stories that relate to the content. You need to study and put in the effort, but it is possible to get an A+. Don't really need the textbook.

I had Ron for Pharmacology and absolutely ADORED him! He puts lots of dry humour in all of his lectures, and really tries his best to make everything interesting and get to know all of his students. This is not an easy course by any means. Lots of memorization, but if you use a lot of cue cards and mnemonics, you'll be fine.

I loved this Prof! He took the time to speak with the students and learned many of our names...on top of that he was extremely fair about memorizing drug names (you only have to know the generic OR the brand name so that cuts down the work) - he grades very fairly as well. I would definitely take a class with him again!

Great semester with him. A funny and very nice man who cares about his students. Sometimes the classes may be a little boring but that's the nature of the material. There is A LOT of information to know and memorize but you're going to get that with any prof. Plus he marks midterms/exam himself so the marks you get are fair!

The class itself is pretty boring and kind of depressing since it is mostly about diseases. Overall the prof is good, he is very clear but can be monotone and boring, especially when it is the last class of the day. The exams are pretty straight forwards as long as you study the material (which there is a ton of)...Good luck!

Good professor. A little monotone after a while, especially when it is the last class of the day. OVerall the class is not so hard as long as you study the material. He makes the m/c questions funny (and easy) in order to releive stress.
He is a great professor and helpful.. Knows his stuff and tried to bring outside knowledge from his work experiences and scientific articles

IMO,textbook questions were pretty useless compared to old midterms.Only do them if you're a high achiever aiming for A/A+.Better to redo old midterms 3-4 times.Start doing old midterms EARLY,like min 2 weeks before test.DON'T wait until the week of a test or 90% CHANCE YOU FAIL.BETTER STUDY AND REVIEW YOUR NOTES EVERYDAY, even if only for 20 mins

reviews.comment: The most difficult class I ever take. Run away don't take that class I beg you

It is the most difficult course I have ever experienced in my undergraduate study, leaving nearly everyone under great pressure. Prof. Devlin's class is not bad, and she listens to the class's feedback to help class succeed. If you have to take her class, be sure to take notes and do the questions posted on BS, it was really helpful.

This course is challenging, regardless of the professor. If you feel the midterm didn't go well, don't lose hope. Stay engaged in class, practice consistently, and focus on performing well on the final exam. With effort, you can still pass the course.

Mandatory class. 

Prof. Devlin is very knowledgeable, but the class is awful. You must not skip, must repeat every exercise, and you'll still face curveball exam questions. Inconsistent, harsh grading with a very low class average.

uOttawa is dropping the ball on Micro 3. The alternative is better, but it's not an easy class. 

Put in the work.

This is my first time writing a view; Professor Devlin is an excellent professor. This class is hard; it does not matter who teaches that, it matters how you work hard. Professor Devlin is glad to help you when you have a question. Trust me, even though you feel so tired and so hard when you study ECO 3153, just keep going, practice makes perfect!
The worst professor, none of them, could even be said to have had difficulty breathing every day of seeing her. If you want to make your undergraduate life unhappy, feel free to take her course.

Lecture was no help to the exam, which was full of new questions and extremely difficult. This is a compulsory course, I don't know why it is so difficult to arrange this course, to raise the repetition rate to earn more tuition fees?

I've never seen so many hard questions on a midterm before, and I just don't have enough time. Everyone gets low grades. Notes from class don't get uploaded to brightspace. Terrible and mean professor!

The exams are particularly difficult and her exams have nothing to do with the examples she teaches in class. Every test could have new questions that she never covered in class. There are already a lot of people who drop her classes!
Very strict professor, notes from class are not even readable. All abbreviated and not uploaded to Brightspace. lots of questions on exams, very strict class! Runnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn!

She is a very mean professor.She never uploads the notes she writes on her pad in class and her notes are full of abbreviations that only she knows what they mean! Her handwriting is very scribbled. She always made simple things very complicated.

This is the worst professor I've ever had in my four years of college! It will only make things difficult for students! No cell phones! Powerpoint is of no use to her class. She writes notes in class, but she doesn't upload them to brightpace! I don't understand why the school still needs such a lazy and demanding old woman to continue teaching
LAJI JIAOSHOU
class is fun
Complelty terrible.  Avoid this prof.  Does not deserve the time and day to teach anyone. Completly biased and has her favorites. Trust me, this is one person you don't want to meet
YUCK YUCK YUCKEVIL EVIL EVIL EVIL EVIL
No Comments
Bad bad bad

Very good class.  She gives all the notes on the overhead.  Don't waste your time doing the readings, everything you need to know for the exams is in your notes.  She was very friendly and made the class interesting & fun, but she does expect you to study (it's not hard, it's all in your notes!!!)
She does skip steps. She does get lost in between the steps. Her helpfulness is almost 0 considering how hard the given subject is. I would like to see her solving some of the problems she assigns.

She's no-nonsense and tough, but an excellent prof. You'll be well prepared for the final. She explains everything clearly and her notes are complete (she never glosses over material). You'll feel like you got your money's worth out of her course.
Amazing professor despite my interest for this course being low. He made his lectures engaging and the discussions about various forms of technology always had an interesting touch.

Ross is a great prof. Took ENGL1020 with him and he explained the content very clearly. Attendance is not mandatory, but for every other class, there was a writing workshop that had to be completed in class. The workshops were nothing too complicated, in fact I found some of them very interesting. He truly cares about the students.
One of my favorite professors. I don't like accounting, but I liked  having him teach it.
The class is difficult, but if you are going to take it, then I highly recommend taking it with Stewart. He works closely with everyone and makes the class interesting.
Very helpful.  Great explanations.

Ross Stewart is my favorite professor so far at SPU.  He is so personable, so friendly, so Kiwi, and he genuinely cares about his students. He is someone whom I would like to stay in contact with for years after graduating.  Amazing man! And his accent and manerisms are so adorable.
Stewart is no doubt the man. Nothing more to say. He is a great teacher and available for help always. Real funny! Not too hard! Clear on what is expected on test and projects.

I cannot imagine taking Financial accounting with anyone other than Stewart. He explains his points very well and does not mind going over them over and over if you do not understand. He is fun to listen to due to his New Zealand accent as well. However this class is very challenging due the nature of the material.
Love the guy. Excellent teacher who is personable with all students. A little tough at times tho.
He was incredibly nice and thoughtful and will help you figure out anything you don't understand...which is especially good for Financial Accounting.
best teacher so far at SPU

This guy is awesome. After the first day he knew everyone of his students names. I was doing horrible and met him in his office hours and helped me so much. His clas sis not easy but if you do the homework and go to class its an easy pass.
Most amazing professor ever
Great teacher who really cares about his students and how well they do. He even invited his whole class to join him for Thanksgiving and it was awesome!
Ross is a great instructor!
Very nice and helpful. She is clear in what she wants and grades fairly. Participation matters!! Overall loved her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is the best! If ever you don't understand the theory homework, go to her office hours, she will answer them straight up. The course was a breeze. I attended one lecture and got an A+. This course is great for those with previous knowledge in music, the curriculum is the equivalent of Advanced Rudiments for RCM, super easy for Grade 8+ pianists.
Tres bonne prof, ce que jaime le plus c'est qu'elle veut ta reussite! she gives you chances to pass she wants you to succede, will grade fairly! really enjoyed her class!!

what a boring class. Didn't help I was forced to take it (returned to uni 6.5 years after leaving a B. Mus degree) so this course was super easy and super boring. I stopped going to class because everything was in the text book and nothing new was offered.
Great professor and extremely helpful.
SHe definitely tries her best!
Prof. Prevost is one of the most helpful profs I have ever had.  She is kind, intelligent, extremely well-organized and works hard to give her students useful constructive feedback on their work.
nice person.....a little shy for my taste
She may be a good role model for aspiring female acadmics, but she has lots of growing up to do, both as a person AND as a pedagogue.
Hmmmm...if only we knew what she was REALLY thinking about....  I had both a great experience and a really, really crappy one.......WOW  enough said

Man what a dull subject matter, but what a great person Roxane is.  Although she is new, she is kind, friendly, a little shy but in a nice way, and very, very smart.    She is truly one of nicest people in the Department....can even be a friend....

The chemistry is very easy but she extremely frustrated she took three point from my exam because I didnt write my last name beside other pointless but the one for the name was very shocked because I did not see instructed grade like her.

The highest overall score in my class was an 83%, not a single "A" in the class.  The majority of students failed or dropped before failing.  Very disappointed for an "intro" class.  Teacher is ruthless.  If you are 1 minute late turning in homework or labs, she will not accept it, which means you'll miss on the lab portion of the class.

reviews.comment: She's one of the toughest graders ever. You have to be on time or else she won't give you a quiz or accept any homework assignments, regardless if you have a valid excuse. She's very strict and expects too much from her students. You can't really ask her questions because she won't really give you an answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Not an easy grader, do the homework because she quizzes on it often! Attendance is mandatory, she will be rude when you ask questions so prepare yourself. Consider another professor for your own sake.

had a teknothat was all essays: history of chemistry and marked down for incorrect Grammer. Your friend may get more or less points for the exact same answer (she's not bias just inconsistent). Made a girl cry once in lab for a spill. Will degrade you. "You Should know this" is her answer if you ask a question

She is a smart woman who definitely loves chemistry. She can come off as stuck up. Extremely difficult and picky grader(I got -10 points on a test once for improper sentences and grammar) even though the answers were correct. While she is a good teacher, she could stand to calm it down a bit.
She grades very hard but her lectures are very clear and her exams are not very hard.

She is a very nice prof. Lectures are boring, but that's a result of the content rather than her teaching. Very similar to GNG 1103. TA's do majority of the marking and can be quite picky, but she has a policy that deliverables can be resubmitted within a week of receiving your original grade for remarking.

This class has a lot of separate assignments and is very similar to GNG1103 with more focus on economics and business. The professor gave very interesting and engaging explanations to the topics explored and as someone who is not too interested in business, she grabbed my attention! Would definitely take this professors class again
Overall, Dr. Russell is a good professor.  The material made the lectures pretty dull.  Grades were fair and tests were no surprise. He is very helpful during office hours.
This guy is ballin.  Definately the most helpful math professor I have ever had.  As for his tests...it's no easy A, but I'd say his class is graded fairly.
He is a bit soft-spoken, but a very helpful and nice person. The material is hard but he does his best to make sure the class understands it.
He is very clear...I didn't do very well in his class becuase I slacked off, but if you show up and just follow his handouts, you should get an A

i really don't think this class should be as hard as he makes it....he's not easy to understand, and super super boring....as long as you keep up, which is hard to do since it is soooo boring, you should do fine....otherwise, mr. russell is a very nice guy

If you have no prior experience with stats,you may not want to take him because the class gets boring and its difficult to pay attention.If you do have experience,the tests aren't that hard and he drops quiz grades.Basically, half the class is doing very well and half is failing.It just depends.
Class is incredibily boring!!! You basically end up teaching yourself the material and if you need real help, go to the open help sessions and get another teacher to show you.

Taken a few classes with Stec and he's one of my favourite profs. Often teaches different softwares & has us use them in smaller assignments, but not usually mandatory for the final project. My best advice: show up to class on time and do the work. If you show effort, he will too, particularly for one on one meetings (super helpful, schedule them)

Don't expect this to be an instructional course for any specific software; It's more focused on developing collaboration and critique skills. Plenty of interesting, open-ended projects that allow you to explore the medium, and experiment in developing creative ideas. Slack off in this class and it'll suck, but engage with it and you'll have fun!

Didn't really teach at all. If you have no editing or filming experience you're kinda left on your own to figure it out. Gave no written feedback, just a letter grade. Often went on rants and was rude to students if he was in a mood. Preached about how disrespectful it is to be late then continued to show up late to every class. overall meh.

Prof Stec is not a good media teacher! In fact he does very little teaching. His critiques are lacking! He had a guest in to help critique students work and they were far more knowledgeable, relatable and meaningful than anything Stec ever offered.
Ryan Stec is awesome!
I've taken a few classes with Stec, he is always super interesting and really evokes great conversation. It's a pleasure to be in his classes.

Attended this class with above-average video editing and computer technology experience. This class should not be a problem for you if you have these experiences. In addition, he tries his best to understand and make happy the students. He is a very good and caring teacher.
Great teacher. Thoughtful and clearly cares about his students. Lots of projects but they are interesting and engaging!
Ryan's class was fully discussion-based and many students rarely participated. Material was rarely compelling. Assignments are easy and graded leniently. Easiest class to skip I've ever taken.

This summer class was meant to be taken in person but it changed to online so it ended up being not what I expected. There were 4 hw 1 Final & a 10+ page. Overall Dr Pepper was a good professor I just wish I could have experienced the class in person we got some good material, great readings and great videos to learn throughout the 5 weeks.

reviews.comment: He answered questions quickly and clearly. His lectures are excellent and easy to understand, and he always provides helpful feedback.

reviews.comment: he doesnt grade homeworks nor other papers terrible professor
Absolutely splendid experience.
He is the best mathematics professor. His lectures are easy to following and understand. He is super easy.
The lectures were alright but this man tests were difficult with a formula sheet I could remember even if I studied the night before and Avoid this Professor Now.

Dr Pepper has honestly been the best math professor I've had. I have always struggled with math and the way he teaches made this class so easy. Great professor, 2 exams and a Final does not use blackboard. All Homework is online and has a huge passion for Math, Beware he will go off on Tangents. If you're bad a math, I recommend him as a professor
Super nice professor overall. Lecture was easier than expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: textbook isnt needed at all as long as you go to class and pay attention. The homework is online. He does go off on tangents but he still teaches what needs to be taught and sometimes he speaks a little fast. he made math pretty interesting. Class can be boring most of the time so be prepared. Doesnt use blackboard which is kinda frustrating. 7/10
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he cant stick to one topic and he is unable to go in depth about the topic that is at hand. Hes a cool guy but hes too jittery to be a math professor.
This guy is a treasure.

He is very passionate, he loves math and that makes you want to love it even more. Dr. Pepper is very understanding and flexible! He is always open for any type of discussion and he is easy to talk to.

Great Professor. No textbook required,teaches it all by his lectures (So don't skip class). He makes his lectures interesting and even goes into some of the Philosophy of Math. He has alot of energy in the morning (which i'm jealous of) so he may speak a bit fast and go off on tangents, but he always circles back and explains everything clearly.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Pepper is a really sweet guy. He prefers to receive feedback on how he is teaching and will actively work with you if you are trying. His classes sometimes venture into "story time"  but it can make the dry topics more interesting. He prefers morning classes so be at school by 8am.

Do not take him if your not good in math. reviews.comment: Was definitely a difficult class with high expectations for a 100 level sociology class. However I know she was passionate and talented. I enjoyed taking her class despite the difficulty and would take her again.

If you liked super disorganized classes, take this one! Got back from Thanksgiving break and hadnt received ANY grades for ANY assignments! We took 30 mins to do ice breakers instead of talking about class topics. She never told us what she wanted then got mad when it wasn't what she wanted. Honestly, I feel like I wasted money taking this.

She is a bit lenient with deadlines but that's the only good thing about her as a prof. No rubric for any assignment, no feedback until the day before grades due, too many assignments, & too many movies watched. She means well but her opinions can be problematic. Always unprepared and will hold students to standards that we can't expect in return

This professor is horrible, she is rude and hypocritical to what she says she stands for, especially being a sociology teacher. She is extremely opinionated, offers no genuine feedback, grades extremely hard for no reason and assigns readings/papers as if it were a graduate level sociology class. Impossible to reach, and has double standards.

First of all, she's an extremely rude person and professor. Didn't have office hours (which are required) and takes a week to reply to emails. No rubrics for huge papers and grades them harshly. Additionally, assigns so many papers but takes years to grade them or makes the TA do it. Makes me upset that I paid tuition to attend this class.
Gives way too much work for a habit of mind course. Harsh grader. She's very nice but not a great prof. Avoid
This teacher required way too much work for simply a gen-ed class. Avoid if possible.

The most ridiculous teacher I ever had in my entire life! I don't know if the teacher herself is incredible or it's because of the online instruction. We spend the first 3 classes learning how to upload videos through canvas; and the last 3 classes meditating. If you want to explore some awkwardness, come! She even failed making multiple choices.

she didn't grade anything until the literal last day of the session so the entire time we had no idea how we were doing. this was especially tough when she said "this was just a crappy paper" attached with one of the biggest paper grades so :( def don't take this as a habits of mind bc it's more work and more annoying to deal with than it should be

reviews.comment: Prob the worst professor in AU. Take anyone else but not her. She is so disorganized and arrogant.

reviews.comment: Really nice Professor who does care about students and is accommodating. She doesn't give clear guidelines on papers but is a tough grader. Assigns lots of reading for a 200 level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Despite preaching openness as one of her most valued qualities, Prof. McDonic is not open to opinions that are not her own. If you disagree with her, she will immediately dismiss you and not give you the chance to defend your point. We also spent the entire time watching movies to the point where I felt I could've taken the class in my dorm room.

reviews.comment: She is disorganized and really hard to reach out of class and doesn't give specific instruction, but if you reach her somehow at office hours she can be helpful!
She is very creative, open and supportive. Very well recommended.

I took this class just to fill my credits and it was the worst decision I have made. If you are not interested in the topic of this course and do not want to read anything relating to this topic, do not take it. You get graded on a few things for the whole semester and you seriously need to read the min. 20 page readings to pass your papers/exams.

reviews.comment: Personality: Loves her students and really wants them to do well. Teaching: Lecture/reading-heavy! Grading: Fairly-tough grader. reviews.comment: The only grades in this class are two papers, a test, and a final project. She is a fairly tough grader on the papers. Too demanding for an intro/gen ed class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor McDonic is a great person and great professor. She will widen your world view and introduce you to things you have never known. Attendance and doing the readings is very important. She is super helpful in office hours and is willing to listen to any concerns or help you with anything you are confused about.

Professor McDonic is one of the best professors I have had at AU. She is very insightful and caring. Put a little bit of effort into her class and it will go a long way. She is always willing to help and is very accommodating to special circumstances . Professor McDonic is definitely one of those teachers you should get to know personally.

Your final project for this class will be a three minute movie. This class is not a film class and knowing how to use Imovie or Adobe Premier are not prerequisites for this class. Do not take this class unless you have to for your major as it does not run like an introduction class at all. McDonic is also not good at responding to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: She's very knowledgeable and passionate, but also incredibly opinionated and biased. Almost makes you feel bad if you don't see things the same way she does. Quizzes are difficult, but DO THE READINGS and they'll be fine. I don't think I'd take this class or her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I love this woman. Her class is so easy and she is the most interesting person. I literally love her and was never bored listening to her talk. Do it for the bats..t insane stories she has about her life. I wrote one of the worst essays of my life and got an A on it. Amazing all around
She is a nice person on her own time but not a good professor.

reviews.comment: She's an amazing professor with exceptional views on the world. I love talking to her and participating in the class because she has fantastic and brilliant responses. She truly is an inspirational teacher and she defiantly the best ANTH teacher in AMERICA(n university) TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's vague with her comments but isn't  a bad person.
