reviews.comment: Professor McDonic is a nice teacher who cares a lot about her students and global issues. Unfortunately, for an introductory sociology course, there is very complicated and long readings in between classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She's a great professor who obviously cares about her students and the topics. She's emotionally invested in what she teaches and it shows, with creative and engaging lectures. You really do need to take notes and pay attention during the class though, as often the  material will make a great deal more sense through her interpretation.
Your grade is based on two hard quizzes, one paper and an I movie project. Everything is graded really hard. You have to work very hard for your grade.

one of the most life-changing things I've ever experienced. If you're open-minded and ready to learn I suggest you take this class. Mcdonic is the most down to earth human being I've ever encountered in my entire life. love her & wouldn't mind taking the class again

There is no midterm or final but there are two exams, a paper and Imovie project. There is a lot of reading and you have to be able to discuss them. The exams are not clear and the papers are not graded by her but by a TA..

This class was really eye-opening for me, and I truly believe that McDonic is just the right balance of knowledgable and eccentric that it really works. Her lectures during the first half of the semester were really interesting, but she seemed to lose steam by the end of the class. Her tests and quizzes can be rough, as well as the final project.

McDonic is an interesting woman. She is VERY passionate and knowledgeable about the Global South &  brings a lot of her own opinions, experiences and beliefs into class lectures. She tends to go off topic a lot and the class is not very structured. Her final exam was brutal as it was subjective questions with objective answers. Shes a character..

She is a really smart and happy professor. She makes me anxious with how her quizzes and tests are made, but if you really read and WRITE EVERYTHING DOWN during lectures, you will be great!! She is a little slow with putting grades up.

McDonic Rocks. She has a really nuanced understanding of the world and she's happy to share as well as to listen. Class with her is a pleasure and even influenced me to pick up a double-major in Sociology

LOVE HER!!! Views was an amazing class and McDonic was a huge part of that. She is incredibly knowledgeable, has a very nuanced perspective, and she's incredibly passionate about the Global South, as well as her students. If you give this class the respect it deserves, it will change your life. McDonic gives very reasonable assignments.

Prof. Mcdonic was an inspirational teacher who opened my eyes to many world issues. At first the readings seemed difficult but  I got used to them (all scholarly sources, no book to buy). There's 2 quizzes, a mid year, 2 writing assignments and a project final. If you need an area 3 and also want a teacher who's down to earth, take this class

I am a bit biased, because I have had her before, her teaching style is perfect fir me, and the subject matter was right up my alley. But despite a surprising lack of structure in her class and sneakily tough grading, I genuinely feel like I get a lot out of her class and from her qualifications.

McDonic is the most passionate and caring professor I have ever had. She is genuinely interested in raising awareness of the atrocities happening in the global south, and cares deeply about her students. Enjoyed this class thoroughly and meeting McDonic. Most incredible woman, highly recommend taking Views from the 3rd World!

She is an amazing professor! Some lectures can get a little boring, but you watch a lot of interesting documentaries. She is really passionate about the subject and it shows. There are a lot of readings but you can still do well without doing them. The assignments are straight forward and grading is lenient. Great class!

She admitted to knowing nothing about the material, which certainly showed. While it is not a good judge of her teaching abilities, it was easy to get by without doing any of the readings. Only a few major assignments, towards the end of the year.

Interesting topic, but some lectures can get boring.  A lot a lot of reading but you don't even have to do it, you'll be fine.  She has a TA grade all the papers, so see the TA at office hours to make sure you will get a good grade.  We watch interesting documentaries.  Quizzes and papers aren't too challenging.

Great professor! Lectures are so engaging and interesting because she is so passionate about what she's teaching.  Assignments are relatively straight forward and she grades pretty leniently.  Readings are long and difficult, but you can honestly not do them and be fine.  Overall a great class!

She is one of the most kind, compassionate, and smart people you will ever meet. Go to her lectures, they will change the way you think about the world. Go to her office hours! She will commend strong arguments and offer the utmost constructive of criticisms to weaker works. She is a great resource, amazing professor, and a wonderful human being!
A-M-A-Z-I-N-G! We heart Prof McDonic. Funny, understanding, and simply amazing.

Professor Mcdonic is an incredibly engaging lecturer and held my attention throughout the entire course - despite having a differing opinion. She is very kind and offers a unique perspective to the subject matter, especially at her office hours. I think many people mistake her passion for stark opinions - she has an open mind! Take her class!

McDonic made me change my major from SIS to anthropology. She's so intelligent, and very passionate about what she does. Be respectful to her and she'll do all she can to help. I definitely recommend her class.
The reading was really hard and I good barely keep up with her in-class discussions. But she was a really easy grader as far as papers and projects are concerned, which were most of the grade.
Incredible. I'd like to listen to her lecture forever.

Difficult assignments but she's a pretty easy grader.  Prof. McDonic is really passionate about her work and it shows through her lecture.  The class really makes you think about the world in a different light.  (Note: There is definitely a liberal spin, but she is very open to different opinions)

Don't miss a class because she doesn't let you make up assignments no matter what. (even if your absence is excused)  Grades are returned so late that you never know how you're doing in the class until after the semester ends.  Would not take class again.

I'm in her class right now and I think she's amazing. She's the most open and up front person I've ever met in my life. I was dreading having to take soc since I'm all about the natural sciences, but so far I love this class. I've learned more than I could ever have dreamed and its only October.

Professor McDonic is a total sociology wonk. She was really knowledgeable and I learned a lot from her class. She can pile on the reading, but it's generally really interesting. I would definitely take class with her again.

I highly recommend the class. McDonic started from the very core of everything and addressed larger issues only after she was sure everyone understood the foundation on which we were working. Great class. very deep.

Pretty easy, 1 paper, midterm, and exam was a visual project and paper. I would recommend just reading it at the library because you use the book until the midterm after that you're not tested on it. I found her grading moderately tough. You watch a lot of movies. I'd say take it because it's easy, she's nice, you can get an A, and it's interesting

Class could have been taught better. Lots of readings, but you dont have to do them, just submit questions on them. Participate a little in class and you'll do fine. Final video project is easy. Hardest thing is 10 page paper. We didnt have a final.

Come into her classes with an open mind.  She has an opinion, but does not force it upon you. If anything, she offers a great perspective to the world that college students aren't used to. I hated her at first, but i got over myself and realized that she has a lot to say that is very, very interesting. Great teacher.

I love McDonic! Her in-class discussions, movies and debates are very insightful, BUT her reading is often lengthy and difficult to understand. She expects a lot from her students, but the midterm isn't that hard and the research paper and visual assignment are both actually really fun!

One of the best professors I had.  She clearly has an opinion, and she may disagree with you, but she does not discount others personal views.  Tests and essays are easy to get an A on.  Really interesting to talk to, especially in office hours.
She is horrible, she does not respect other opinions, just bias and you get a good grade, if you have a different opinion, you fail.
One of the smartest, most intelligent thinkers I've ever met. She has an opinion, and it's usually right. Great class, made me realize so much about the world I live in.

I don't understand the comments here, Professor McDonic is very open to opinions and debate.  She has a point of view certainly but that doesn't make her closed minded.  I learned a lot in this class and found that it really opened my eyes to a lot of things.  I also found her to be very helpful outside of class when needed.  Great professor.

Professors like this are the reason I transferred AWAY from AU.  She spent every class talking about her life experiences and how they made her a better person than us.Hates Americans, and didn't hesitate to tell us how ungrateful and stupid the people of this country are.Any opinion that differs even slightly from her own was shot down.avoid her!

this professor is easily the worst one i have ever had in my life. makes the most close minded, outrageous statements and manipulates students to agree with her. nurtures students **** ideas of the white man being the devil. HORRIBLE. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS UNLESS YOU WANT TO BE TERRIBLY FRUSTRATED.

Her opinions are facts, she never agrees with you, and she is one of the most close minded professors I have ever encountered. Why is she even in America if she so critical of it, get right out. If you aren't a die hard liberal that hates America, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

This rating won't mean much because she's leaving after the spring term. However, I found this class to be a pain. I felt the assignments were ambiguous, but maybe I am an idiot. No textbook but lots of scholarly readings. Professor is smart but often too revealing about herself. Didn't like the subject material.

First, whoever said 'hot' is WRONG. Very intelligent woman--even more closed-minded. If you want a lively debate, DON'T take this class. If you share her views (socialist-feminist) you'll love it. The readings are repetitive and many are boring. The class is a joke. Don't get me wrong--she's a very cool, very experienced person. Bad professor.

She was a great teacher and really an amusing person to listen to in class and often makes really funny jokes.  Sit up front though because if your in a lecture you wont catch anything.  But do the readings!  The papers are pretty simple as the majority of the people take the class for Gen Ed requirements.

This class was amazing, I learned so much.  She didn't approach it the way I thought but I am grateful because I learned so much more about how the world works. She is smart, compassionate and definately open to opposing views.  She was always available to help.  Take her classes, she is awesome! She will open your eyes and challenge your thinking.

Terrible professor.Not open-minded at all. She HATES Christians, conservatives, and basically anyone that respectfully differs in opinion from her. Spent 20 minutes before evaluation pleading for good marks after having spent all semester spouting and preaching hatred and intolerance. You'll get an A if you accept her BS as gospel (pun intended).

This professor is a joke. In her class, we watched a movie every day and talked about pointless, trivial things the other days. Some days, she didn't bother to show up.   Although she seems passionate about her material, she is unable to convey information to others. Her grading is laughably easy.  Her class: an easy A but  waste of your time.

Absolutely excellent. She is incredibly open-minded and compassionate about the world that she studies. She also encourages students to think outside their own experiences and biases to understand the connectedness of all the world. She is simply one of the best profs I have had at AU.

She knows her stuff, but seems to assume you already know it as well. Dense reading - and lots of it. That said, she really does open your eyes to a whole different perspective of looking at the world. In other words, your typical liberal, commie college professor that may be too smart for her own good - but hey, isn't that why you came to college?

she's disorganized, some of the films for the class are outdated and she doesn't like to individually help students. however, shes really passionate and knows her stuff, most of the films are quality and the texts will give a better understanding of the 3rd world in general. wish for more discussion classes, they were the most helpful part of class

Professor McDonic is a great teacher. She pushes you to question the world around you. She is an inspiring compassionate person. The movies she shows are truly fascinating. She is a very intelligent, informed, wise instructor.She will open your mind up to concepts that you would have never thought of. Take her class shes one of AU's best.

She doesn't actually teach this class. We watch informational movies almost every class and I am constantly bored. Coming into the class I was hoping to learn a lot about the third world, but  I've only learned what it's like to take a boring and un-engaging class. Find another way to satisfy gen-ed classes. Nice teacher...but doesn't teach.

Among the worst classes I have ever taken.  She constantly tells us her time is too valuable to help us and in the process wastes valuable class time complaining.  Is not clear at all and doesn't explain anything.  A VERY opinionated woman that trys to convince you that she is always right and you are always wrong. AVOID IF POSSIBLE!
Didn't learn much, hated the books, she is really opinionated and above my head sometimes. Likes the class to discuss, but very bad at leading a discussion and the topic always strays...

McDonic is a good professor, she is really interesting to listen too, the only problem is that if you have taken previous gender courses you might not get as much out of the course as if you were taking one for the first time. If you know the theories and general themes of the course an A is totally possible.

This woman is amazing. No need to have a background in anthro to understand the social discussions in class. Extremely articulate, clear, emotional, helpful and a wonderful teacher. Opens students' eyes to the things around them that they should already know.

Terrible. Always late with no apology. Disorganized-forgets things like it's her job. The class is a continual presentation of opinion as fact. 2 week minimum for getting assignments/tests back. Anthro majors are waist deep trying to brown-nose with her too. If this is a gen ed requirement,  RUN AWAY RIGHT NOW, FIND ANOTHER CLASS!!!!

She is awesome, super smart, funny and approachable.  I learned so much in this class.  Definately one of the best classes I have taken at AU.  Fabulous prof, take her classes.  She wants you to learn and you will!

She is awesome and really knows her stuff. She sounds like a scary grader but isnt at all.  She will change the way you look at the world.  One of the best classes I've taken here.  Definately take her classes!

One of my favorite profs at AU.Definitely one of the best in the Anth department.  It was her first semester here so she had difficulties but overall it was a great class - of course you'd have to do the reading to know that.  Changed the way I look at the world.

I don't know what the rest of the students are saying!!! She was awesome as a professor--very accessible and welcoming... I got a B and I know I did not do all the work but I enjoyed the class a lot...
very approchable always willing to talk after class.  She has high standards but grading is fair and material is really interesting.
hard class but I learned alot.  She expects a lot but is willing to work with you.  Can't think about race or racism in the same way, opened my eyes.  Take her class

WORST PROF I've at at AU! She was unorganized, could not adapt to class's needs, could not understand that we did not have PhD's in Anthro- material was geared for students with background in the subject, while we clearly did not. Treated us like 7th graders with summaries due for each reading, yet no one every understodd the reading.

Unorganized, brought her daughter to every Tuesday class, spent more than half of each class rambling on about nothing...too many books in a short period of time.  Nice person, yet not fit to teach the class.  Not very engaging at all..
she cannot articulate herself well enough to describe anything  it took us about two hours (more than one class) for her to describe what she wanted on our final paper

class was awful. we had 2 read grandiloquent, long articles & summarize 4 almost every class. the material was 2 abstract & difficult 2 understand 4 someone w/ no background in anthropology.  prof was unorganized.  didn't respond 2 student contacts. no idea what ur grade is during semester bc article summaries r graded w/ check -, checks, & check +

OST2053 -  She's a very nice professor. She give alot of work for this 1 credit course. Sometimes the due dates for assignments are all over the place. Just do your work and you will pass. I received a B in the course and that's missing an assignment. You do need the book too.
She is old, unprofessional and not particularly knowledgable of ANYTHING. She also shows poor business ethics. I think this was one of the worst teachers I've ever encountered.

Great professor.I took Geb2430 business ethics online. She is very helpful and yes, at times the due dates of work can be confusing. But I passed the class with an A. As long as you do your work trust me you will pass. You will need the book for all course work though. Good luck!!! :-)

This was an online class, the class was tedious and if you have questions you must e-mail her and she does not respond in a timely manner which is quite upsetting because your grade depends on it. When she does respond to discussions or e-mails they are not always clear.

Great Teacher! I've taken her twice online already and she is very helpful. At times she is not always clear but she responds quickly and works with you. When I didn't know how to do something I saw her on campus and she sat with me and helped me. I highly recommend her.

HORRIBLE PROFESSOR!!!She is the worse teacher that I ever had.  Her classes are boring because she is so confusing with herself, she is lost.  She knows nothing about Mac computers and she is the course manager?? Never answers emails or phone calls. Do not take HTML or Illustrator with her. BC should chose better professors.  Her grade:  F--

This is the new class code. when I took the class it was GRA -Web Design.Great teacher. Very fair. Grading is spelled out point by point. You know when you submit your projects what your grade is. No surprises. If you calculate your grade your self, you already know if you are getting a C, B, or A. Wriotten tests are extremely hard. I got only Cs a

NOT RECOMMENDED. Syllabus full of inaccurate dates. Does NOT return emails for weeks. Very SLOW to grade assignments, sometimes 2 months, but if you submit late, you lose points. Does not help at all if you have a question or a problem. Disrespectful to her students and disgrace to the college.

planning to take her computer class... to graduate? well take her now get it over.. i was on myspace and doing work at the same time! just do what she say and show up...and chill  their are two power point presentation which is kinds optional because i only did one and pass..she is nice and helpful if u into computers
she is great, i bet those who didn't like her just didn't do well in her class. its easy to get A's on ALL her classes

she is such a sweet person! and her class was fairly easy! i mean, you are only learning the basics to Microsoft office@!!! I'm glad i took this class and learned the shortcuts to long tasks and formulas. However, the class is very boring. Most people were behind for some reason ?! Although, Ms. Lambert is very good with taking her time to help out

Don't take her internet class!!!She can't catch up with everything, doesn't return e-mails/questions on time, you really are on your own she doesn't help at all. If you are not a self learner you will not do well.. Will never take an online course again!
Great teacher if it your first time with computer. Take time to explain the school work. Remind me of the old fashion classroom. When the teacher really taught. Walk around to see if you need help.

Class was online, and you are on your own! Have taken many online classes. This teach would wait for a week to get back with  email response. It was terrible. Only good is that she allows you to hand in late.Took her a month to grade one project so I am not suprised. Horrible online instructor. Good in independent study? Take her! If not , BEWARE!

Never gives us time to practice. We get lectured on the most boring level for 3 months and the last month it's all about turning in projects every class. She is not helpful at all, whenever I had a problem, she could barely solve it. Her "subjective" grading constantly ignores and takes away some points from your final grade. Never again.

Ms Lambert is a sweetheart.... BUT Her class is hard considering it was my elective and 5 months of sitting in class only to get a packet of HARD Assignments expected to be completed in one month. She went out of her way to help everyone even outside of class. But it's hard if you aren't familiar with computer terms. She expects alot but is sweet

ONly take this women if you have the major other wise stay out of her path. She is very rude, **** and mean. She doesn't like it when you know more than she does. Although her background is in Communications she really doesn't have a degree in this field. She thinks she is teaching you what you need to know about multimedia but she is not.
I took her class online and loved it. She made it fun and interesting.

This teacher is hard. She goes to quick/ she expects you to know what to do even though it is your first time in the class. She can also be rude towards some people. If you take this class make sure you take photoshop first. Lambert is the worst teacher I have ever taking in my two years of college.
She's a very helpful teacher.

I'm not done with the course yet but the class is very weird. Some things make sense but most don't. We pretty much talk about random texts whenever they mention animals. Lots of very heavy readings. The teacher is nice though, and if you like that kinda thing with lots of interpretation and discussion then its cool ig

reviews.comment: Ne prenez pas ce cours, il est un peu fouillis et très vague. Un peu trop globalisant. Les invités ont des sujets inintéressants et tellement nuls. Le professeur est gentil et est prêt à répondre aux questions. Mais ces réponses ne résolvaient pas mes soucis. Je déconseille fortement...
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Course was unorganized due to the fact that its new however prof did his best.

J'ai aimé le sujet d'interdisciplinarité et les concepts qu'on a abordé. Par contre, il n'y avait pas de powerpoint ou enregistrement qu'on pouvait se référer durant le cours (visuel avec points clés) ou pour nos révisions d'examen. Les exams et les travaux de groupe sont assez facile.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: What is this class? Couldn't tell you if my life depended on it. I read the texts, did the assignment and still have no idea what I am supposed to be learning, if I am learning anything at all.

I still do not know what this class was about to this day. Super ambiguous all the time and no clear course plan or actual course material presented. Seems like a good guy but needs to work on his teaching skills. Whole class is just random philosophical texts that are very hard to interpret with very loose ties between them.

Class was confusing and only received readings. Lectures were difficult to understand in addition to the course content itself. If it weren't for the group projects (worth 45%), I would have definitely failed. Professor was very vague as well when discussing work and the exams.
Very great teacher. She was very knowledgeable. She does give lots of homework. Make sure you come to class because she goes over lots of materials.

Prof did good with very limited ressources, very helpful and flexible during office hours. Material isnt easy but if you take the time to understand the homework assignments youre guaranteed to do good on the exams. Exams were 10-20 multiple choice questions, pretty short.

Super disorganized when it comes to exams... Exams are separated in two brightspace quizzes, back to back. First part is with excel and the second part is math questions with lockdown browser. Both monitored by joining a teams meeting with mic and camera on.
Teaches really fast. Monotone voice. Get ready to study A LOT.

reviews.comment: Tara Cohen is an amazing, young, enthusiastic teacher who is there for you no matter what you need. The tests are easy if you pay attention in class or if you study the power points on her webpage. Overall she has been a fantastic teacher! (Also easy on the eyes)

Dr. Konkle is a course supervisor (not teaching prof) for my class and my experiences with her have been great. She seems like a prof who cares about her students and wants to prepare us for the realities of grad studies. Overall a positive experience (though I cannot speak to her instructing abilities). Fair, flexible and gives us academic freedom

She was a tough grader for our projects- AVOID. She made our MENTAL HEALTH class be a burden on my mental health. Did not enjoy what I thought would be a fun and interesting class. That being said, exams are pretty easy but the project (worth 35%) was absolutely insane.

avoid for online classes. She did pre record the lecture which was great, but she does a poor job of actually explaining the course material and her slides lack detail as well. Anne Konkle is the worst teacher I have had in 4 years at university. I have never seen exams so poorly representitive of the material. She has no idea what she is teaching. She feels embarrased during the classes because she gets all mixed up and goes to read her notes. She is so unfair and suggests you to drop the course and throw away 1000$

Nice prof but the exams demolish you. I took this class only taking in account her rating but because the exams are so tough, I would never retake anything with Konkle. She will ask questions of medication name we never studied in class

reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor really cares about us connecting the content to ourselves in some way! There is a midterm, a solo paper, a group final paper (instead of exam), and a group presentation. The papers and presentation are doable and not hard! She is helpful if you approach her! She does not negotiate marks though. Midterm was fair, textbook was not required.

Premièrement, elle donne 2 heures de théories (lecture de ses diapos) sans pause donc à la fin, la concentration n'y est plus. Ses examens sont faciles par contre!

Bonne prof mais cours très difficile ... J'ai mis plus d'effort dans ce cours que n'importe quel et j'ai quand même eu beaucoup de difficulté. Il y a beaucoup de matières mais peu de celle-ci se retrouve sur l'examen. Difficile à se retrouver dans les A.
Extremely nice lady and very helpful, but her classes are tough. You need to put in a lot of effort to break into the A's spectrum.

She's an amazing prof, loved her for 4324! The course has an oral presentation, participation marks, a term paper instead of a final, and one midterm. She marks hard for the paper and the midterm requires a lot of memorization, but considering there is no final it's not too bad of a course load. She gives very good feedback as well!

As a person, she was really nice. Classes were interesting. However, I pretty much died in her exams. Normally,   I would consider myself to be a pretty good student. But, there was just someone about her exams that just doesn't work for me even when I've studied.
Anne est très gentille et passionnée pour sa matière, mais il y a énormément de matière et ses examens sont trop longs..

She was very easy to understand, examples given were fairly reflected in the midterms and final exam. People in the class said she went too fast, but these were people who didn't know how to read simple coordinates on a line graph.
Bonne professeure. Elle est bien organiser et enseigne bien la matiere

Look I hate her with a passion but that's because she's a snake who wouldn't increase my grade because I was .3% short... She's a good lecturer, her exams were fair however she corrected very strictly and she always had time for her students. And yea the textbook is completely useless.

Worst prof that I have had so far. She never give hints on the exams - which are too long to actually finish. Don't bother attending this class as you will learn more from reading the textbook - got a C by doing so. Avoid if at all possible.

She takes a long time to mark midterms and then did not even post the marks before the final exam. Midterms were impossible to finish because they were way too long. They did not represent what was taught in the lectures. She doesn't even use the assigned text book.

Terrible prof! Rushes through slides, does not explain material well. Midterms are extremely long and there isn't sufficient time provided to finish all the questions. She comes off as a snob. Refuses to answer people's questions during midterms. Only answers VC questions if there is an exam the next day. Does not give ANY hints prior to exams.
The exams are ridicously hard! the question are usually about subject she never talked in class! She do not explain well!!! If you can avoid her....DO IT!!!!

Bonne professeure.  Elle est passionnée de la matière qu'elle enseigne mais a parfois de la difficulté à garder l'attention des étudiants.  A améliorer: distinguer ce qui est matière à examen et non.  Autrement, c'est une excellente prof qui donne de très bons conseils quand on lui consulte un à un! Très gentille! Un bon semestre.

BGEN215 was very easy, but also a dumb class. Tim didn't really understand anything about young people & talked about himself A LOT. He is a nice guy and has made it in the business world, but isn't really up to date. Lectures were useless, but he was very easy like too easy. I got a 100% and didn't try. He's a nice guy, but go with Bonnie instead.
Kindest professor I've experienced at Uottawa. Bombed the final and failed the course but still got to redeem myself with extra credit, only regret not trying harder.
This professor is extremely accommodating and definitely cares about her students and what she teaches. I would take all of her classes if I could!
So kind, so sweet! Follow her, get A+
There will be a lot of classes where you are just listening to group presentations

She is a very professional person. She makes her expectations clear from the start and tells us how we can succeed in her class. However, you gotta put in the work because there is a lot of reading. Finally, if you are interest enough in the class and work har enough it is easy to get an A.

Probably one of the worst profs in the political science faculty. If she does not like you, just forget about receiving the grade you deserve. Avoid

Expect to put in the work and the rest will be fine. Pretty straightforward if invested & start the assignments early. 2 group projects + mid/final

This class was amazing! Prof. Curlic is a gem, she's super nice and willing to give extensions. We went on 3 field trips to the National archives, UO's museum and archives. 

Assignments were primary source analyses and the final is a take-home paper. 10% of your grade is based on group discussions so do the readings, they're pretty short though.

There is no class you attend. The professor shares PowerPoints and that's literally it. If you want free credits go ahead but if you actually want to learn something about music it is a waste of time. Horrible course for online learning. I took him for the class "Sound of Rock" in French and it was great. There is a lot of cool listening to music in class, and as a prof he is really nice. I would definitely take his classes again, he's dope

If you don't like Philosophy then don't take a class that starts with PHL,if you do however and are willing to read the textbook, which was just portions of other books, are competent and listen to her audios this class is easy. Don't miss deadlines answer the questions how she explains on quizzes and you will be fine. back up your points in essays
No clear grading scheme, audio lectures do not assist with what she wants you to learn. no formal lecture, just a chat box to have in class discussion. Very disorganized and unstructured

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Terribly organized, and a horrific grader with esoteric marking criteria. The class is formatted horribly, and will give you 0s with absolutely zero feedback. Ignores students concerns.

Honestly, I hardly went to class (like 4 times for the whole semester) and still got a 4.0. Everything is pretty much lecture based but for essays I pulled material from the textbook which worked great (she gave me 100% on my essay). Straight-forward marker, uses interesting course concepts, lecture is a bit heavy, but a really nice woman :)

This prof is nice, at times. She answers your questions but I've noticed that questions sent to her via email are not given much consideration; instead, she answers in a rude way. However, the class itself is rather nice and tends to be based on class discussion and having done the readings (took it during the Summer Term).

A very intelligent professor, knowledgable but open to criticism and different opinions. Encourages debate and discussion on all topics but doesn't call out students for not participating. Participation marks depend on quality of class discussion.

I took a philosophy of art class with her in the summer. It was one of my favourite classes during university. She was very pleasant and her class was very enlightening. Years after the class I still have the power point slides she created because they were so great.
Not helpful at all, makes you feel horrible for asking for clarification, does not care about helping students improve or learn- just

One of the worst professors I've taken in three years. Everyone is hating but honestly I think the problem is more so the class, not the teacher. Cool guy, terrible course content.

reviews.comment: The professor is very approachable and always available to help. He gives constructive feedback and takes the time to repeat explanations until everything is clear. The exams are fair—neither too easy nor too difficult.

Can't complain since I received  my final exam mark I got 98%. I did technical scientific ts4 math. Ask questions if you are unsure. Final grade mark 89%.

Dude was funny in the way he chuckles or talks to students but damn he's tough to learn from. Sitting through one of his lectures is like watching paint dry. Perebasso

Wadii is an absolute beauty and top G.

Great class 10/10
he is a very good persom

I would say avoid this prof to every student who ask me about MAT courses

I love him. He's just so funny and makes the lecture go by so quickly, and created an amazing memory of a first-year math prof for me.  The material is difficult cuz he jokes around a lot , blah blah blah... I still don't care, he literally changed my midterm mark cuz I asked politely HAHA. Super funny i literally cried of laughter in his class. Always stays as long as possible after class to answer everyone's questions. Gives you exactly whats gonna be on his exams especially in his practice exams. Easy grader and chill. Best prof uOttawa has ever hired fr

Love this guy. You won't understand his course if you don't put your mind on it, but he's an easy grader and he often add bonus points to everyone if the class average isn't good. I know sometimes his explainations arent very clear, but you can see him after to ask him all your questions. I really liked studying with him
Plus, bro is very hilarious

A sweet guy but he is not a good professor. I love him but boy does he do a bad job at teaching. He is constantly sidetracked by other students asking stupid questions to slow him down on purpose. reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

I've seen stuff on midterm exams that we haven't been clearly taught.The tests are dangerous because most of the tests are multiple choice with only a few development questions that count for a lot of points.

Not the best teacher (very hard to understand) but is very caring and does everything in he can do get you the best mark possible. Go to all the DGD, study group sessions and do all the homework and you'll be fine

GOAT. Best prof this uni has ever hired. If you want the easiest A in your life take his class. His teaching is a bit goofy but will actually answer questions and make sure u understand. Great guy , really funny and knows his stuff.Lectures are as good as linear algebra can be so dry most of the time but wadii knows how to lighten the mood with his infamous jokes and stories  .He always  takes the time to answer to questions , and tries to help us as much as possible with grades by giving bonus points and extra exams .
Nice but doesn't teach very effectively make sure you have a textbook to help you understand
I will not take any course with him
I like him. He is cute.  Hahahahaha. He had a health problem at the end of the term. He was an excellent professor. I learned a lot from him.

Super funny teacher because he feels so awkward teaching classes. He's hard to understand at times but goes slowly for the harder stuff. He's really nice too. If you have a good TA, go to the DGDs every time because that's probably where you will learn the most lol. If you can, take a class with this teacher, I would recommend him!!
great teacher, kinda hard to understand at times. exams are super easy, gives out bonuses like no other. he also adjusts our grades to make sure everybody has the highest mark possible.

This teacher reminded me why I used to love math.  He is an amazing teacher, very clear.  I understood almost everything after each lecture he taught. Very cute and teach very well.  Is approchable and cares a lot about his student.  One of the best teacher I had!
Very funny and cute !
No Comments
awesome instructor his power points taught me more then a book would have. show up for class and take notes
This instructor takes time and effort to make his own power point for our classes. He stresses if we have a question ASK. his quizzes help with both exams. Listen, Take notes and participate,He
Instructor not very helpful, notes are given on a powerpoint there is no book required for this class, and anal about everything says he cares but he doesn't

He does not explain the procedure well and he doesn't like to be corrected. He tells student their stupid and ask the students with the best grade to stand up. Mr. Morsy is a alright teacher you just have to get to know him first and really pay attention to him because i enjoy is class and you learn a lot so he is not bad once you get to know him and pay close attention then you can understand what he is saying most of the time,

This man is horrible - can not understand a word he speaks - heaven forbid you ask him to repeat a sentence - he gets an attitude (big time) - can't avoid him or class because he is the only one that teaches it!!! yuck

If you do not work in a nursing home or have no knowledge of the day to day operations, you will find this class exceedingly frustrating. He hates to be challenged on any issue and its very hard to understand him when he lectures. In addition, someone should introduce him to spell check.
A Great Teacher. Very Difficult you must focus and take good notes. If you do this you'll be fine.

I have been a student for a number of years, both for undergrad and graduate level, and took this course to update some skills for career options. Group project dominated most of the class. Wan was pretty good at teaching the actual course material and her quizzes/tests weren't super hard. lots of group work and marked by few things overall good prof

Professors first time teaching and he was actually a great lecturer, seemed very passionate about the material. He also really wants his students to succeed. Cares a lot about students. Professor Guo is a wonderful instructor. He really knows how to teach! Although deep learning is a challenging topic, he can always make it easy to understand and teach it in simple way. He cares about students learning material, not giving them bad grades.
His exams are very fair, he will give you a practice test that will be very good indicator of exam material.
I learned a lot in his class and was not stressed about exams. His homeworks are also very clear. You can learn at your own pace using the slides if you want.
Very cute teacher he is very nice except slides are from 1999 so you can't even download them. Easy class because it's online.

Lectures were extremely dry and boring and the prof was almost monotonous. Exams were needlessly hard but doable. Very dense material and only relies on rote memorization.

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Super bland lectures that barely have information he only explins during Zoom. Exams were extremely difficult for no reason even when I studied for almost a week. He does not give practice questions other than a couple he barely answers in his class the week before the exam. He was the only prof option for this as of now but i would have switched.
AVOID him!!!
Lots of memorization and super boring lectures that you can't skip because of information that isn't in the course notes. Final exam was easier than midterms that are super hard.

This prof is great! Really nice and explains everything pretty well. The lectures get a little boring because they're 3 hours long, but that's not his fault. There's a lot of material to memorize but if you put the work in the quizzes and exams will go over great.

yan is pretty caring and is very open to answering questions. lectures are a little boring sometimes but they always end early. exams were pretty hard in my opinion but microbio is also just a hard class. lots to memorize, but if you put in the work you should be just fine.

He talks too slow, so you need a recording for 2x speed, this could be beneficial for people who write/type slow. Overall, kinda boring but interesting material. Slides are random, midterms and final was okay.

Such an awesome prof who really cares about his students and always ended lectures early!! Exams & quizzes aren't 'easy' but as long as you pay attention in class and study it's not difficult to get good grades. Would totally recommend Dr. Yan and would absolutely take another class of his again!

He is nice and knows what he is taking about but lecture are really slow and hard to sit through for 3 hours. Read the online textbook/booklet because exams are based off the textbook and not slides. Start studying for midterms early, there is a lot of memorization

He chose to make our last 2 exams virtual, grades got better and he accused everyone of cheating even though the tests were proctored. Loves the sound of his voice....The exams were much more difficult that what he portrayed in his lectures. Needing to know tiny unnecessary details about something is basically how he grades you.

Dr. Yan gives a straightforward lectures. The course notes and lecture ppt are concise and simple. Exams are fair. Dr. Yan was very responsive to my emails regarding exams and lecture contents. He is a kind professor who cares about students.

Extremely OK prof. Didn't enjoy his teaching style of expecting us to watch pre-recorded lectures before class, where he'd just skim over them and answer questions. reviews.comment: quizzes, and midterms are really tough, you'll need to know everything about all bacteria, viruses and fungi.  make sure to read and memorize course notes in addition to slides.

reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

I thoroughly enjoyed the content and found it very interesting! The tests can be a bit of a shock at first but once you get used to how questions are worded you won't have that much issues with it! A solid choice for a prof for this class.

Class is difficult, but fair. Professor Yan has clear expectations and provides you with all the content needed to do well.
